translations.literal: After the treaty was fixed, they immediately sent naval officers and consuls in steam vessels into the river, upstream to Hankou, and after more than a month returned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after ratification naval officers and consuls steamed upriver to Hankou on a survey that lasted over a month.

sentences.zh: 是年，議通商善後事。

translations.literal: That year, they deliberated on commercial-trade follow-up matters.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court turned to the routine business of treaty commerce.

sentences.zh: 時各國來天津換約，均因桂良原議，改由北塘海口入。

translations.literal: At the time the various states came to Tianjin to exchange treaties, all because of Guiliang's original proposal, changed to enter by the Beitang sea mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign envoys arrived at Tianjin to exchange ratifications; following Guiliang's plan, all were to land at Beitang instead of Dagu.

sentences.zh: 獨英船先抵天津海口，俄人繼之，突背前約，闖入大沽口。

translations.literal: Only the English ships first reached Tianjin's sea mouth; Russians followed, suddenly turning their backs on the prior agreement, forcing entry into the Dagukou mouth.
translations.idiomatic: British vessels reached Tianjin first, Russians close behind, and both broke the agreement by forcing the Dagu passage.

sentences.zh: 直隸總督恆福遣人持約往，令改道，不聽。

translations.literal: Zhili governor-general Hengfu sent men bearing the treaty to go, ordering them to change route; they did not heed.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Hengfu of Zhili sent envoys with the treaty to demand they change course; they refused.

sentences.zh: 九年夏五月，英船十餘艘駛至灘心。

translations.literal: In the fifth summer month of the ninth year, more than ten English vessels sailed to the heart of the shoal.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, year 9, a dozen British ships anchored on the inner shoals of the Dagu bar.

sentences.zh: 越日，豎紅旗挑戰，拽倒港口鐵鏁、鐵椿，遂逼砲臺，開砲轟擊。

translations.literal: The next day they raised a red banner to challenge battle, pulled down the port's iron chains and iron piles, then pressed the batteries and opened cannon to bombard.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they ran up a red battle flag, hauled away the harbor chains and piles, closed on the batteries, and opened a bombardment.

sentences.zh: 時僧格林沁防海口，開砲應之，沈毀其數船。

translations.literal: At the time Sengge Rinchen defended the sea mouth, opened cannon to answer them, and sank and destroyed several of their ships.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen, commanding the coastal defense, replied in kind and sank several ships.

sentences.zh: 英人復以步隊接戰，又敗之。

translations.literal: The English again used infantry to join battle, and were again defeated.
translations.idiomatic: A British landing force followed; they were beaten back again.

sentences.zh: 十年夏六月，復犯天津海口，直隸提督樂善守北岸砲臺，拒戰，中砲死。

translations.literal: In the sixth summer month of the tenth year, they again violated Tianjin's sea mouth; Zhili provincial commander Le Shan defended the north-bank batteries, resisted battle, was struck by cannon and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, year 10, the allies again assaulted the Tianjin approaches; provincial commander Le Shan held the north-bank batteries and was killed by shellfire.

sentences.zh: 時僧格林沁尚守南岸砲臺。

translations.literal: At the time Sengge Rinchen still defended the south-bank batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen still held the south bank.

sentences.zh: 詔罷兵議撫，乃自天津退軍張家灣，英遂乘勢陷天津。

translations.literal: An edict halted fighting and discussed pacification; thereupon from Tianjin the army withdrew to Zhangjiawan, and the English then rode the momentum to seize Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting was halted in favor of peace talks; Qing forces withdrew from Tianjin to Zhangjiawan, and the British occupied the port city.

sentences.zh: 尋復遣僧格林沁進軍通州。

translations.literal: Shortly they again dispatched Sengge Rinchen to advance the army to Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen was soon ordered forward again to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝仍命大學士桂良往天津議撫。

translations.literal: The Emperor still ordered Grand Secretary Guiliang to go to Tianjin to discuss pacification.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again sent Grand Secretary Guiliang to Tianjin to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 桂良抵津，牒洋人商和局。

translations.literal: Guiliang reached Tianjin, sent documents to the foreign people to consult on a peace settlement.
translations.idiomatic: Guiliang reached Tianjin and proposed terms to the foreign ministers.

sentences.zh: 英公使額爾金、參贊巴夏里請增軍費及在天津通商，並請各國公使帶兵入京換約。

translations.literal: English minister Elgin and counsellor Parkes requested increased military expenses and commerce at Tianjin, and also requested that the various states' ministers bring troops into the capital to exchange treaties.
translations.idiomatic: Elgin and Parkes demanded increased indemnities, commercial rights at Tianjin, and that all ministers enter Beijing under arms to exchange ratifications.

sentences.zh: 桂良以聞，嚴旨拒絕，仍命僧格林沁等守通州。

translations.literal: Guiliang reported upward; stern edicts refused, and still ordered Sengge Rinchen and others to defend Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guiliang reported the demands; the throne refused flatly and ordered Sengge Rinchen to hold Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，英人犯通州，帝命怡親王載垣赴通議款。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the English violated Tongzhou; the Emperor ordered Prince Zaiyuan of the First Rank to proceed to Tong to discuss terms.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month British forces advanced on Tongzhou, and Prince Zaiyuan was sent to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 時桂良及軍機大臣穆廕皆在，英使額爾金遣其參贊巴夏里入城議和，請循天津原議，並約法使會商。

translations.literal: At the time Guiliang and Grand Councillor Muyin were both present; the English envoy Elgin sent his counsellor Parkes into the city to discuss peace, requesting to follow the original Tianjin agreement and also fix a time for the French minister to confer.
translations.idiomatic: Guiliang and Grand Councillor Muyin were on hand when Elgin sent Parkes into the city to treat, asking to adhere to the Tianjin terms and arrange a joint conference with the French plenipotentiary.

sentences.zh: 翼日，宴於東獄廟。

translations.literal: The next day they feasted at the Eastern Temple of the God of Taishan.
translations.idiomatic: The next day a banquet was held at the Eastern Peak Temple.

sentences.zh: 巴夏里起曰：「今日之約，須面見大皇帝，以昭誠信。」

translations.literal: Parkes rose and said: "Today's agreement must have a face-to-face audience with the Great Emperor, to display sincerity and trust."
translations.idiomatic: Parkes rose and said, "Today's pact requires an audience with the Emperor himself, that good faith may be plain for all to see."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「遠方慕義，欲觀光上國久矣，請以軍容入。」

translations.literal: He also said: "From afar we have admired righteousness and long wished to behold the splendor of the Upper Kingdom; please allow entry in military array."
translations.idiomatic: He added, "We have long admired the Middle Kingdom from afar and beg leave to enter the capital in martial array.

sentences.zh: 王憤其語不遜，密商僧格林沁，擒送京師，兵端復作。

translations.literal: The Prince, enraged at his disrespectful speech, secretly consulted Sengge Rinchen, seized him and sent him to the capital, and war flared anew.
translations.idiomatic: Outraged at his insolence, the prince secretly arranged with Sengge Rinchen to seize Parkes and send him to Beijing; hostilities reopened at once.

sentences.zh: 時帝適秋獮，自行在詔以恭親王奕訢為全權大臣，守京師，並詔南軍入援。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor happened to be on the autumn hunt; from the traveling palace he issued an edict Prince Gong Yixin as plenipotentiary minister to guard the capital, and also issued an edict southern armies to enter as relief.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was away on the autumn hunt and from Rehe appointed Prince Gong full plenipotentiary to defend the capital, summoning southern troops to reinforce Beijing.

sentences.zh: 時團防大臣、大學士周祖培，尚書陳孚恩等議籌辦團練城守事。

translations.literal: At the time defense coordinators Grand Secretary Zhou Zupei, Minister Chen Fuen and others deliberated on planning militia training and city defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Defense coordinators including Grand Secretary Zhou Zupei and Minister Chen Fuen organized militia and strengthened the city walls.

sentences.zh: 恭親王、桂良駐城外，而英師已薄城下，焚圓明園。

translations.literal: Prince Gong and Guiliang garrisoned outside the walls, while English troops had already pressed close beneath the city and burned the Yuanming Garden.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong and Guiliang remained outside the walls even as British columns reached the suburbs and burned the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 英人請開安定門入與恭親王面議和，乃約以次日定和議，而釋巴夏里於獄，遣恆祺送歸。

translations.literal: The English requested opening Anding Gate to enter and discuss peace face-to-face with Prince Gong; they then agreed to fix the peace settlement the next day, while releasing Parkes from prison and dispatching Hengqi to escort him back.
translations.idiomatic: The British asked that Anding Gate be opened so Prince Gong could treat with them in person; terms were set for the morrow, Parkes was released from prison, and Hengqi escorted him back to camp.

sentences.zh: 九月，和議成，增償兵費八百萬，並開天津商埠，復以廣東九龍司地與英人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the peace agreement was concluded, increasing indemnity military expenses by eight million, also opening Tianjin as a commercial port, and again ceding Guangdong's Kowloon Division lands to the English.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month peace was concluded: indemnities rose by eight million taels, Tianjin was opened to trade, and Kowloon was ceded.

sentences.zh: 是年，用里國太幫辦稅務。

translations.literal: That year, Li Guotai was employed to assist in handling customs revenue.
translations.idiomatic: That year Horatio Nelson Lay was appointed to assist in customs administration.

sentences.zh: 十一年春二月，英人始立漢口、九江市埠，均設洋關。

translations.literal: In the second spring month of the eleventh year, the English first established commercial ports at Hankou and Jiujiang, both setting foreign customs stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring, year 11, treaty ports were opened at Hankou and Jiujiang, each with an Imperial Maritime Customs house.

sentences.zh: 九月，總署因與英使卜魯士議暫訂長江通商章程十二款，納稅章程五款。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Yamen, because of discussions with the English envoy Bruce, provisionally fixed twelve articles on Yangtze commercial regulations and five articles on tax payment regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Zongli Yamen provisionally agreed twelve articles on Yangtze trade and five on taxation with Minister Frederick Bruce.

sentences.zh: 是月，交還廣東省城。

translations.literal: That month, they returned Guangdong provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: That month the British returned the walled city of Canton.

sentences.zh: 卜魯士始駐京。

translations.literal: Bruce first resided in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Bruce took up residence in Beijing for the first time.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，與英人議立招工章程。

translations.literal: In the first spring month of the fifth year, they deliberated with the English on establishing regulations for recruiting laborers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, year 5 of the reign, regulations on recruiting contract laborers were negotiated with Britain.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月，臺灣英領事吉必勳因運樟腦被阻，牽及教堂，洋將茄當踞營署，殺傷兵勇，焚燒軍火局庫，索取兵費。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, Taiwan's English consul Gibson, because transporting camphor was obstructed, involved the church; foreign officer Jiadang occupied the barracks office, killed and wounded soldiers, burned the arsenal depot, and demanded military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, year 7, the British consul at Taiwan, Gibson, clashed over blocked camphor exports; foreign troops under a naval commander took over the yamen, killed Qing soldiers, burned the arsenal, and demanded indemnities.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詰英使，久之，始將吉必勳撤任。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, they questioned the English envoy; after a long time they finally removed Gibson from his post.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached Beijing the British minister was pressed; only after prolonged diplomacy was Gibson recalled.

sentences.zh: 未幾，英兵船在潮州，又有毀燒民房、殺死民人事，幾釀變。

translations.literal: Before long, English gunboats at Chaozhou again had matters of destroying and burning civilian houses and killing civilians, nearly brewing an incident.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward British gunboats at Chaozhou burned houses and killed civilians, nearly sparking a riot.

sentences.zh: 八年九月，與英換新約，英使阿禮國請朝覲，不許。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year, they exchanged a new treaty with England; English envoy Alcock requested an imperial audience, and it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, year 8, a revised treaty was exchanged; Minister Rutherford Alcock asked for an audience and was refused.

sentences.zh: 九年，請辦電線、鐵路，不許。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, they requested establishing telegraph lines and railways; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 they sought permission for telegraph lines and railways; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 既而請設水底電線於中國通商各口，許之。

translations.literal: Soon after they requested laying submarine cables at China's treaty-port openings; this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: A later request to lay submarine cables between treaty ports was granted.

sentences.zh: 十年，請開瓊州商埠。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, they requested opening Qiongzhou as a commercial port.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 they asked to open Qiongzhou (Haikou) as a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 先是同治七年修新約，英使阿禮國允將瓊州停止通商，以易溫州。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the seventh year of Tongzhi when revising the new treaty, English envoy Alcock agreed to cease commerce at Qiongzhou in exchange for Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, under the Tongzhi revision of year 7, Alcock had agreed to close Qiongzhou in exchange for Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 至是，英使威妥瑪與法、俄、美、布各國咸以為請，允仍開瓊州。

translations.literal: At this point English envoy Wade, together with France, Russia, America, and Bu states, all made the same request; permission was granted still to open Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Now Wade, joined by the French, Russian, American, and Prussian ministers, asked again, and the court agreed to reopen Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二年，穆宗親政，始覲見。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Emperor Muzong personally took government; audiences began.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 the Tongzhi Emperor assumed personal rule and foreign ministers were at last received in audience.

sentences.zh: 初因覲見禮節中外不同，各國議數月不決，英持尤力，至是始以鞠躬代拜跪，惟易三鞠躬為五，號為加禮。

translations.literal: At first because audience rites differed between China and foreign states, the various countries deliberated for months without decision; England held especially hard, until then they first used bowing from the waist to replace prostration and kneeling, only changing three bows to five, termed augmented rite.
translations.idiomatic: For months the powers had haggled over court etiquette; Britain had been the most insistent. Now bowing replaced the kowtow, three bows becoming five in what was styled an "enhanced courtesy."

sentences.zh: 二年五月，諭：「馬嘉理案，疊經王大臣與英使威妥瑪辯論未洽，命李鴻章商辦早結。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, an edict stated: "In the Margary case, repeatedly prince-ministers and the English envoy Wade debated without harmony; Li Hongzhang is ordered to negotiate early conclusion."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, year 2, an edict declared that the Margary affair, long debated between senior ministers and Minister Wade without result, must now be settled by Li Hongzhang.

sentences.zh: 六月，命鴻章為全權大臣，赴煙臺，與威妥瑪會商，相持者逾月，議始定。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Hongzhang was ordered as plenipotentiary minister to proceed to Yantai and confer with Wade; they faced off for more than a month before deliberations were finally fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Li was appointed plenipotentiary and went to Yantai; negotiations with Wade deadlocked for more than a month before terms were fixed.

sentences.zh: 七月，鴻章奏稱：「臣抵煙臺，威妥瑪堅求將全案人證解京覆訊，其注意尤在岑毓英主使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Hongzhang memorialized stating: "Your servant reached Yantai; Wade firmly demanded the entire case's witnesses be sent to the capital for re-examination, his attention especially on Cen Yuying as instigator.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Li reported from Yantai that Wade insisted all witnesses be brought to Beijing for retrial, focusing above all on provincial governor Cen Yuying as the alleged mastermind.

sentences.zh: 臣與反復駁辨，適俄、德、美、法、日、奧六國使臣及英、德水師提督均集煙臺，往來談宴，因于萬壽聖節，邀請列國公使、提督至公所燕飲慶賀，情誼聯洽。

translations.literal: Your servant with him repeatedly rebutted and argued; it happened that six states' envoys of Russia, Germany, America, France, Japan, and Austria, and English and German naval commanders-in-chief, all gathered at Yantai, coming and going in talks and banquets; on account of the Longevity Sacred Festival your servant invited the various states' ministers and admirals to the public hall for a convivial toast in celebration, sentiments linked in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Li rebuffed him repeatedly. Envoys of Russia, Germany, the United States, France, Japan, and Austria—along with British and German admirals—were also at Yantai; on the emperor's birthday Li hosted a banquet for all the envoys and naval commanders, and the goodwill thus cultivated helped loosen the talks.

sentences.zh: 翌日，威使始允另議辦法，將條款送臣查核。

translations.literal: The next day Wade's envoy first agreed to discuss another method of handling, and sent the articles to your servant for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Wade agreed to an alternative procedure and submitted draft articles for Li's review.

sentences.zh: 其昭雪滇案六條，皆總理衙門已經應允，惟償款銀數未定。

translations.literal: Its six articles clearing the Yunnan case, the Zongli Yamen had already agreed to all; only the indemnity silver amount was unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Six articles on exonerating officials in the Yunnan case had already been accepted by the Yamen; only the indemnity sum remained open.

sentences.zh: 其優待使臣三條：一，京外兩國官員會晤，禮節儀制互異，欲訂以免爭端；

translations.literal: Its three articles on preferential treatment of envoys: first, when officials of the two states meet inside and outside the capital, etiquette and ceremonial systems differ, wishing to fix rules to avoid disputes;
translations.idiomatic: Three articles on diplomatic privileges followed: first, uniform etiquette when Chinese and foreign officials met inside and outside the capital, to forestall disputes;

sentences.zh: 一，通商各口會審案件；

translations.literal: second, joint trial of cases at the various treaty ports;
translations.idiomatic: second, joint trial of cases at treaty ports;

sentences.zh: 一，中外辦案觀審，兩條可合併參看。

translations.literal: third, China and foreign states handling cases with observers at trial—these two articles may be consulted together.
translations.idiomatic: third, the right of foreign observers at trials—the last two were to be read together.

sentences.zh: 觀審一節，亦經總署於八條內允行。

translations.literal: The provision on observance at trial had also been permitted by the Yamen within the eight articles.
translations.idiomatic: The observer principle had already been conceded in earlier eight-article negotiations.

sentences.zh: 至通商事務原議七條：一，通商各口，請定不應抽收洋貨釐金之界，並欲在沿海、沿江、沿湖地面，添設口岸；

translations.literal: As for commercial matters, the seven originally proposed articles: first, at treaty ports, requesting to fix boundaries where foreign goods should not be levied likin, and wishing on coastal, riverside, and lakeside ground to add ports;
translations.idiomatic: On commercial matters, seven original articles remained. First, delimit zones exempt from likin on foreign goods and open additional ports along the coast, rivers, and lakes;

sentences.zh: 一，請添口岸，分作三項，以重慶、宜昌、溫州、蕪湖、北海五處為領事官駐紮，湖口、沙市、水東三處為稅務司分駐，安慶、大通、武穴、陸溪口、岳州、瑪斯六處為輪船上下客商貨物；

translations.literal: second, requesting additional ports, divided into three categories: Chongqing, Yichang, Wenzhou, Wuhu, Beihai five places for consular residence; Hukou, Shashi, Shuidong three places for assistant commissioners of customs residence; Anqing, Datong, Wuxue, Luxikou, Yuezhou, Masi six places for steamships loading and unloading travelers' goods;
translations.idiomatic: second, new ports in three tiers—Chongqing, Yichang, Wenzhou, Wuhu, and Beihai for consuls; Hukou, Shashi, and Shuidong for deputy commissioners of customs; and Anqing, Datong, Wuxue, Luxikou, Yuezhou, and Masi for steamers to land passengers and cargo;

sentences.zh: 一，洋藥准在新關並納稅釐；

translations.literal: third, foreign opium permitted at the new customs to pay tax and likin together;
translations.idiomatic: third, opium to pay duty and likin together at treaty customs houses;

sentences.zh: 一，洋貨半稅單，請定劃一款式，華、洋商人均准領單，洋商運土貨出口，商定防弊章程；

translations.literal: fourth, foreign goods' half-duty certificates, requesting to fix a uniform format; Chinese and foreign merchants alike permitted to receive certificates; foreign merchants shipping native goods outbound, agreeing on anti-abuse regulations;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, a uniform certificate for the transit duty on foreign goods, issuable to Chinese and foreign merchants alike, with agreed safeguards on foreign merchants exporting native goods;

sentences.zh: 一，洋貨運回外國，訂明存票年限；

translations.literal: fifth, foreign goods shipped back abroad, specifying years for retaining certificates;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, fixed validity periods for warehouse receipts when foreign goods were re-exported;

sentences.zh: 一，香港會定巡船收稅章程；

translations.literal: sixth, Hong Kong jointly fixing patrol-ship tax-collection regulations;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, revised regulations for revenue cruisers operating out of Hong Kong;

sentences.zh: 一，各口未定租界，請再議訂。

translations.literal: seventh, ports where concessions were not yet fixed, requesting further deliberation and fixing.
translations.idiomatic: seventh, further talks on concessions not yet demarcated at various ports.

sentences.zh: 以上如洋藥釐稅由新關並徵，既免偷漏，亦可隨時加增；

translations.literal: Regarding the above, such as foreign opium likin tax collected jointly by the new customs—this both avoids smuggling leakage and may also be increased at any time;
translations.idiomatic: On these points, collecting opium likin at treaty customs would curb smuggling and allow rates to be raised when needed;

sentences.zh: 土貨報單嚴定章程，冀免影射冒騙諸弊；

translations.literal: native goods transit certificates with strict regulations, hoping to avoid the abuses of shadowing and fraudulent substitution;
translations.idiomatic: tighter rules on native-goods transit passes would curb false reporting and smuggling;

sentences.zh: 香港妥議收稅辦法，均尚於中國課餉有益。

translations.literal: Hong Kong properly deliberating tax-collection methods, all still benefit China's revenue levies.
translations.idiomatic: and a sound revenue regime for Hong Kong would still benefit the imperial treasury.

sentences.zh: 其餘亦與條約不背。

translations.literal: The remainder also does not turn against the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining clauses were consistent with existing treaties.

sentences.zh: 英使又擬明年派員赴西藏探路，請給護照，因不便附入滇案、優待、通商三端之內，故列為專條。

translations.literal: The English envoy also planned next year to send staff to Tibet to reconnoitre routes, requesting passports; because it was inconvenient to attach this within the three parts of the Yunnan case, preferential treatment, and commerce, it was therefore listed as a separate article.
translations.idiomatic: Wade also sought passports for a survey mission to Tibet the following year; as this lay outside the Yunnan, diplomatic, and commercial sections, it was set out in a separate article.

sentences.zh: 免定口界、添設口岸兩事，反覆爭論，乃允免定口界，僅於租界免抽洋貨釐金，且指明洋貨、土貨仍可抽收。

translations.literal: The two matters of exempting fixed port boundaries and adding ports were argued back and forth; permission was then granted to exempt fixed port boundaries, only within concessions to exempt likin on foreign goods, and it was specified that foreign goods and native goods might still be levied.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged debate over likin-free zones and new ports, the court conceded on boundaries—exempting foreign-goods likin only within concessions while reserving the right to tax both foreign and native goods elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 將來洋藥加徵，稍資撥補，似於大局無甚妨礙。

translations.literal: Future increases in foreign-opium levies would slightly supplement allocations; it seems there is not much hindrance to the larger situation.
translations.idiomatic: Higher opium duties could offset revenue losses and seemed acceptable on balance.

sentences.zh: 至添口岸一節，總署已允宜昌、溫州、北海三處，赫德續請添蕪湖口，亦經奏准。

translations.literal: As for the matter of adding ports, the Yamen had already permitted Yichang, Wenzhou, and Beihai three places; Hart further requested adding Wuhu mouth, which was also approved by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On new ports the Yamen had already approved Yichang, Wenzhou, and Beihai; Hart then secured approval for Wuhu as well.

sentences.zh: 今仍堅持前議，准添四口，作為領事官駐紮處所。

translations.literal: Now still holding to the prior deliberation, four ports were permitted as places for consular residence.
translations.idiomatic: Li held to prior limits and approved four ports for consular residence.

sentences.zh: 其重慶派英員駐寓，總署已於八條內議准，未便即作口岸，聲明俟輪船能上駛時，再行議辦。

translations.literal: As for Chongqing, dispatching an English officer to reside there, the Yamen had already agreed within the eight articles; it was inconvenient immediately to make it a port, declaring that when steam vessels could sail upstream, deliberation would again be undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqing, where an English officer might reside, had been conceded in the eight articles but could not yet be opened as a full port until steamers could reach it upstream.

sentences.zh: 至沿江不通商口岸上下客商貨物一節，自長江開碼頭後，輪船隨處停泊，載人運物，因未明定章程，礙難禁阻。

translations.literal: As for the provision on non-treaty ports along the river where travelers' goods are loaded and unloaded—since the Yangtze opened wharves, steam vessels everywhere anchored and carried people and goods; because regulations were not yet clearly fixed, prohibition was difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Steamers already stopped at will along the Yangtze to take on passengers and cargo; without clear rules the practice could not be stopped.

sentences.zh: 英使既必欲議准，似不在停泊處所之多寡，要在口岸內地之分明。

translations.literal: The English envoy, since he must have this permitted in deliberation, seems that the issue is not how many places anchor, but that inland territory within ports must be clearly distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Wade insisted on formal approval; Li argued the issue was not how many landing places existed but how clearly port limits were drawn inland.

sentences.zh: 臣今與訂『上下貨物，皆用民船起卸，仍照內地定章，除洋貨稅單查驗免釐外，有報單之土貨，只准上船，不准卸賣，其餘應完稅釐，由地方官一律妥辦』等語，是與民船載貨查收釐金者一律，只須各地方關卡員役查察嚴密耳。

translations.literal: Your servant now with him fixed: 'Goods loaded and unloaded above and below all use native boats for transfer, still following inland fixed regulations; apart from foreign-goods tax certificates inspected and exempt from likin, native goods with transit certificates are only permitted aboard ship, not permitted to be unloaded and sold; the remainder should complete tax and likin, uniformly handled by local officials' and so forth—this is the same as native boats carrying goods and collecting likin; it only requires local barrier clerks and runners at each place to inspect strictly.'
translations.idiomatic: Li agreed that cargo must be transferred by native craft under inland rules: foreign goods with duty certificates would be likin-exempt, certificated native goods could be loaded but not sold ashore, and all other dues would be collected by local officials—matching existing likin practice, provided barrier staff enforced the rules.

sentences.zh: 英使先請湖口等九處，臣與釐定廣東之水東系沿海地方，不准驟開此禁，岳州距江稍遠，不准繞越行走，姑允沿江之大通、安慶、湖口、武穴、陸溪口、沙市六處，輪船可暫停泊，悉照內地抽徵章程。

translations.literal: The English envoy first requested Hukou and nine other places; your servant with him fixed that Guangdong's Shuidong was a coastal place and could not suddenly open this prohibition, Yuezhou was somewhat distant from the river and could not detour to pass; for the time being along the river Datong, Anqing, Hukou, Wuxue, Luxikou, and Shashi six places were permitted for steam vessels temporarily to anchor, all following inland levy regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Wade had asked for nine stops including Hukou; Li barred Shuidong on the Guangdong coast and Yuezhou as too far inland, granting six Yangtze anchorages—Datong, Anqing, Hukou, Wuxue, Luxikou, and Shashi—subject to inland likin rules.

sentences.zh: 臣復與德國使臣巴蘭德議及德國修約添口，即照英國議定辦理。

translations.literal: Your servant again with the German envoy Brandt discussed Germany's treaty revision adding ports, to be handled according to what England had fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Li also told the German minister Brandt that new ports in Germany's revised treaty would follow the British settlement.

sentences.zh: 威妥瑪請半年後，開辦口岸租界，免洋貨釐，洋藥並納釐稅，須與各國會商，再行開辦，因准另為一條。

translations.literal: Wade requested that after half a year, opening port concessions and exempting foreign-goods likin, with foreign opium paying likin tax together, must be discussed with the various states before again opening; permission was granted to make this a separate article.
translations.idiomatic: Wade asked that concession zones, likin exemptions, and combined opium duties take effect in six months after consultation with other powers; this was allowed as a separate clause.

sentences.zh: 至派員赴西藏探路一節，條約既准遊歷，亦無阻止之理。

translations.literal: As for the matter of dispatching staff to Tibet to reconnoitre routes, since the treaty already permitted travel, there was also no reason to obstruct.
translations.idiomatic: On the Tibet survey, the treaty already allowed travel and could not reasonably be blocked.

sentences.zh: 臣於原議內由總理衙門、駐藏大臣查度情形字樣，屆時應由總理衙門妥慎籌酌。

translations.literal: Within the original deliberation your servant used the wording 'to be investigated according to circumstances by the Zongli Yamen and the resident minister in Tibet'; when the time came it should be carefully weighed by the Zongli Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: The draft had left timing to the Yamen and the Tibetan resident minister; Li noted the Yamen would decide when the mission should proceed.

sentences.zh: 迨至諸議就緒，商及滇案償款。

translations.literal: When all deliberations were settled, they then discussed the Yunnan-case indemnity.
translations.idiomatic: Once the other points were settled, talks turned to the Margary indemnity.

sentences.zh: 英使謂去冬專為此事，調來飛遊幫大兵船四隻，保護商民，計船費已近百萬。

translations.literal: The English envoy said that last winter he had specially for this matter summoned four fast cruiser gunboats to protect merchants, calculating that vessel expenses already approached one million.
translations.idiomatic: Wade said he had last winter sent four fast cruisers solely for this affair to protect merchants, at a cost approaching one million taels.

sentences.zh: 臣謂兩國並未失和，無認償兵費之例，囑其定數。

translations.literal: Your servant said the two states had not yet broken relations, and there was no precedent for acknowledging indemnity for military expenses, and instructed him to fix the amount.
translations.idiomatic: Li replied that the two countries were not at war and that there was no precedent for paying military costs as indemnity, and asked Wade to state a definite sum.

sentences.zh: 英使謂吳淞鐵路正滋口舌，如臣能調停主持，彼即擔代，仍照原議作二十萬，遂定議。

translations.literal: The English envoy said the Wusong Railway was just then breeding quarrels; if your servant could mediate and preside, he would bear it on their behalf, still according to the original deliberation making two hundred thousand, and deliberation was then fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Wade said the Wusong Railway dispute was still contentious; if Li would mediate, Britain would cover that issue and hold to the original figure of two hundred thousand taels, and the indemnity was settled.

sentences.zh: 因於二十六日，將所繕會議條款華、洋文四分，彼此畫押蓋印互換。

translations.literal: Therefore on the twenty-sixth day, the drafted conference articles in Chinese and foreign scripts, four copies each, were mutually initialed, sealed, and exchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-sixth the negotiated articles were drawn up in four Chinese and four English copies, signed, sealed, and exchanged.

sentences.zh: 至滇邊通商，威使面稱擬暫緩開辦，求於結案諭旨之末，豫為聲明。」

translations.literal: As for Yunnan-border trade, Minister Wade stated in person that he planned temporarily to defer opening; he requested at the end of the closing edict to declare this in advance."
translations.idiomatic: On border trade with Yunnan, Wade said opening would be deferred for the time being and asked that the closing edict say so explicitly.

sentences.zh: 疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; report was heard.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 鴻章仍回直督本任。

translations.literal: Hongzhang still returned to his original post as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang then resumed his post as governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 約成互換，是為煙臺條約。

translations.literal: When the treaty was completed and exchanged, this was the Yantai Treaty.
translations.idiomatic: After ratification and exchange, the agreement became known as the Chefoo Convention.

sentences.zh: 約分三端：一曰昭雪滇案，二曰優待往來，三曰通商事務。

translations.literal: The treaty was divided into three parts: first, clearing the Yunnan case; second, preferential treatment of mutual travel; third, commercial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: It had three sections: vindication in the Margary affair, diplomatic courtesies, and trade.

sentences.zh: 又另議專案一條。

translations.literal: A separate article was also separately deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: A fourth separate article was added.

sentences.zh: 是年，遣候補五品京堂劉錫鴻持璽書往英，為踐約惋惜滇案也。

translations.literal: That year, the court dispatched acting fifth-rank capital official Liu Xihong bearing the imperial sealed letter to England, to fulfill the treaty and express regret for the Yunnan case.
translations.idiomatic: That year Liu Xihong was sent to Britain as acting fifth-rank capital official with an imperial letter of regret over the Margary affair, as the treaty required.

sentences.zh: 三年，英窺喀什噶爾，以護持安集延為詞。

translations.literal: In the third year, England eyed Kashgar, using protection of Andijan as pretext.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Britain cast its eyes on Kashgar, citing protection of Andijan.

sentences.zh: 陝甘總督左宗棠拒之。

translations.literal: Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Zuo Zongtang refused them.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang, governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu, refused.

sentences.zh: 英人欲中國與喀什噶爾劃地界，又請入西藏探路，皆不行。

translations.literal: The English wished China to demarcate boundaries with Kashgar, and also requested entry into Tibet to reconnoitre routes; both were not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Britain asked China to delimit a border with Kashgar and sought permission to survey routes into Tibet; both requests were denied.

sentences.zh: 是年始於英屬地星嘉坡設領事。

translations.literal: That year a consul was first established at Xingjiapo in English territory.
translations.idiomatic: That year China first posted a consul at Singapore in British territory.

sentences.zh: 四年秋八月，福建民毀英烏石山教堂，英人要求償所失乃已。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn in the fourth year, Fujian people destroyed the English Wushishan church; the English demanded compensation for losses before they would desist.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, year 4, Fujian locals razed the British church at Wushishan; Britain demanded compensation before it would drop the matter.

sentences.zh: 五年，英欲與中國定釐稅並徵確數。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, England wished with China to fix likin and levy definite amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Britain pressed China to fix likin rates and exact figures.

sentences.zh: 總署擬仍照煙臺原議條款，稅照舊則，釐照舊章。

translations.literal: The Yamen planned still to follow the Yantai original deliberation articles: duties according to old rules, likin according to old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen proposed to keep Chefoo terms: customs duties on the old scale and likin under existing rules.

sentences.zh: 七年十月，李鴻章復與威妥瑪議洋藥加徵稅釐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventh year, Li Hongzhang again with Wade deliberated increased levy of tax and likin on foreign opium.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, year 7, Li Hongzhang again negotiated with Wade over higher combined duties on imported opium.

sentences.zh: 初，洋藥稅釐並征之議，始發于左宗棠，原議每箱徵銀一百五十兩。

translations.literal: Initially, the deliberation on collecting foreign-opium tax and likin together first arose from Zuo Zongtang; the original deliberation was one hundred fifty taels of silver per chest.
translations.idiomatic: The idea of a combined opium duty had first come from Zuo Zongtang, who had proposed one hundred fifty taels per chest.

sentences.zh: 其後各督撫往來商議，訖無成說。

translations.literal: Afterward the various governors-general exchanged deliberations, but in the end no settled proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors debated the matter by correspondence, but no agreement was reached.

sentences.zh: 滇案起，鴻章乃與威妥瑪議商洋藥加徵稅釐。

translations.literal: When the Yunnan case arose, Hongzhang then with Wade deliberated and discussed increased levy of tax and likin on foreign opium.
translations.idiomatic: During the Margary negotiations Li took up opium duties again with Wade.

sentences.zh: 威妥瑪謂須將進出口稅同商，定議進口稅值百抽十，而出口稅以英商不原加稅為辭，並主張在各口新關釐稅並加，通免內地釐金。

translations.literal: Wade said import and export duties must be discussed together; deliberation fixed import duty at ten per hundred of value, while export duty used English merchants' unwillingness to add tax as plea, and also advocated at each port's new customs adding likin tax together, with general exemption of inland likin.
translations.idiomatic: Wade insisted import and export tariffs be negotiated together, sought ten per cent ad valorem on imports, refused export increases on British merchants' plea, and wanted combined opium duties at treaty ports in exchange for abolishing inland likin.

sentences.zh: 鴻章以欲通免釐金，當於海關抽稅百二十兩，須加正稅三倍。

translations.literal: Hongzhang said that if one wished general exemption of likin, then at customs one should levy one hundred twenty taels in tax and must add three times the regular duty.
translations.idiomatic: Li replied that a nationwide likin exemption would require one hundred twenty taels at the customs—three times the basic duty.

sentences.zh: 如不免釐金，則須增加一倍至六十兩。

translations.literal: If likin were not exempted, then one must increase by one fold to sixty taels.
translations.idiomatic: Without likin exemption the rate need only be doubled, to sixty taels.

sentences.zh: 既，威妥瑪接到本國擬定鴉片加稅章程數條：「一，釐稅並徵增至九十兩；

translations.literal: Soon after, Wade received from his state several articles of a drafted opium tax-increase regulation: "First, combined likin and tax increased to ninety taels;
translations.idiomatic: Wade then received from London a draft opium tariff with several clauses: "First, combined duties raised to ninety taels;

sentences.zh: 二，增正稅至五十兩，各口釐金仍照舊收；

translations.literal: Second, increase regular duty to fifty taels, while likin at each port still collected as before;
translations.idiomatic: second, the basic duty raised to fifty taels, with port likin unchanged;

sentences.zh: 三，擬由中國通收印度鴉片，而印度政府或約於每年減種鴉片，或由兩國商定當減年限，至限滿日停種，至每石定價，或按年交還，或另立付價，時候亦由兩國訂明，其價或在香港撥還，或在印度交兌，其事則官辦商辦均可；

translations.literal: Third, plan for China to collect Indian opium throughout, while the Indian government might agree annually to reduce opium cultivation, or the two states fix the years of reduction; when the term was full, planting would cease; as for fixed price per picul, or annual repayment, or separate payment, the time would also be fixed by the two states; payment might be remitted at Hong Kong or exchanged in India; the matter could be handled by government or merchants;
translations.idiomatic: third, China might monopolize Indian opium imports while India phased out cultivation over agreed years, with price, payment schedule, and settlement in Hong Kong or India left to bilateral terms and to official or merchant management;

sentences.zh: 四，擬立專辦洋藥英商公司，每箱應償印度政府一定價值，應納中國國家一定釐稅，至繳清此項釐稅後，其洋藥在中國即不重徵，印度政府約明年限，將鴉片逐漸裁止。」

translations.literal: Fourth, plan to establish a specialized English merchant company for foreign opium; each chest should compensate the Indian government a fixed value and pay the Chinese state a fixed likin; after this likin was paid in full, the foreign opium in China would not be levied again; the Indian government would set a term next year to cut off opium gradually."
translations.idiomatic: fourth, a British opium company would pay India a fixed sum per chest and China a fixed likin, after which opium would be duty-free inland, while India undertook to end exports over a set period."

sentences.zh: 初，威妥瑪於進口已允值百抽十，至是因洋藥稅釐未定，又翻。

translations.literal: Initially Wade on imports had already permitted ten per hundred of value; now because foreign-opium tax and likin were unsettled, he again reversed.
translations.idiomatic: Wade had already accepted ten per cent on general imports, but reopened the question while opium duties remained unsettled.

sentences.zh: 又欲於各口租界外，酌定二三十里之界，免收洋貨釐。

translations.literal: He also wished outside each port's concession to fix a boundary of twenty or thirty li, exempting foreign-goods likin.
translations.idiomatic: He also sought a likin-free belt of twenty or thirty li beyond each concession.

sentences.zh: 鴻章以租界免釐，載在條約，業經開辦有年，何得復議推廣？

translations.literal: Hongzhang said concession likin exemption was recorded in the treaty and had been in operation for years—how could it be deliberated again and expanded?
translations.idiomatic: Li objected that likin exemption within concessions was treaty-bound and long established and could not be widened.

sentences.zh: 拒之。

translations.literal: He refused them.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 威妥瑪又請由香港設電線達粵省，其上岸祗准在黃埔輪船停泊附近之處，由粵省大吏酌定。

translations.literal: Wade again requested telegraph lines from Hong Kong reaching Guangdong province; landing ashore was only permitted near where steam vessels anchored at Huangpu, to be fixed by Guangdong high officials.
translations.idiomatic: Wade also asked for a telegraph cable from Hong Kong to Guangdong, landing only near the Huangpu steamer anchorage as the provincial authorities might designate.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，上諭：「洋藥稅釐並徵，載在煙臺條約，總理衙門歷次與英使威妥瑪商議，終以咨報本國為詞，藉作延宕。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year, the emperor decreed: "Foreign-opium tax and likin collected together is recorded in the Yantai Treaty; the Zongli Yamen repeatedly with the English envoy Wade discussed it, but in the end used reporting to the home country as plea, borrowing delay.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, year 9, the throne ordered: "Combined opium duties were promised in the Chefoo Convention; the Yamen had repeatedly negotiated with Wade, who stalled by referring every point to London.

sentences.zh: 威妥瑪現已回國，著派出使大臣曾紀澤妥為商辦，如李鴻章前議一百一十兩之數，並在進口時輸納，即可就此定議。

translations.literal: Wade has now returned to his country; order the envoy minister Zeng Jiyang properly to negotiate; if like Li Hongzhang's prior deliberation of one hundred ten taels, and paid at import, then deliberation may be fixed on this.
translations.idiomatic: Wade has now left China. Zeng Jiyang in London should settle the matter on Li Hongzhang's figure of one hundred ten taels, payable on import.

sentences.zh: 洋藥流毒多年，自應設法禁止。

translations.literal: Foreign opium has flowed poison for many years; naturally methods to prohibit it should be devised.
translations.idiomatic: Opium had poisoned the country for decades and ought to be curbed.

sentences.zh: 英國現有戒煙會，頗以洋藥害人為恥。

translations.literal: England now has an anti-smoking society, which rather takes shame in foreign opium harming people.
translations.idiomatic: Britain itself had a temperance movement that regarded the trade as a national disgrace.

sentences.zh: 如能乘機利導，與英外部酌議洋藥進口、分年遞減專條，逐漸禁止，尤屬正本清源之計。

translations.literal: If one could seize the opportunity and guide advantageously, with the English Foreign Office deliberating a separate article on foreign-opium import with year-by-year progressive reduction, gradually prohibiting it, that would especially be a plan to rectify the root and clear the source.
translations.idiomatic: If Zeng could steer London toward a phased reduction of imports, that would strike at the root of the evil.

sentences.zh: 並著酌量籌辦。」

translations.literal: He is also ordered to deliberate and handle as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: He was told to explore that course as well.

sentences.zh: 紀澤奉旨與英外部議，三年始定。

translations.literal: Zeng Jiyang received the decree and with the English Foreign Office deliberated; only in the third year was it fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng obeyed and bargained with the Foreign Office for three years before terms were fixed.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，奏曰：「臣遵旨與英外部尚書伯爵葛蘭斐爾，侍郎龐斯茀德、克雷等商論，力爭數目，最後乃得照一百一十兩之數。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, he memorialized: "Your servant, obeying the decree, with the English Foreign Office minister Earl Granville, vice-ministers Ponsonby, Clare, and others discussed; struggling over the figures, at last one obtained accordance with one hundred ten taels.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, year 11, he reported: "As ordered, I negotiated with Foreign Secretary Earl Granville and Under-Secretaries Ponsonby and Clare, pressing hard on the sum until London accepted one hundred ten taels per chest.

sentences.zh: 今年二月，准彼外部允照臣議，開具節略，咨送臣署，且欲另定專條，聲明中國如不能令有約諸國一體遵照，英國即有立廢專約之權。

translations.literal: This second month, their Foreign Office permitted according to your servant's deliberation, drew up a summary, and sent it to your servant's legation; they also wished to fix a separate article stating that if China could not make treaty powers uniformly comply, England would have the right immediately to annul the special treaty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Foreign Office agreed to my terms in a memorandum and proposed a separate article giving Britain the right to cancel the agreement if other treaty powers did not follow suit.

sentences.zh: 臣復力爭，不允載入專條，彼乃改用照會。

translations.literal: Your servant again struggled and would not permit it to be recorded in the special article; they then used a note instead.
translations.idiomatic: I resisted that clause and they recorded it only in an exchange of notes.

sentences.zh: 詳勘所送節略，即系商定約稿。

translations.literal: Examining in detail the summary sent, it was exactly the agreed treaty draft.
translations.idiomatic: The memorandum was in effect the agreed text.

sentences.zh: 其首段限制約束等語，緣逐年遞減之說，印度部尚書堅執不允。

translations.literal: The opening language on restriction and constraint was because the India Office minister firmly would not permit year-by-year reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Its opening language on "restriction and constraint" reflected the India Office's refusal of a fixed schedule of reductions.

sentences.zh: 其侍郎配德爾密告臣署參贊官馬格里云，照專條辦法，印度每年已減收英金七十萬餘鎊，中國欲陸續禁減洋藥入口，惟有將來陸續議加稅金，以減吸食之人，而不能與英廷豫定遞減之法。

translations.literal: The vice-minister Pauncefote privately told your servant's legation counsellor Macartney that under the special-article method India already lost more than seven hundred thousand pounds sterling annually; if China wished progressively to ban and reduce foreign-opium entry, it could only in future progressively deliberate increased tax to reduce smokers, and could not with the British court pre-fix a method of reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Under-Secretary Pauncefote told Macartney privately that the new duty already cost India over seven hundred thousand pounds a year; further cuts in imports could come only through higher taxes to discourage use, not through a treaty timetable with London.

sentences.zh: 遂未堅執固爭，而請外部于專案首段，加入於行銷洋藥之事須有限制約束一語，以聲明此次議約加稅之意，而暗伏將來修約議加之根。

translations.literal: Your servant therefore did not insist and struggle firmly, but requested the Foreign Office in the opening of the special case to add the phrase that marketing foreign opium must have restriction and constraint, to declare the intent of this tax deliberation, while covertly planting the root for future treaty revision and increases.
translations.idiomatic: I did not press the point but asked that the opening clause state that the opium trade must be "restricted and constrained," reserving leverage for future tariff increases.

sentences.zh: 至如何酌定防弊章程，設立稽徵總口，煙臺條約第三端第五節固已明定要約。

translations.literal: As for how to fix anti-abuse regulations and establish a chief collection port, the Yantai Treaty third part fifth section had already clearly fixed essential terms.
translations.idiomatic: Rules against evasion and a central collecting office were already required by section five of the Chefoo Convention's commercial articles.

sentences.zh: 臣此次所定專條第九款又復聲明前說，將來派員商定，自不難妥立章程，嚴防偷漏。

translations.literal: Your servant's ninth article of the special article this time again declared the prior statement; when staff are later dispatched to fix it, it will not be difficult properly to establish regulations and strictly guard against smuggling.
translations.idiomatic: Article nine of the new protocol repeated that pledge; detailed regulations could be worked out later to stop smuggling.

sentences.zh: 其餘各條，核與疊准總理衙門函電吻合。

translations.literal: The remaining articles, checked, matched the repeatedly approved Zongli Yamen letters and telegrams.
translations.idiomatic: The other clauses matched the Yamen's standing instructions.

sentences.zh: 旋承總署覆電照議畫押。

translations.literal: Soon the Yamen replied by telegram approving deliberation and signature.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen soon telegraphed approval to sign.

sentences.zh: 時適英外部尚書葛蘭斐爾退位，前尚書侯爵沙力斯伯里推為首相，仍兼外部。

translations.literal: It happened that the English Foreign Office minister Granville retired; the former minister Marquis Salisbury was elevated as prime minister, still concurrently Foreign Office.
translations.idiomatic: Granville had just left office; Salisbury returned as prime minister and foreign secretary.

sentences.zh: 六月三日，始據來文定期七日畫押。

translations.literal: On the third day of the sixth month, they first sent word fixing the seventh day for signature.
translations.idiomatic: On 3 June London set the signing for the seventh.

sentences.zh: 臣屆期帶同參隨等員前往外部，與沙力斯伯里將續增條約專條漢文、英文各二分，互相蓋印畫押。

translations.literal: Your servant on the appointed day brought counsellors and attendants to the Foreign Office; with Salisbury the supplementary treaty's special articles in Chinese and English, two copies each, were mutually sealed and initialed.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day I went to the Foreign Office with my staff and exchanged seals with Salisbury on two Chinese and two English copies of the supplementary articles.

sentences.zh: 按此次所訂條約，除第二條稅釐並徵數目，恪遵諭旨，議得百一十兩外，又於第五條議得洋藥於內地拆包零售，仍可抽釐，是內地並未全免稅捐。

translations.literal: According to this treaty deliberated, apart from article two's combined tax and likin figure, scrupulously following the decree and obtaining one hundred ten taels, article five also obtained that foreign opium unpacked and retailed inland might still have likin levied—thus inland areas were not wholly exempt from tax levies.
translations.idiomatic: Besides fixing the combined duty at one hundred ten taels as ordered, article five preserved likin on opium broken bulk for inland retail, so inland taxation was not wholly surrendered.

sentences.zh: 將來若于土煙加重稅釐，以期禁減，則洋藥亦可相較均算，另加稅釐。

translations.literal: If in future native opium had increased tax and likin to seek prohibition and reduction, then foreign opium might also be comparatively calculated and have tax and likin added.
translations.idiomatic: If China later raised duties on native opium to discourage use, foreign opium could be taxed proportionally.

sentences.zh: 臣於專條中並未提及土煙加稅之說，以期保我主權。」

translations.literal: Your servant in the special articles did not mention native-opium tax increase, in order to preserve our sovereign authority."
translations.idiomatic: I left native-opium duties out of the protocol to keep that lever in Chinese hands.

sentences.zh: 疏入，得旨允行。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; an edict permitted execution.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 旋兩國派員互換，是為煙臺續約。

translations.literal: Soon the two states dispatched staff to exchange; this was the Yantai supplementary treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The two governments then exchanged ratifications—the Convention Supplementary to the Chefoo Convention.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，英人議通商西藏。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, the English deliberated opening trade with Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Britain again pressed for trade with Tibet.

sentences.zh: 是歲英窺緬甸，踞其都。

translations.literal: That year the English eyed Burma and seized its capital.
translations.idiomatic: That year Britain invaded Burma and took the capital.

sentences.zh: 滇督岑毓英奏請設防，旋遣總兵丁槐率師往騰越備之。

translations.literal: Yunnan Governor Cen Yuying memorialized requesting defenses; soon he dispatched regional commander Ding Huai leading troops to Tengyue to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan governor Cen Yuying asked for defenses and sent regional commander Ding Huai to Tengyue with troops.

sentences.zh: 中國以緬甸久為我屬，電曾紀澤向英外部力爭，令存緬祀立孟氏。

translations.literal: China, because Burma had long been our dependency, telegraphed Zeng Jiyang to struggle firmly with the English Foreign Office, ordering preservation of the Burmese rites and installation of the Meng clan.
translations.idiomatic: China, treating Burma as a long-standing dependency, wired Zeng Jiyang to press London to preserve the dynasty and install a prince of the Meng family.

sentences.zh: 英外部不認緬為我籓屬，而允立孟氏支屬為緬甸教王，不得與聞政令。

translations.literal: The English Foreign Office did not acknowledge Burma as our tributary dependency, but permitted installing a Meng-clan collateral as Burma's ecclesiastical king, not permitted to participate in government orders.
translations.idiomatic: The Foreign Office denied Chinese suzerainty but offered a Meng collateral as a religious king without political power.

sentences.zh: 紀澤未允，外部尚書更易教王之說亦置諸不議矣。

translations.literal: Zeng Jiyang did not consent; when the Foreign Office minister changed, the altered proposal on the ecclesiastical king was also set aside from deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng refused; after a change of foreign secretary even the religious-king proposal lapsed.

sentences.zh: 既，英署使歐格訥以煙臺約有派員入藏之文，堅求立見施行。

translations.literal: Soon after, the English acting minister O'Conor, because the Yantai treaty had text on dispatching staff into Tibet, firmly demanded immediate implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Then chargé d'affaires O'Conor, citing the Chefoo clause on missions to Tibet, insisted it be carried out at once.

sentences.zh: 總署王大臣方以藏眾不許西人入境，力拒所請。

translations.literal: The Yamen prince-ministers were just then using Tibetans' refusal to let Westerners enter the border to refuse the request firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Yamen ministers resisted on the ground that Tibetans would not admit Westerners.

sentences.zh: 會歐格訥以緬約事自詣總署，言緬甸前與法私立盟約，是以興師問罪。

translations.literal: It happened that O'Conor on Burma-treaty affairs came in person to the Yamen, saying Burma had earlier privately made a treaty with France, and therefore troops were raised to demand satisfaction.
translations.idiomatic: O'Conor then came to the Yamen on Burma, explaining that Britain had invaded because Burma had secretly allied with France.

sentences.zh: 令若重立緬王，則法約不能作廢，故難從命。

translations.literal: If one were to re-establish the Burmese king, the French treaty could not be voided, and therefore the command was hard to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring the Burmese king, he said, would leave the Franco-Burmese treaty in force and could not be done.

sentences.zh: 今欲依緬甸舊例，每屆十年，由緬甸長官派員赴京，而勘定滇、緬邊界，設關通商，以踐前約。

translations.literal: Now wishing according to Burma's old precedent, every ten years Burma's high officials would dispatch staff to the capital, while surveying and fixing the Yunnan-Burma border and establishing customs for trade, to fulfill the prior treaty.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed instead the old decennial Burmese mission to Beijing, a Sino-Burmese boundary survey, and border trade to satisfy earlier commitments.

sentences.zh: 王大臣等以但言派員赴京，並未明言貢獻，辨爭再四，始改為呈進方物，循例舉行，而勘界、通商，則皆如所請。

translations.literal: The prince-ministers, because it only spoke of dispatching staff to the capital and did not clearly speak of tribute offerings, argued repeatedly four times before it was changed to presenting local products according to precedent, while border survey and trade were both as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers argued that "dispatching staff" was not tribute until O'Conor agreed to the usual presentation of local products; boundary and trade terms stood as he asked.

sentences.zh: 歐格訥始允停止派員入藏，藏、印通商，仍請中國體察情形，再行商議。

translations.literal: O'Conor then consented to stop dispatching staff into Tibet; Tibet-India trade still requested China to observe circumstances and deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: O'Conor then dropped the Tibet mission in return for a Chinese promise to consider Sino-Indian trade when circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 議既定，總署因與歐格訥商訂草約四條，得旨允行。

translations.literal: When deliberation was settled, the Yamen therefore with O'Conor deliberated and fixed a draft treaty of four articles, and an edict permitted execution.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen then signed a four-article draft convention with O'Conor, which the throne approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月，請英退朝鮮巨文島，不聽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twelfth year, China requested England withdraw from Korea's Komundo (Giant Stone Island); they did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, year 12, China asked Britain to leave Korea's Komundo (Giant Stone Island); Britain refused.

sentences.zh: 十月，議瓊州口岸。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Qiongzhou port openings were deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the court debated which Qiongzhou port to open.

sentences.zh: 英領事以條約有牛莊、登州、臺灣、潮州、瓊州府城口字樣，謂城與口皆口岸，中國以英約十一款雖有瓊州等府城口字樣，而煙臺續約第三端，聲明新舊各口岸，除已定有各國租界，應無庸議云云。

translations.literal: The English consul, because the treaty had Niuzhuang, Dengzhou, Taiwan, Chaozhou, and Qiongzhou prefectural-city mouth wording, said both city and mouth were treaty ports; China said that although the English treaty's eleven articles had Qiongzhou and other prefectural-city mouth wording, the Yantai supplementary treaty's third part declared that old and new treaty ports, except where various states' concessions were already fixed, needed no further deliberation, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: The consul cited treaty language on Niuzhuang, Dengzhou, Taiwan, Chaozhou, and "Qiongzhou prefectural city and port" to claim both city and harbor were open ports; China replied that the Chefoo supplementary articles had closed the question for ports where concessions already existed.

sentences.zh: 英約天津郡城海口作通商埠，紫竹林已定有各國租界，城內亦不作為口岸，以此例之，則瓊州海口系口岸，瓊州府城非口岸也。

translations.literal: The English treaty's Tianjin prefectural-city sea mouth was made a trading port; Zizhulin already had various states' concessions fixed, and the city interior was also not made a port—using this as precedent, then Qiongzhou sea mouth was the port and Qiongzhou prefectural city was not a port.
translations.idiomatic: At Tianjin only the treaty port outside the city was open while Zizhulin held the concessions and the walled city was not a port; by that precedent Qiongzhou harbor was the port, not Qiongzhou city.

sentences.zh: 十三年秋七月，與英換緬約於倫敦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn in the thirteenth year, with England the Burma treaty was exchanged in London.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, year 13, the Burma convention was exchanged in London.

sentences.zh: 十四年春，英人麻葛藟督兵入藏，藏人築卡禦之，為英屬印兵所逐。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year, the Englishman Magalei led troops into Tibet; Tibetans built barrier forts to resist and were driven off by English-subject Indian troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 14 a British officer, Magalei, advanced into Tibet; Tibetans built blockhouses but were driven back by troops of British India.

sentences.zh: 藏人旋又攻哲孟雄境之日納宗，又敗。

translations.literal: The Tibetans soon again attacked Rinag Dzong in Zhe Mengxiong territory and were again defeated.
translations.idiomatic: They then attacked Nathu La in what they held to be Sikkimese territory and were defeated again.

sentences.zh: 先是，藏地國初歸附，自英侵入印度後，藏遂與英鄰。

translations.literal: Earlier, Tibetan territory at the dynasty's founding returned to allegiance; after the English invaded India, Tibet thus bordered England.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet had submitted in the early Qing; once Britain held India, Tibet faced the Raj along its southern marches.

sentences.zh: 乾隆年，英印度總督曾通使班禪求互市，班禪謂當請諸中國，議未協而罷。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign, the English India governor-general once sent envoys to the Panchen seeking mutual trade; the Panchen said he must request China; deliberation was not harmonious and ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong the governor-general of India had asked the Panchen Lama for trade; the Lama said Beijing must decide, and talks lapsed.

sentences.zh: 哲孟雄者，藏、印間之部落也。

translations.literal: Zhe Mengxiong is a tribe between Tibet and India.
translations.idiomatic: Sikkim lay between Tibet and India.

sentences.zh: 道光間，英收為印屬。

translations.literal: In the Daoguang reign, England received it as Indian dependency.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daoguang era Britain made it a protectorate of India.

sentences.zh: 及煙臺訂約有派員入藏之說，而藏人未知，遂築砲臺於邊外之隆吐山，冀阻英兵使不得前。

translations.literal: When the Yantai treaty was concluded there was talk of dispatching staff into Tibet, but Tibetans did not know; they therefore built batteries on Lungdu Mountain beyond the border, hoping to block English troops from advancing.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans, unaware of the Chefoo clause on surveys, fortified Lungdu Ridge beyond the border to stop British advance.

sentences.zh: 英人以為言，帝諭四川總督劉秉璋，飛咨駐藏大臣文碩、幫辦大臣升泰，傳各番官嚴切宣示，迅撤卡兵。

translations.literal: The English made it a matter of complaint; the emperor decreed Sichuan Governor-General Liu Bingzhang urgently to consult the resident minister in Tibet Wen Shuo and assistant minister Sheng Tai, transmitting to each Tibetan official strict proclamation to withdraw barrier troops swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Britain protested; the emperor ordered Liu Bingzhang of Sichuan to urge the Tibetan resident Wen Shuo and assistant Sheng Tai to tell all Tibetan officials to pull back their outposts at once.

sentences.zh: 於時升泰尚未抵任，文碩未諳交涉，輒以拒英護藏覆奏。

translations.literal: At that time Sheng Tai had not yet reached his post; Wen Shuo was not versed in negotiations and promptly memorialized refusing the English to protect Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai had not yet arrived; Wen Shuo, inexperienced in diplomacy, reported that refusing the British was protecting Tibet.

sentences.zh: 於是嚴旨切責，以長庚代之。

translations.literal: Thereupon a stern edict rebuked him, and Chang Geng replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing rebuked him severely and replaced him with Chang Geng.

sentences.zh: 仍有旨催令升泰赴藏，傳齊番官，諭以：「上年與英人訂議，緩辦通商，正朝廷護持黃教、覆庇藏番，代籌一永保安全之至計。

translations.literal: There was still an edict urging Sheng Tai to proceed to Tibet, assembling Tibetan officials, instructing them: "Last year's deliberation with the English deferred trade opening; this was the court's support of the Yellow Faith, sheltering Tibetan subjects, devising on their behalf a plan to secure safety forever.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict sent Sheng Tai to Tibet to tell the chiefs: "Last year's agreement with Britain deferred border trade while the court protected the Yellow Faith and Tibetan subjects—our plan for lasting security.

sentences.zh: 但令迅速撤卡，印督已言明彼決不越藏、中定界熱勒巴拉山嶺一步。

translations.literal: Only order swift withdrawal of barrier forts; the Indian governor has already stated clearly he will not cross one step beyond the boundary ridge fixed between Tibet and China at Relabara Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Withdraw the outposts at once. The viceroy of India has pledged not to cross the Relabara ridge, the border between Tibet and China.

sentences.zh: 彼此未經開戰，無論此地屬藏屬哲，將來尚可從容辨論。」

translations.literal: Neither side had yet opened battle; regardless whether this place belonged to Tibet or to Zhe, in future one might still debate at leisure."
translations.idiomatic: No fighting had yet begun; whether the ground was Tibetan or Sikkimese could still be argued later."

sentences.zh: 時十四年正月也。

translations.literal: The time was the first month of the fourteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: This was in the first month, year 14.

sentences.zh: 寄諭未至，英兵已進攻隆吐，毀其壘，藏番悉潰。

translations.literal: Before the forwarded decree arrived, English troops had already attacked Lungdu and destroyed its fortifications; Tibetan subjects all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Before the order reached Tibet, British forces stormed Lungdu, destroyed the works, and the Tibetan troops scattered.

sentences.zh: 乃欲藉通商以緩師，文碩復左右之，竟以藏人與英自行立約入奏。

translations.literal: They then wished to use trade opening to slow the army; Wen Shuo again swayed them, and in the end Tibetans with the English on their own established a treaty and memorialized it.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shuo then urged using trade talks to slow the advance and allowed Tibetans to make a separate agreement with Britain and report it to court.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，諭曰：「印、藏通商一事，英人約定並不催辦。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the fourth month, an edict stated: "The matter of India-Tibet trade—the English had agreed not to press it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the fourth month an edict declared: "India-Tibet trade was not to be pressed by Britain.

sentences.zh: 此次開釁，與通商絕無干涉。

translations.literal: This opening of hostilities had absolutely no connection with trade.
translations.idiomatic: This fighting had nothing to do with trade.

sentences.zh: 文碩始終不明機要，乃欲藉通商為轉圜，不思藏為中國屬地，豈有聽其自行與人立約之理！

translations.literal: Wen Shuo from beginning to end did not understand essentials, yet wished to use trade as a turning point, not reflecting that Tibet is China's dependency—how could there be reason to hear them make treaties with others on their own!
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shuo never grasped the stakes yet tried to trade concessions for peace, forgetting that Tibet is Chinese territory and cannot treaty with foreigners on its own.

sentences.zh: 升泰、文碩接奉此旨，即傳集番官，諭以事須稟明駐藏大臣具奏，由總理衙門核定，候旨遵辦。」

translations.literal: Sheng Tai and Wen Shuo, receiving this edict, at once assembled Tibetan officials and instructed them that matters must be reported to the resident minister in Tibet for memorial, fixed by the Zongli Yamen, and carried out awaiting the decree."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai and Wen Shuo were to tell the chiefs that any agreement must go through the resident minister and the Yamen for imperial approval."

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，又諭曰：「使英大臣劉瑞芬電稱，『印督近又函達藏官，但令藏眾退回原界，便可仍舊和好，絕不欲侵入藏地，致礙兩國睦誼。』

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the fifth month, another edict stated: "Envoy minister Liu Ruifen telegraphed saying, 'The Indian governor has again written the Tibetan officials that if Tibetan masses return to the original border, friendship may still be as before, and he absolutely does not wish to invade Tibetan territory and harm the two states' cordial relations.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the fifth month another edict cited Minister Liu Ruifen's telegram: "The viceroy of India writes again that if Tibetans withdraw to their former line, relations may be restored and he has no wish to invade Tibet or disturb friendship between our countries.

sentences.zh: 向來藏務專歸商上，第穆呼圖克圖人尚和平曉事，現在掌辦商上，責有專歸。

translations.literal: Tibetan affairs have always belonged to the council of regents; the ninth Pakpa Hutuktu's people are still peaceful and understand affairs; now managing the council, responsibility has a dedicated locus.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan affairs have always rested with the council of regents; the Ninth Pakpa Hutuktu's faction is moderate and capable, and now holds the council—the duty is theirs alone.

sentences.zh: 升泰接奉此旨，即傳諭第穆，令其妥為了結。」

translations.literal: Sheng Tai, upon receiving this decree, at once transmitted instructions to Demu, ordering him to bring the matter to a proper conclusion."
translations.idiomatic: On receiving the decree, Sheng Tai instructed Demu to settle the affair properly."

sentences.zh: 未幾，升泰抵任受事。

translations.literal: Before long, Sheng Tai arrived at his post and assumed his duties.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Sheng Tai reached his post and took up his duties.

sentences.zh: 九月，奏言：「藏番自作不靖，肇起兵戈。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, he memorialized, stating: "The Tibetan tribes brought unrest upon themselves and started armed conflict.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he memorialized: "The Tibetans courted unrest and opened hostilities.

sentences.zh: 所有隆吐山南北本皆哲孟雄地，英人雖視為保護境內，實則哲孟雄、布魯克巴皆西藏屬籓，每屆年終，兩部長必與駐藏大臣呈遞賀稟，駐藏大臣循例優加賞犒。

translations.literal: All territory north and south of Lungdu Mountain was originally Dremojong land; though the English regard it as within their protectorate, in fact Dremojong and Bulukeba are both Tibetan dependencies; at each year's end the chiefs of both departments must jointly present congratulatory memorials to the resident minister in Tibet, who according to precedent bestows superior rewards and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: All the country north and south of Lungdu Ridge had always been Sikkimese. Britain counted it within the protectorate, yet Sikkim and Bhutan were dependencies of Tibet: at year's end both chiefs presented New Year memorials to the resident minister, who by custom granted them rewards.

sentences.zh: 唐古特自達賴喇嘛以下，均有額定禮物，商上亦回賞緞疋銀茶，與兩部復書草稿，必呈送駐藏大臣批准，始行繕覆。

translations.literal: From the Dalai Lama downward, all Tanguts had fixed gifts; the council of regents also returned rewards of silk, silver, and tea, and drafts of replies to both departments—all had to be submitted to the resident minister in Tibet for approval before fair copies could be written and sent.
translations.idiomatic: From the Dalai Lama down, Tibetans owed fixed gifts; the regency returned silk, silver, and tea, and draft replies to both states had to be approved by the resident minister before letters could be sent.

sentences.zh: 哲、布兩部遇有爭訟，亦稟由藏官酌派漢、番官辦理，此哲、布本為藏地屬籓之實在情形也。

translations.literal: When the Zhe and Bu two departments had disputes, they also reported them for Tibetan officials to assign Chinese and Tibetan officers to handle; this is the actual condition of Zhe and Bu as dependencies of Tibetan territory.
translations.idiomatic: Disputes between Sikkim and Bhutan were referred to Lhasa, which sent Chinese and Tibetan officers to adjudicate—proof that both were Tibetan dependencies in practice.

sentences.zh: 兩部長於光緒二年曾各遞番字稟，以英人有窺伺藏地之心，請早為設法辦理。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu the chiefs of both departments had each submitted Tibetan-script memorials, stating that the English harbored designs on Tibetan territory and asking that measures be devised and carried out early.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 both chiefs had petitioned in Tibetan script that Britain eyed Tibetan soil and begged Beijing to act in time.

sentences.zh: 雖經前西藏糧員四望關通判周溱帶同戴琫劄喜達結往辦，祗取哲孟雄空結一紙，敷衍了事，並不妥籌善後，貽悮邊疆，其禍實自此始。

translations.literal: Although the former Tibet grain officer, Siwang Pass subprefect Zhou Qin, took Dai Biong and the lama Chidaje to handle it, they only obtained an empty undertaking from Dremojong on paper, disposed of the matter perfunctorily, and did not properly plan for aftermath—erring on the frontier; the calamity truly began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Qin of Siwang Pass and Dai Biong had been sent with the lama Chidaje to negotiate, but secured only a hollow pledge from Sikkim, closed the file, and planned no follow-up—an error on the frontier from which the later trouble sprang.

sentences.zh: 嗣後哲夷知藏番並無遠慮，始一意與英人交接，又復貪利取租，聽英人修路直至撚納，迄今仍稱租界，又藏中自失籓籬之始末也。

translations.literal: Afterward the Zhe tribesmen, knowing the Tibetan tribes had no far-sighted plan, began to deal with the English exclusively, again greedily taking rent, allowing the English to build roads as far as Nianna—still called a leased district to this day; this too is the beginning and end of Tibet's losing its frontier screen.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Tibet's shortsightedness, the Sikkimese then dealt chiefly with Britain, leased land for roads as far as Nianna—still called a concession—and Tibet thereby lost its buffer.

sentences.zh: 藏人不知優待屬籓，哲部偶受欺淩，不為申理，此時漸覺英人有偪己之心，忽又攘奪哲地以為己有，更揚言哲夷私結英人，屢議起兵攻伐，哲夷內不自安，則益句結英人以圖自保，此又藏、印交兵之所由來也。

translations.literal: The Tibetans did not know how to treat dependencies well; when the Zhe department was occasionally bullied they did not seek redress; at this time they gradually sensed the English had a mind to press them; suddenly they again seized Zhe territory as their own and further spread word that the Zhe tribes privately allied with the English and repeatedly discussed raising troops to attack; the Zhe tribes were inwardly uneasy and then all the more colluded with the English to seek self-preservation—this too is whence Tibetan-Indian fighting arose.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet failed to protect its dependencies: when Sikkim was bullied Lhasa did nothing, then seized Sikkimese land and accused the Sikkimese of siding with Britain—driving them closer to India and into war with Tibet.

sentences.zh: 藏人自四月十三日戰敗之後，不思設法弭患，又復添調各路土兵，分由小道至派克里，沿途騷擾，良民大受荼毒。

translations.literal: After the Tibetans' defeat on the thirteenth day of the fourth month, they did not think to devise means to quell trouble but again added local troops from all routes, dividing by bypaths to reach Phari, along the way harassing—the good people greatly suffered.
translations.idiomatic: After their defeat on the thirteenth of the fourth month Tibetans made no peace but poured levies along hill paths toward Phari, plundering civilians along the way.

sentences.zh: 番官管餉，又多減刻，人有怨言，軍無鬥志。

translations.literal: Tibetan officers managing supplies also greatly reduced and carved off rations; men had complaints, armies had no fighting will.
translations.idiomatic: Supply officers skimped on rations; the men grumbled and would not fight.

sentences.zh: 除向隸戴琫之兵三千，及工布兵數百人，差可用命，餘則悉系烏合。

translations.literal: Apart from three thousand troops under Dai Biong and several hundred Gongbu troops, which could somewhat obey orders, the rest were entirely rabble.
translations.idiomatic: Only Dai Biong's three thousand men and a few hundred from Gongbu were reliable; the rest were a mob.

sentences.zh: 現劄帕隘以外者一萬餘人，分佈各口又數千人，一旦敗北譁潰，則數千里臺站伏莽增多，此內患之堪虞者也。

translations.literal: At present beyond Zhapa Pass there are more than ten thousand men, distributed at each pass several thousand more; once defeated and routed in uproar, then for several thousand li of courier stations hidden dangers would multiply—this is the internal trouble to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten thousand men lay beyond Zhapa Pass with thousands more at each gap; a rout would turn the thousand-li of courier lines into bandit country—an internal peril.

sentences.zh: 近時開導之難，實因曩時初與外人交涉，商上辦事諸員邀三大寺僧眾，以護教為名，共立誓詞，云『藏地男女不原與洋人共生於天地，此後藏中男女老弱有違此誓，即有背黃教，人人得而誅之』。

translations.literal: The difficulty of guidance at present truly stems from when they first dealt with outsiders: council staff invited the great three monasteries' clergy, in the name of protecting the faith, jointly to swear an oath, saying, "Men and women of Tibet do not wish to live under heaven with foreigners; hereafter any man, woman, old or young in Tibet who violates this oath has betrayed the Yellow Teaching—everyone may kill them."
translations.idiomatic: Persuasion failed because, at first contact with foreigners, the regency and the three great monasteries had sworn that no Tibetan man or woman would live with aliens on earth, and that whoever broke the oath betrayed the Yellow Hat faith and might be killed.

sentences.zh: 此本不肖之徒，為聚眾抗官之謀，三大寺僧眾亦藉此干預政事。

translations.literal: This was originally unworthy persons' scheme to gather crowds to resist officials; the great three monasteries' clergy also used this to intervene in government.
translations.idiomatic: Wicked men had framed the oath to rally resistance to the throne; the great monasteries used it to meddle in affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 今事機危迫，特旨到藏，第穆亦知凜畏。

translations.literal: Now the situation is critically urgent; a special decree has reached Tibet, and Demu also knows awe.
translations.idiomatic: The crisis was acute and an imperial decree had reached Lhasa; even Demu was frightened.

sentences.zh: 無如遽違初議，即禍在目前，雖掌辦商務之尊，恐亦不免自危，其噶布倫以次更不待言。

translations.literal: Yet to abruptly violate the initial agreement brings disaster immediately; even the exalted ones in charge of commerce probably cannot escape endangering themselves, to say nothing of the kalöns and those below.
translations.idiomatic: To break the original oath at once was to court death; even the trade ministers would be at risk, let alone the kalöns below them.

sentences.zh: 窺其情形，似非背城一戰，難望轉機。

translations.literal: Observing their condition, it seems unless they fight a last-ditch battle, one cannot hope for a turn.
translations.idiomatic: They seemed to think only a desperate stand could change their fate.

sentences.zh: 此臣探其隱衷而言，非藏番等自有此語也。

translations.literal: This is what your minister probes of their hidden feelings in speaking—not that the Tibetan tribes themselves had such words.
translations.idiomatic: This was my reading of their private mind, not words the Tibetans themselves had used.

sentences.zh: 此時兵尚未撤，委員不便前往。

translations.literal: At this time troops have not yet been withdrawn, and commissioners cannot conveniently go.
translations.idiomatic: Troops had not yet withdrawn, so commissioners could not safely proceed.

sentences.zh: 且委員至彼辦理界務，應與英國何人會議，應請飭詢英使，由總署知照藏中，庶免隔閡。

translations.literal: Moreover, when commissioners reach there to handle boundary affairs, with whom in Britain should they confer? It should be ordered to inquire of the British minister, and the Yamen should notify Tibet—then one may avoid estrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Boundary talks required knowing which British officer would meet them; I asked that the minister in Beijing be consulted and the Yamen inform Tibet, lest we work at cross purposes.

sentences.zh: 近年藏番異常刁悍，今自開兵釁，尚不自知悔悟，實難姑容。
