translations.literal: In recent years Tibetan tribes have been exceptionally fierce and violent; now that they have opened fighting on their own and still do not know repentance, it is truly hard to indulge them.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans had grown unusually truculent; having started war and shown no repentance, indulgence was hard to justify.

sentences.zh: 第藏衛距川過遠，餉絀兵單，無事不形掣肘。

translations.literal: Yet the Tibetan guard is too far from Sichuan, funds short and troops few—nothing is not a hindrance.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tibet was far from Sichuan, short of pay and men—everything was a constraint.

sentences.zh: 臣萬不敢不出之審慎，籌慮萬全，相機駕馭，冀紓朝廷西顧之憂。」

translations.literal: Your minister absolutely dares not proceed without careful deliberation, planning for complete security, steering according to circumstances, hoping to ease the court's western anxieties."
translations.idiomatic: I dared act only with utmost care, hoping to ease the court's anxieties for the western marches."

sentences.zh: 是月丁卯，又奏：「臣於五月二十六日抵藏，第穆與大小番官僧俗公同遞稟，譯其情詞，總以隆吐之南日納宗為藏界，藏人設卡系在境內，英人無端恃強動兵侵地為言。

translations.literal: That month on the dingmao day, he again memorialized: "Your minister on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month reached Tibet; Demu together with great and small Tibetan officials, clergy and laity, jointly submitted a memorial; translating their words, they altogether take Nathu Dzong south of Lungdu as the Tibetan border, Tibetan barrier posts as within the territory, and the English as without cause relying on strength to move troops and invade land.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of that month he memorialized again: "I reached Tibet on the twenty-sixth of the fifth month. Demu and Tibetan officials, clergy, and laity jointly petitioned that the border lay at Nathu La south of Lungdu, that their outposts were within Tibet, and that Britain had attacked without cause.

sentences.zh: 臣以經界為地方要政，從前豈無案牘。

translations.literal: Your minister, considering that boundaries are a locality's essential policy—were there not documents from before?
translations.idiomatic: Boundaries are vital to any province—surely there were old records.

sentences.zh: 乃派員將新舊各案卷概行檢閱，始尋出乾隆五十九年前大臣尚書和琳、內閣學士和瑛任內奏設鄂博原案一卷，注明藏內界址，系在距派克里三站之雅拉、支木兩山，設有鄂博。

translations.literal: He then dispatched staff to examine all old and new case files comprehensively, and at last found one original file on setting up obo boundary markers before Qianlong fifty-nine, when Grand Minister Helin and Academician He Ying served, noting Tibetan interior boundaries at the Yala and Zhimu mountains three stages from Phari, where obo were set up.
translations.idiomatic: Staff searched the archives and found a Qianlong-era file by Helin and He Ying placing Tibet's inner border at the Yala and Zhimu ranges three stages from Phari, marked by obo cairns.

sentences.zh: 又有春丕、日納宗兩處，上年雖系藏界，乾隆五十三年廓番用兵，哲孟雄被廓夷追過藏曲大河，哲部窮蹙，達賴喇嘛始將日納宗地賞給哲部筦理，原派委員西藏遊擊張志林原稟，即聲敘日納宗不應作為藏界，只在雅拉、支木兩山設立鄂博，稟詞甚為明晰。

translations.literal: There were also Chumbi and Nathu Dzong two places; though last year they were Tibetan border, in Qianlong fifty-three when Gurkha troops were used, Dremojong was pursued by Gurkha tribes across the Zangchu River; the Zhe department was cornered, and the Dalai Lama then bestowed Nathu Dzong territory for the Zhe department to administer; the originally dispatched commissioner, Tibet garrison commander Zhang Zhilin's original memorial, clearly stated Nathu Dzong should not be treated as Tibetan border but obo should be set only at Yala and Zhimu mountains—the memorial wording was very clear.
translations.idiomatic: Chumbi and Nathu La had lain on the Tibetan side, but in Qianlong 53, when Nepal invaded, Sikkim was driven beyond the Zangchu; the Dalai Lama then granted Nathu La to Sikkim. Commissioner Zhang Zhilin had reported clearly that Nathu La was not Tibet's border and that markers should stand only on Yala and Zhimu.

sentences.zh: 此圖惜已佚，又覓得舊圖一張，並注明納蕩一地乃哲孟雄邊境，藏圖南面極邊界線之上亦繪有雅拉山，是雅拉山確屬藏地南界。

translations.literal: This map unfortunately is lost; another old map was found, also noting Nathang as Dremojong border; on the southern extreme border line of the Tibetan map Yala Mountain is also drawn—thus Yala Mountain truly belongs to Tibet's southern border.
translations.idiomatic: That map is lost, but another old chart marks Nathang as Sikkimese frontier and draws Yala Peak on Tibet's southern line—proof that Yala was Tibet's southern limit.

sentences.zh: 至藏人設卡之隆吐山，考之舊圖，實無此名，以英人所云日納宗在隆吐北數十里，而藏番新圖則日納宗又在隆吐之南，顯系藏人多繪此一段，飾稱藏界。

translations.literal: As for Lungdu Mountain where Tibetans set barrier posts, checking old maps, this name truly does not exist; the English say Nathu Dzong is several tens of li north of Lungdu, while the Tibetan new map places Nathu Dzong again south of Lungdu—clearly Tibetans added this segment to adorn and call it Tibetan border.
translations.idiomatic: Lungdu Ridge, where Tibetans had built posts, does not appear on old maps. Britain placed Nathu La north of Lungdu; Tibet's new map drew it to the south—an invented stretch of "Tibetan" border.

sentences.zh: 臣既考察明確，即以原卷舊圖發交開導委員，轉給藏番閱看。

translations.literal: Your minister, having investigated clearly, at once handed the original roll and old map to guidance commissioners to pass to Tibetan tribes for reading.
translations.idiomatic: I gave the original dossier and old map to my commissioners for the Tibetans to read.

sentences.zh: 番人雖有愧色，然終以日納宗本屬藏地，從前雖賞給哲夷，今哲夷已歸英屬，應即收回自筦。

translations.literal: The tribesmen though had ashamed expressions, yet ultimately held that Nathu Dzong originally belonged to Tibetan territory; though formerly bestowed on the Zhe tribes, now the Zhe tribes have returned to English dependency and it should at once be recovered for self-administration.
translations.idiomatic: They looked ashamed yet insisted Nathu La was Tibetan soil: though once granted to Sikkim, Sikkim was now under Britain and the tract should revert to Lhasa.

sentences.zh: 旋奉電傳寄諭，臣即面授第穆。

translations.literal: Shortly he received a telegraphed imperial message by relay; your minister at once instructed Demu face to face.
translations.idiomatic: A telegraphed decree arrived and I instructed Demu in person.

sentences.zh: 臣深慮第穆使將屯兵先行撤入派克里，並劄飭哲、布兩部長親赴英軍，告以藏人畏偪，故兵難先撤，印兵亦宜克踐前言，彼此約期同日撤退，仍由臣致信英官，促其速撤。

translations.literal: Your minister deeply feared Demu would have garrison troops first withdraw into Phari, and also ordered the Zhe and Bu chiefs in person to go to the English army, telling them Tibetans fear pressure, hence troops cannot withdraw first; Indian troops also ought to honor prior words—both sides to agree a date for same-day withdrawal; still your minister would write the English officer urging swift withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: I urged Demu to pull troops back to Phari and sent Sikkimese and Bhutanese chiefs to the British camp to explain that Tibet could not withdraw first while under pressure, but that Indian troops should keep their word and both sides retire on the same day; I would also write the British officer to hurry the withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 忽又得報，英人於六月二十八日添兵九百餘名，又益以大砲六門。

translations.literal: Suddenly came report that on the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month the English added more than nine hundred troops, and further six large cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Word then came that on the twenty-eighth of the sixth month Britain had sent nine hundred more men and six heavy guns.

sentences.zh: 第穆旋亦稟英人屢次攻撲我營。

translations.literal: Demu soon also reported the English repeatedly attacked and stormed our camps.
translations.idiomatic: Demu reported that British forces were repeatedly assaulting our camps.

sentences.zh: 且廓爾喀前王子果爾雜撚曾出奔印度，今亦由印帶兵五百名前來助戰，聞已過大吉嶺，是以未敢撤兵。

translations.literal: Moreover the former Nepalese prince Gorzanian had fled to India; now he too leads five hundred troops from India to assist in fighting; heard he has passed Darjeeling—therefore troops were not dared withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The exiled Nepalese prince Gorzanian was also marching five hundred men from India to help Britain and was said to have passed Darjeeling—so we dared not withdraw.

sentences.zh: 伏乞飭下總署詳告英使，轉電印督，約期撤兵，並飭印兵毋得再動。」

translations.literal: Prostrate begging that the Yamen be ordered to inform the British minister in detail, telegraph the Indian governor, agree a date to withdraw troops, and order Indian troops not to move again."
translations.idiomatic: I begged the Yamen to tell the British minister, telegraph the viceroy to fix a withdrawal date, and forbid further Indian attacks."

sentences.zh: 疏入，奉上諭：「升泰所陳，頗中肯綮。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, an imperial rescript was bestowed: "What Sheng Tai stated hits the vital point.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: "Sheng Tai's analysis goes to the heart of the matter.

sentences.zh: 劉瑞芬八月二十八日電稱：『印兵在熱勒巴拉山近處與藏兵攻戰，藏兵傷亡數百，印兵追入徵畢山岔。』

translations.literal: Liu Ruifen on the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month telegraphed: 'Indian troops near Rela Bara Mountain fought Tibetan troops; Tibetan casualties several hundred; Indian troops pursued into Zhengbi mountain pass.'
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ruifen telegraphed on the twenty-eighth of the eighth month that near Jelep La Indian and Tibetan troops had fought, with hundreds of Tibetan casualties, and that Indian forces had pursued into the Zhengbi defile.

sentences.zh: 九月十五日電稱：『英外部照覆，云來攻納蕩之英軍統領拉哈瑪，已遵印度政府之諭，不可佔據藏地，故追入徵畢後，立即退回。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the ninth month telegraphed: 'The English Foreign Office replied in a note, saying the commander Rahama who came to attack Nathang, obeying the Indian government's order, must not occupy Tibetan territory; therefore after pursuing into Zhengbi he at once withdrew.'
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth of the ninth month he reported that the Foreign Office had replied that General Graham, who attacked Nathang, obeyed India's order not to hold Tibetan soil and withdrew as soon as he entered Zhengbi.

sentences.zh: 印督又報告其政府，謂駐藏大臣將以西曆十月三日由拉薩前赴邊界，已派政事官保爾前往會晤。』

translations.literal: The Indian governor again reported to his government that the resident minister in Tibet would proceed from Lhasa to the border on the third of October by the Western calendar; he had dispatched political officer Paul to go meet.'
translations.idiomatic: The viceroy also reported that the resident minister would leave Lhasa for the frontier on 3 October and had sent Political Officer Paul to meet him.

sentences.zh: 目前升泰想已接晤保爾。

translations.literal: At present Sheng Tai presumably has already met Paul.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai has presumably met Paul by now.

sentences.zh: 藏、哲界址當已查明，印督又有『甚望速了』之語。

translations.literal: The Tibetan-Zhe boundary should already be clarified; the Indian governor also had words 'greatly hoping for swift settlement.'
translations.idiomatic: The Tibet-Sikkim line should be settled; the viceroy had also said he wished a quick end.

sentences.zh: 著即熟商妥辦。」

translations.literal: Order at once to deliberate maturely and settle properly."
translations.idiomatic: Deliberate carefully and conclude the affair."

sentences.zh: 升泰先使江孜守備蕭佔先馳往開導，又以知縣秀廕繼之。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai first sent Gyangzê garrison commander Xiao Zhanxian in haste to guide; then sent magistrate Xiuyin to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai first sent Xiao Zhanxian, garrison commander at Gyangzê, to reason with them, then the magistrate Xiuyin.

sentences.zh: 藏兵之敗也，英兵追至仁進岡，將盡焚山上下民舍。

translations.literal: When Tibetan troops were defeated, English troops pursued to Renjing Ridge and were about to burn all dwellings above and below the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tibetan defeat British troops pursued to Renjing Ridge and were about to burn every house on the slope.

sentences.zh: 會佔先至，見英將力爭，乃退屯對邦，而促升泰前往會議。

translations.literal: It happened Zhanxian arrived, saw the English general and argued forcefully; they then withdrew to camp at Doklam and urged Sheng Tai to go confer.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanxian arrived, argued with the British commander, and induced them to fall back to Doklam while pressing Sheng Tai to come to talks.

sentences.zh: 數日，復進據姑布。

translations.literal: Several days later, they again advanced and occupied Gubu.
translations.idiomatic: Days later they advanced again and occupied Gubu.

sentences.zh: 升泰十一月至，與英員保爾相見於對邦，議經月未就。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai arrived in the eleventh month and met English officer Paul at Doklam; deliberation for a month did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai came in the eleventh month and met Paul at Doklam; a month of talks failed.

sentences.zh: 乃奏言：「英人戰勝而驕，必欲諸事議妥始允撤兵。

translations.literal: He then memorialized: "The English, victorious and arrogant, must have all matters agreed before they will allow troop withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that Britain, flush with victory, would not withdraw until every point was settled.

sentences.zh: 現議哲孟雄事不下十次，保爾必欲將哲為英屬，註明條約，而畫咱利拉山為界，即歷次奏牘所謂熱勒巴拉山也。

translations.literal: Now deliberating Dremojong affairs no fewer than ten times, Paul must have Zhe as English dependency written in the treaty, and draw Jelep La as border—that is the Rela Bara Mountain of successive memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Sikkim alone was debated ten times: Paul demanded treaty language making it British territory and a border on Jelep La—the Rela Bara of earlier memorials.

sentences.zh: 臣議以印督前言『藏眾退回原界，仍守二年以前情形，不在隆吐山駐兵，便可照舊辦理，絕不侵入藏界』等語折之，保爾則謂此語當在未開戰前，戰釁既開，自當另議。

translations.literal: Your minister argued with the Indian governor's prior words, 'Tibetan masses return to original border, still keep conditions of two years before, not station troops at Lungdu Mountain, then may handle as before, absolutely not invade Tibetan border'—Paul then said these words should apply before fighting opened; once fighting was opened, naturally another deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: I cited the viceroy's pledge that if Tibetans returned to their old line and left Lungdu unmanned, matters could proceed as before and India would not cross into Tibet; Paul said that applied only before war—after hostilities, terms must change.

sentences.zh: 通商一事，英人開來條款，直欲到藏貿易。

translations.literal: On trade, the English presented articles straight wishing to trade in Tibet itself.
translations.idiomatic: On trade, Britain's draft articles aimed at commerce inside Tibet.

sentences.zh: 臣百端辨說，始允退至江孜。

translations.literal: Your minister argued in a hundred ways before they agreed to fall back to Gyangzê.
translations.idiomatic: After long argument they agreed to limit trade to Gyangzê.

sentences.zh: 又答以萬不能行，則又意在派克哩。

translations.literal: Answering again that it absolutely could not be done, they then also had mind toward Phari.
translations.idiomatic: When I refused that too, they turned to Phari.

sentences.zh: 帕隘乃藏南門戶，其險要在山腰之格林卡，若至派克哩，則已在高原，為廓爾喀、哲孟雄、布魯克巴三部通衢。

translations.literal: Phari Pass is Tibet's southern gateway; its strategic point lies at Glingka on the mountainside; if reaching Phari Dre, one is already on the plateau, the thoroughfare of Gurkha, Dremojong, and Bulukeba three departments.
translations.idiomatic: Phari was Tibet's southern gate; the choke point was Glingka on the slope. Phari Dre lay on the plateau where Nepal, Sikkim, and Bhutan met.

sentences.zh: 目前開導藏番，通商必在界外，始可期其遵從。

translations.literal: At present guiding Tibetan tribes, trade must be outside the border before one can expect their compliance.
translations.idiomatic: To win Tibetan consent, trade had to lie beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 是以臣堅未允許，保爾意甚怫然。

translations.literal: Therefore your minister firmly did not permit; Paul was very displeased in mind.
translations.idiomatic: I stood firm; Paul was openly angry.

sentences.zh: 臣惟有平心靜氣，婉與商榷，冀紓目前之急。」

translations.literal: Your minister has only to keep a calm heart and gently discuss, hoping to ease present urgency."
translations.idiomatic: I could only negotiate calmly, hoping to relieve the immediate crisis."

sentences.zh: 是年英定華工往澳大利亞例限。

translations.literal: That year England fixed regulations limiting Chinese laborers going to Australia.
translations.idiomatic: That year Britain set limits on Chinese labor emigration to Australia.

sentences.zh: 英君主維多利亞登位五十年，中國遣使致賀。

translations.literal: The English sovereign Victoria's fiftieth year on the throne; China dispatched envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Queen Victoria's Golden Jubilee was marked by a Chinese mission of congratulation.

sentences.zh: 十五年，升泰復與英人接議通商、分界，久不決。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Sheng Tai again joined the English in discussing trade and boundaries, long unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 Sheng Tai reopened talks on trade and boundaries, still without result.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月，朝旨派總稅務司赫德之弟赫政赴藏協商藏、印約事。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixteenth year, a court decree dispatched Inspector General of Customs Hart's younger brother Hart to Tibet to assist in negotiating Tibetan-Indian treaty affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 16 the court sent James Hart, brother of Inspector General Robert Hart, to Tibet to help negotiate the Tibet-India settlement.

sentences.zh: 升泰奏言：「撤兵藏番已原遵旨，所難者分界、通商兩大端耳。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai memorialized: "Troop withdrawal—the Tibetan tribes have already agreed to obey the decree; what is difficult are the two great points of boundary and trade.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai reported that Tibetans would obey orders on withdrawal, but boundary and trade remained the hard questions.

sentences.zh: 臣自到邊，哲部長之母率其親族頭目來營具稟，云：『英人昔年立約，曾經議明，無論如何不得逾日喜曲河一步。

translations.literal: Since your minister reached the border, the Zhe chief's mother led her kinsmen and headmen to camp to submit a memorial, saying: 'Years ago when the English made a treaty, it was already agreed that in no case might they cross one step beyond the Rishi Chu River.
translations.idiomatic: At the frontier the Sikkimese chief's mother came with kinsmen and headmen to petition: "When Britain first treated with us, we agreed they must not cross the Rishi Chu by a single step.

sentences.zh: 哲部租地與英，每年應收租費洋銀十二千圓，英人分毫未給。

translations.literal: The Zhe department leased land to the English; each year rent of twelve thousand foreign silver dollars should be received; the English have not given a fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Sikkim leased land to Britain for twelve thousand dollars a year, yet not a cent had been paid.

sentences.zh: 此次印、藏構兵，以致殃及，實不原再歸英屬。』

translations.literal: This time Indian-Tibetan fighting caused harm reaching them; they truly do not wish again to return to English dependency.'
translations.idiomatic: This war has ruined us; we will not again be British subjects."

sentences.zh: 臣維哲孟雄本屬小邦，僻在極邊。

translations.literal: Your minister reflects: Dremojong originally is a small state, remote at the extreme border.
translations.idiomatic: Sikkim is a small, remote state.

sentences.zh: 本年印、藏用兵，被英人掠取全土，復遷其部長，安置印度噶倫繃之地，而以重兵駐守扛多，即部長平時治所也。

translations.literal: This year Indian-Tibetan troops were used; the English plundered the whole territory, again moved its chief, settling him at Kalimpong in India, and stationed heavy troops at Gangduo—that is the chief's usual seat of government.
translations.idiomatic: This year's fighting let Britain seize the whole country, move the raja to Kalimpong, and garrison Gangtok, his former capital.

sentences.zh: 流離轉徙，情實可矜。

translations.literal: Wandering and displaced—the situation truly merits pity.
translations.idiomatic: Dispossessed and exiled, their plight deserved pity.

sentences.zh: 是以此次會議，但許其保護，而必爭『照舊』兩字，使藏人不至咎臣辦理邊事失去屬籓，並可藉此羈縻布魯克巴。

translations.literal: Therefore at this conference, only protection was permitted them, yet one must contend for the two words 'as before,' so Tibetans would not blame your minister for handling border affairs and losing dependencies, and one could also use this to tether Bulukeba.
translations.idiomatic: At the talks I could grant only protection, but had to insist on the phrase "as before," lest Tibet accuse me of losing a dependency and to keep Bhutan in hand.

sentences.zh: 至布魯克巴，地大物博，民俗強悍，其地數倍哲孟雄，實為前藏遮罩，西人呼為布丹國。

translations.literal: As for Bulukeba, the land is large and resources abundant, customs fierce and strong; its territory several times Dremojong, truly the screen before front Tibet; Westerners call it the Bhutan state.
translations.idiomatic: Bhutan is larger, richer, and warlike—several times Sikkim's size and Tibet's shield to the south; Westerners call it Bhutan.

sentences.zh: 上年曾經入貢，其部長向無印信，亦無封號。

translations.literal: Last year it had already presented tribute; its chief had never had seals or titles.
translations.idiomatic: It had sent tribute last year, though its chief held no seal or title.

sentences.zh: 臣此次到邊，其部長派兵千七百人來營效力。

translations.literal: When your minister reached the border this time, its chief sent seventeen hundred troops to camp to serve with effort.
translations.idiomatic: When I arrived its chief sent seventeen hundred men to serve in camp.

sentences.zh: 臣方飭藏兵遣撤，豈可留此多人，致貽口實？

translations.literal: Your minister was just ordering Tibetan troops dispatched withdrawn—how could one keep so many men and give cause for talk?
translations.idiomatic: I was disbanding Tibetan levies and could not keep so large a foreign force on the field.

sentences.zh: 是以優給賞賚，勉以大義，飭令速回，許事後為之代懇天恩。

translations.literal: Therefore superior rewards and gifts were bestowed, they were exhorted with great principle, ordered to return swiftly, and promised afterward to plead heaven's grace on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: I rewarded them, urged duty, sent them home, and promised to seek imperial favor later.

sentences.zh: 該部人歡忻鼓舞而去。」

translations.literal: That department's people went away rejoicing and exulting."
translations.idiomatic: They left rejoicing."

sentences.zh: 赫政既抵藏，升泰與英官開議，保爾雖奉命印督為議約專員，然不得自主，事事仍請命印督。

translations.literal: After Hart reached Tibet, Sheng Tai opened discussions with English officers; though Paul was ordered by the Indian governor as treaty commissioner, he could not act independently—on every matter he still requested orders from the Indian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Once James Hart arrived, Sheng Tai resumed talks with Paul, who was India's commissioner but could decide nothing without Calcutta.

sentences.zh: 藏番不原與英接壤，必間哲孟雄於中，乃可定界。

translations.literal: Tibetan tribes do not wish to border the English; Dremojong must stand between before the boundary can be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans refused a frontier with Britain and demanded Sikkim stand between.

sentences.zh: 英既幽哲酋於噶倫繃，直欲收入印度幅員之內，藏人聞之益憤。

translations.literal: The English, having confined the Zhe chief at Kalimpong, straight wished to absorb him into India's territory; hearing this, Tibetans were all the more angry.
translations.idiomatic: Britain had interned the Sikkimese raja at Kalimpong and aimed to annex his state, which inflamed Tibetan opinion.

sentences.zh: 升泰嚴飭番官僧俗毋率行干預哲事，而亟使赫政勸阻英官，勿遽更易哲酋，使藏人有所藉口。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai strictly ordered Tibetan officials, clergy and laity not rashly to intervene in Zhe affairs, and urgently had Hart dissuade English officers, not hastily to change the Zhe chief, giving Tibetans a pretext.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai forbade Tibetan clergy and officials to meddle in Sikkim and had Hart urge the British not to replace the raja and give Lhasa a pretext.

sentences.zh: 藏、哲舊界本在雅納、支木兩山間，其後商販往來另辟捷徑，於是有所謂咱利孔道者，即熱勒巴拉嶺之支麓也。

translations.literal: The old Tibetan-Zhe boundary was originally between Yala and Zhimu mountains; afterward merchants going and coming opened a shortcut, and thus there is what is called the Jelep Pass road—that is a spur of Rela Bara Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: The old Tibet-Sikkim line ran between Yala and Zhimu; traders later opened the Jelep route, a spur of Jelep La.

sentences.zh: 升泰議即咱利山立石畫分藏、哲之界，其印、哲舊界在日喜河者，亦擬仍舊，而於條約註明。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai proposed to set stones and draw the Tibetan-Zhe boundary at Jelep Mountain; the old Indian-Zhe boundary at Rishi River was also proposed to remain as before, and to note it in the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai proposed marking the Tibet-Sikkim border on Jelep La, leaving the India-Sikkim line on the Rishi Chu as before, and writing both into treaty.

sentences.zh: 藏番不原通商，初指對邦附近地為商埠，後始議定後藏之亞東，於其地修建關卡，設漢官治之。

translations.literal: Tibetan tribes did not wish trade; at first they pointed to land near Doklam as a mart, afterward finally agreed on Yadong in rear Tibet, building a customs barrier there with Chinese officials to administer.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans resisted trade, first naming Doklam, then accepting Yatung in southern Tibet with a customs post under Chinese officers.

sentences.zh: 藏番甫首肯，而英官又遷延不遽決。

translations.literal: The Tibetan tribes had just nodded assent, yet English officers again delayed and would not promptly decide.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans had barely consented when British officers stalled again.

sentences.zh: 升泰亟奏請飭總署促英使迅速議約。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai urgently memorialized requesting the Yamen be ordered to urge the English minister to deliberate the treaty swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai begged the Yamen to press the British minister for a speedy settlement.

sentences.zh: 總署王大臣旋擬四條，與英使華爾身籌商久之，始議定八款。

translations.literal: Grand Minister Wang of the Yamen soon drafted four articles and deliberated long with English minister Walsham before at last agreeing on eight clauses.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wang of the Yamen drafted four points and bargained with Minister Walsham until eight articles were fixed.

sentences.zh: 總署乃上奏，謂：「第一款，藏、哲以咱利山一帶山顛為界；

translations.literal: The Yamen then memorialized upward, stating: "Article one: Tibet and Zhe take the Jelep Mountain ridge as border;
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen memorialized: "Article 1: Tibet and Sikkim shall take the crest of Jelep La as the boundary;

sentences.zh: 第二款，哲地歸英保護；

translations.literal: Article two: Zhe territory returns to English protection;
translations.idiomatic: Article 2: Sikkim shall remain under British protection;

sentences.zh: 第三款，兩邊各無犯越；

translations.literal: Article three: neither side shall violate or cross;
translations.idiomatic: Article 3: neither side shall cross the border;

sentences.zh: 其餘緩議。

translations.literal: the rest to be deliberated slowly.
translations.idiomatic: the rest to be discussed later.

sentences.zh: 各條善後應辦事宜，侭可徐與商榷，彼此派員定議。

translations.literal: Matters of aftermath for each article that should be handled may all be slowly discussed with them; each side to dispatch officers to fix deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining details might be settled gradually by commissioners on both sides.

sentences.zh: 請簡派升泰為全權大臣，與英員先行畫押。」

translations.literal: Request specially to appoint Sheng Tai plenipotentiary minister, to initial with the English officer first."
translations.idiomatic: It asked that Sheng Tai be named plenipotentiary to initial the agreement with the British commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奉旨俞允。

translations.literal: An imperial edict granted approval.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 是歲秋七月，出使大臣薛福成與英外部互換於倫敦，是為中英會議藏印條約。

translations.literal: That year in the seventh month of autumn, envoy minister Xue Fucheng exchanged ratifications with the English Foreign Office in London—this was the Sino-British Convention Relating to Tibet and India.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Minister Xue Fucheng exchanged ratifications in London with the Foreign Office, completing the Anglo-Chinese Convention on Tibet and Sikkim.

sentences.zh: 是年德宗大婚，英派使臣華爾身齎英主維多利亞國書致賀，並自鳴鐘一座，上刻祝辭云：「日月同明，報十二時，吉祥如意，天地合德，慶億萬年，富貴壽康。」

translations.literal: That year was the Guangxu Emperor's grand wedding; England dispatched minister Walsham bearing Queen Victoria's state letter of congratulation, and also a self-chiming clock, on which was carved an auspicious inscription saying: "Sun and moon equally bright, striking the twelve hours, good fortune as wished; heaven and earth united in virtue, celebrating billions of years—wealth, rank, longevity, and health."
translations.idiomatic: The same year marked Guangxu's imperial wedding. Britain sent Minister Walsham with Queen Victoria's letter of congratulation and a chiming clock inscribed: "Sun and moon share their light, marking every hour with good fortune; heaven and earth in harmony, celebrating endless years of wealth, honor, longevity, and peace."

sentences.zh: 旋命駐使薛福成赴英外部傳旨致謝，並遞國書。

translations.literal: The court then ordered resident envoy Xue Fucheng to call on the English Foreign Office to convey an imperial message of thanks and present a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: The court then had Minister Xue Fucheng call on the Foreign Office to convey thanks and present China's letter of credence.

sentences.zh: 是年英開重慶商埠。

translations.literal: That year England opened Chongqing as a commercial port.
translations.idiomatic: That year Britain secured the opening of Chongqing to foreign trade.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月，換約限滿，前駐藏大臣升泰遣員黃紹勳、張昉及總務司赫政與英印督蘭士丹所派之保爾在大吉嶺會議，各擬辦法。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the seventeenth year, when the deadline for exchanging supplementary terms arrived, former resident minister in Tibet Sheng Tai dispatched officers Huang Shaoxun and Zhang Fang, together with General Superintendent James Hart, to confer at Darjeeling with Paul, whom Indian Governor Lansdowne had appointed; each side drafted its proposals.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Guangxu 17, as the deadline for exchanging supplementary terms arrived, Sheng Tai sent Huang Shaoxun, Zhang Fang, and James Hart to Darjeeling to meet Paul, Lansdowne's commissioner. Each side put forward its proposals.

sentences.zh: 保爾欲在仁進岡入藏一百五十餘里之法利城（

translations.literal: Paul wished, at Renqing Pass, to enter Tibet more than one hundred fifty li to Phari Town (
translations.idiomatic: Paul wanted trade opened at Phari Town, more than 150 li inside Tibet beyond Renqing Pass (

sentences.zh: 即派克里）

translations.literal: that is, Phari)
translations.idiomatic: that is, Phari).

sentences.zh: 設關通商，並俟十年後再定入口貨稅。

translations.literal: to establish a customs post for trade, and to wait ten years before fixing import duties.
translations.idiomatic: A customs post would be established there, with import duties fixed only after ten years.

sentences.zh: 升泰執定十二年條款「藏、印邊界通商，由中國體察情形」之語，辯駮久不決。

translations.literal: Sheng Tai held fast to the twelfth-year clause that "trade on the Tibet-India border shall be arranged by China as circumstances warrant," and after prolonged rebuttal no settlement was reached.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Tai clung to the twelve-year-old wording that border trade was for China to arrange as circumstances allowed, and months of argument produced no agreement.

sentences.zh: 十八年夏六月，復與保爾商議辦法九款，續款二條，定於交界之咱利山下亞東境內為英商貿易所。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer in the eighteenth year they again deliberated with Paul on nine implementing articles and two supplemental clauses, fixing a mart for British merchants within Yadong, below Jelep La on the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Guangxu 18 they agreed with Paul on nine trade regulations and two supplements, placing the British mart in Yadong below Jelep La.

sentences.zh: 商上等復懷疑慮，堅請於二款內註明「不得擅入關內」字樣，又請禁印茶運藏，一再與英使華爾身辯論，仍不決。

translations.literal: The merchant chiefs again harbored doubts, firmly requesting that Article Two note the words "may not enter the pass without authorization," and also requesting a ban on transporting Indian tea into Tibet; they debated again and again with English minister Walsham, yet still no decision.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan merchant elites again objected, insisting Article Two state that traders "must not enter the interior without permission" and demanding a ban on Indian tea imports. They argued repeatedly with Minister Walsham, but the matter remained unsettled.

sentences.zh: 至十九年五月，總理衙門奏：「現據赫德稱：『印度已將辦法九款更改商訂，最緊要之第二款內，註明英商在亞東貿易，自交界至亞東而止；

translations.literal: By the fifth month of the nineteenth year the Yamen memorialized: "Hart now reports: 'India has revised and renegotiated the nine implementing articles. The most important change to Article Two notes that British merchants trading at Yadong may do so only from the border up to Yadong and no farther;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Guangxu 19 the Yamen reported: "Hart advises that India has revised the nine regulations. The crucial change to Article Two limits British trade at Yadong to the stretch from the frontier to the town itself;

sentences.zh: 第四款內註明進出口稅，俟五年期滿酌定稅則；

translations.literal: Article Four notes import and export duties, to be fixed after a five-year term;
translations.idiomatic: Article Four postpones fixing import and export duties for five years;

sentences.zh: 至印茶一項，現議開辦時不即運藏，俟五年限滿，方可入藏銷售，應納之稅不得過華茶入英納稅之數；

translations.literal: as for Indian tea, it is now agreed that at opening it will not immediately be sent into Tibet; only after the five-year term may it enter Tibet for sale, and the tax payable may not exceed the tax on Chinese tea entering England;
translations.idiomatic: Indian tea may not enter Tibet at once but only after five years, and its tax may not exceed that levied on Chinese tea in Britain;

sentences.zh: 此外各款，均照升泰所擬辦理。』

translations.literal: all other articles are to be handled according to Sheng Tai's draft.
translations.idiomatic: all other clauses follow Sheng Tai's proposals."

sentences.zh: 臣等查中英通商稅則，茶葉每百斤徵銀二兩五錢，而洋商運華茶至英，每百斤徵銀十兩。

translations.literal: Your ministers have examined the Sino-British trade tariff: tea is taxed two taels and five mace of silver per hundred jin, yet when foreign merchants carry Chinese tea to England they pay ten taels per hundred jin.
translations.idiomatic: We find that under the Sino-British tariff Chinese tea pays 2.5 taels per hundred jin at home, whereas Chinese tea in Britain pays 10 taels per hundred jin.

sentences.zh: 現在先與議定，如印茶入藏，應照華茶入英每百斤稅銀十兩，磋議經年，始克就範。

translations.literal: It is now agreed in advance that if Indian tea enters Tibet it shall be taxed at ten taels per hundred jin, as with Chinese tea in England; after deliberation lasting a year, terms were at last settled.
translations.idiomatic: Indian tea entering Tibet was set at the same 10 taels per hundred jin as Chinese tea in Britain—terms that took a year of negotiation to secure.

sentences.zh: 竊思藏約未結三端，自十七年開議至今，已屆三年之久，始得印、藏兩情翕然允協，即可就此收束，以綏邊圉。」

translations.literal: We reflect that the three outstanding points of the Tibet settlement, from the opening of talks in the seventeenth year until now, have already spanned three years; at last Indian and Tibetan parties have harmoniously assented, and the matter may be closed to pacify the frontier."
translations.idiomatic: The three remaining issues on Tibet had been debated since Guangxu 17—three years in all—until India and Tibet finally agreed. The Yamen urged closing the matter to secure the border.

sentences.zh: 是為續議中英會議藏印條款。

translations.literal: This was the Supplementary Regulations to the Sino-British Convention on Tibet and India.
translations.idiomatic: These were the Supplementary Regulations to the Anglo-Chinese Convention on Tibet and Sikkim.

sentences.zh: 是年十月，在大吉嶺互換。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year the instruments were exchanged at Darjeeling.
translations.idiomatic: Ratifications were exchanged at Darjeeling that October.

sentences.zh: 既又與英議滇、緬界務。

translations.literal: China then took up border affairs between Yunnan and Burma with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: Britain and China next turned to the Yunnan–Burma boundary.

sentences.zh: 初，曾紀澤與英議約，英許中國稍展邊界，擬予以潞江以東南掌、拈人之地。

translations.literal: At first, when Zeng Jiyang negotiated with Britain, London had allowed China a slight extension of territory, planning to grant lands east of the Salween in the Zomia and Jingpo regions.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in talks with Zeng Jiyang, Britain had agreed in principle to extend China's frontier east of the Salween in the Zomia and Jingpo hill country.

sentences.zh: 既，紀澤又向英外部要求八募之地，不允。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Jiyang again asked the Foreign Office for the Bhamo region, but was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jiyang later demanded Bhamo itself, and London refused.

sentences.zh: 英外部侍郎克蕾謂英廷已飭駐緬之英官勘驗一地，允中國立埠設關收稅，有另指舊八募之說，在八募東二三十里。

translations.literal: Under-Secretary Clare of the Foreign Office said the British government had ordered its officer in Burma to survey a site permitting China to establish a mart, set customs, and collect duties; there was also talk of a separate site near old Bhamo, twenty or thirty li to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Under-Secretary Clare replied that London had ordered its Burma officer to survey a site where China might open a customs station, with talk of an alternative spot east of old Bhamo.

sentences.zh: 紀澤因與外部互書節略存卷，暫停不議。

translations.literal: Jiyang therefore exchanged written summaries with the Foreign Office and kept them on file, suspending further discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jiyang exchanged memoranda with the Foreign Office and shelved the issue.

sentences.zh: 旋受代回華。

translations.literal: He was soon relieved and returned to China.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon replaced and returned home.

sentences.zh: 至是，出使大臣薛福成見英人與暹羅勘界，並有創築鐵路通接滇邊之訊，恐分界、通商事宜不早籌議，臨時必受虧損。

translations.literal: By then envoy Xue Fucheng learned that Britain was surveying borders with Siam and had plans to build a railway linking the Yunnan frontier, and feared that if boundary and trade matters were not settled early, China would suffer losses when pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Envoy Xue Fucheng then saw Britain demarcating territory with Siam and heard of a planned railway to the Yunnan border. He warned that delay on boundaries and trade would cost China dearly.

sentences.zh: 於是上書請與英人提議。

translations.literal: He therefore memorialized requesting negotiations with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized urging immediate talks with Britain.

sentences.zh: 及福成往促踐前議，英以公法為解，謂：「西洋公法，議在立約之後，不可不遵；

translations.literal: When Fucheng went to urge fulfillment of the earlier understanding, Britain cited international law, saying: "Under Western public law, undertakings made after a treaty is concluded must be observed;
translations.idiomatic: When Xue pressed Britain to honor prior understandings, London cited international law: "Under Western public law, agreements made after a treaty is signed must be kept;

sentences.zh: 議在立約以前，不能共守。」

translations.literal: undertakings made before a treaty is concluded cannot be jointly enforced."
translations.idiomatic: agreements made before a treaty is signed cannot bind either party."

sentences.zh: 蓋不認讓中國展邊界及以大金沙江為公共江、八募近處勘地、中國立埠設關三端。

translations.literal: In effect Britain refused to recognize the three points of extending China's frontier, treating the great Jinsha River as a common waterway, surveying land near Bhamo, and letting China establish a mart and customs post.
translations.idiomatic: Britain thus repudiated earlier concessions on extending the frontier, sharing the Jinsha River, surveying near Bhamo, and allowing a Chinese customs station.

sentences.zh: 薛福成以英既翻前議，因思野人山地綿亙數千里，不在緬甸轄境之內，復照外務部，請以大金沙江為界，江東之境歸滇。

translations.literal: Because Britain had overturned the earlier understanding, Xue Fucheng, reflecting that the Wild Headman hills stretched for thousands of li outside Burma's jurisdiction, reported again to the Foreign Ministry requesting the great Jinsha River as the boundary, with lands east of the river to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: With Britain having gone back on its word, Xue Fucheng argued that the wild hill tracts beyond Burma stretched for thousands of li and asked the Foreign Ministry to take the Jinsha River as the border, assigning everything east of it to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 而印度總督不允，出師盞達邊外之昔馬攻擊野人，以示不原分地之意。

translations.literal: The Indian Governor-General refused, however, and sent troops from Sima beyond the Zhedao frontier to attack the hill peoples, showing that he was unwilling to partition territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Viceroy of India refused and sent troops from Hsima beyond Tengyue to raid hill tribes, signaling that he would not yield territory.

sentences.zh: 又欲藉端停商全約。

translations.literal: He also sought a pretext to suspend the entire commercial treaty.
translations.idiomatic: He also tried to use the unrest as grounds to suspend the whole commercial treaty.

sentences.zh: 福成仍促速議。

translations.literal: Fucheng still pressed for speedy negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Fucheng nevertheless pressed for a quick settlement.

sentences.zh: 久之，英始允將久淪於緬之漢龍、天馬兩關還中國。

translations.literal: After a long delay Britain at last agreed to return to China the Hanlong and Tianma passes, long lost to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged delay Britain agreed to restore Hanlong and Tianma, passes long under Burmese control.

sentences.zh: 又久之，始允讓所據之鐵壁關。

translations.literal: Still later it agreed to yield Tiebi Pass, which it occupied.
translations.idiomatic: Much later it also yielded Tiebi Pass.

sentences.zh: 惟虎踞關，英人以深入彼境七八十里，與八募相近，不允讓。

translations.literal: Only Huju Pass Britain refused to yield, saying it lay seventy or eighty li deep in their territory and close to Bhamo.
translations.idiomatic: Huju Pass alone was withheld on the ground that it lay seventy or eighty li inside Burmese territory near Bhamo.

sentences.zh: 至於設關，拒尤力。

translations.literal: On establishing a customs post they refused with especial firmness.
translations.idiomatic: Britain was especially adamant against a customs station.

sentences.zh: 福成以英既不允我地，則英所得於我之權利亦應作廢。

translations.literal: Fucheng argued that since Britain would not grant China territory, the rights Britain had obtained from China should likewise be voided.
translations.idiomatic: Xue argued that if Britain would not yield territory, the concessions China had granted Britain should be void as well.

sentences.zh: 相持甚久，始就滇境東南商定于孟定橄欖壩西南邊外讓一地曰科干，又自猛卯土司邊外包括漢龍關在內，作一直線，東抵潞江麻栗壩之對岸止，劃歸中國，約計八百英方里。

translations.literal: After a very long stalemate they at last agreed, on Yunnan's southeastern border, to yield a tract called Kokang southwest of Mengding and Ganlanba; and from beyond the Mengmao native office, including Hanlong Pass, to draw a straight line east to the opposite bank of the Salween at Maliba and stop, assigning it to China—about eight hundred square English miles.
translations.idiomatic: After months of deadlock Britain conceded Kokang southwest of Mengding and Ganlanba, and drew a straight line from beyond Mengmao—including Hanlong Pass—east to the Salween opposite Maliba, ceding roughly eight hundred square miles to China.

sentences.zh: 又車里、孟連土司所屬鎮邊廳，系為兩屬，亦允全讓，並野人山毗連之昔馬亦允讓。

translations.literal: The Zhenbian subprefecture under the Cheli and Menglian native offices, formerly under dual allegiance, was also fully yielded; Sima in the Wild Headman hills adjoining it was yielded as well.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenbian, long under dual Cheli and Menglian jurisdiction, was ceded outright, as was Hsima in the adjoining hill country.

sentences.zh: 至此界務告一結束。

translations.literal: At this the boundary question reached a conclusion.
translations.idiomatic: The boundary dispute was thus closed.

sentences.zh: 而商務，大金沙江行船、八募立埠設關，英仍不允。

translations.literal: On commerce, however—navigation on the great Jinsha and a mart and customs post at Bhamo—Britain still refused.
translations.idiomatic: On trade, however, Britain still refused navigation on the Jinsha and a customs station at Bhamo.

sentences.zh: 福成久與爭論，始於行船一事，於約中另立一條，不許他國援例，而設關仍不肯通融。

translations.literal: After long argument with Fucheng, Britain at last added a separate article on navigation, forbidding other powers to cite it as a precedent, yet still would not compromise on a customs post.
translations.idiomatic: Xue wrangled for months until Britain added a separate navigation clause excluding other powers, but would not budge on customs.

sentences.zh: 惟約中於英人所得權利，如緬鹽不准運入滇境，英關暫不徵收貨稅，領事僅設一員、限一定駐所，商貨僅由二路，不准開埠，英亦無詞。

translations.literal: Only on rights Britain had obtained under the treaty—such as forbidding Burmese salt in Yunnan, temporarily exempting British customs from commodity duties, limiting consuls to one officer at a fixed post, restricting trade to two routes, and forbidding new treaty ports—did Britain have nothing to say.
translations.idiomatic: Britain accepted Chinese limits on Burmese salt, deferred British customs duties, capped consular posts, restricted trade routes, and barred new treaty ports without protest.

sentences.zh: 遂於二十年正月二十四日在倫敦定約，共二十條：一、二、三、四，劃定各段界線；

translations.literal: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month of the twentieth year a treaty of twenty articles was concluded in London: Articles One through Four demarcated the boundary in sections;
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month of Guangxu 20 a twenty-article treaty was signed in London. Articles 1–4 defined the boundary in sections;

sentences.zh: 五，中國不再索問永昌、騰越邊界外隙地，英國於北丹泥及科幹照所劃邊界讓與中國，孟連、江洪之地亦歸中國，惟未定議前不得讓與他國；

translations.literal: Article Five: China would no longer press claims to vacant lands beyond Yongchang and Tengyue; Britain would yield to China North Theinni and Kokang as demarcated, and Menglian and Chiang Hung as well, provided neither was ceded to another state before final agreement;
translations.idiomatic: Article 5 relinquished China's claims to vacant lands beyond Yongchang and Tengyue while Britain ceded North Theinni, Kokang, Menglian, and Chiang Hung, neither to be alienated before ratification;

sentences.zh: 八，各貨物分別應稅不應稅；

translations.literal: Article Eight: which goods were taxable and which were not;
translations.idiomatic: Article 8 listed taxable and exempt goods;

sentences.zh: 十、十一，分別各貨物准販運不准販運；

translations.literal: Articles Ten and Eleven: which goods might and might not be transported for sale;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 10 and 11 specified permitted and prohibited goods;

sentences.zh: 十三，中國派領事駐仰光，英國派領事駐蠻允；

translations.literal: Article Thirteen: China to post a consul at Rangoon and Britain at Manwun;
translations.idiomatic: Article 13 placed a Chinese consul at Rangoon and a British consul at Manwun;

sentences.zh: 十五，定交逃犯例；

translations.literal: Article Fifteen: extradition of fugitives;
translations.idiomatic: Article 15 covered extradition;

sentences.zh: 十七，定中、英民在兩國界內相待最優例；

translations.literal: Article Seventeen: reciprocal most-favored-nation treatment for Chinese and British subjects within each other's territories;
translations.idiomatic: Article 17 granted reciprocal most-favored-nation treatment;

sentences.zh: 又專條內各條款，僅用於兩國所指屬地，不能用於別處。

translations.literal: and a special article provided that these clauses applied only to the territories designated by both states and could not be invoked elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: and a special clause limited the treaty to the designated territories of each side.

sentences.zh: 是為中英續議滇緬界務商務條款。

translations.literal: This was the Sino-British Convention on the Boundary and Trade of Yunnan and Burma.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Anglo-Chinese Convention Relating to Burma and Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 是年又與英議接滇、緬邊界陸路電線條約。

translations.literal: That year China also negotiated with Britain a treaty on a land telegraph line along the Yunnan–Burma border.
translations.idiomatic: That year Britain and China also agreed on a land telegraph linking the Yunnan–Burma frontier.

sentences.zh: 尋又議藏、印條款。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Tibet–India regulations were discussed again.
translations.idiomatic: Talks on Tibet and India were reopened shortly afterward.

sentences.zh: 二十一年夏，中、日和議既成，法索雲南普洱徼外猛烏、烏得兩地。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-first year, after the Sino-Japanese peace, France demanded the Mengwu and Wude districts beyond Pu'er in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Guangxu 21, after peace with Japan, France demanded Mengwu and Wude beyond Pu'er.

sentences.zh: 英使歐格訥以兩地屬緬江洪，指為違約，欲中國將八募北野人山地，由薩伯坪起，東南到盞達，西南順南碗河折向瑞麗江，循江至猛卯，向南至工隆、八關、科干皆在內，讓歸英。

translations.literal: Minister O'Conor, holding that the two places belonged to Chiang Hung in Burma, called this a breach of treaty and demanded that China yield the Wild Headman hills north of Bhamo—from Sabaping southeast to Zhedao, southwest along the Namwan River to the Ruili River, following the river to Mengmao, and south to Gonglong, Baguan, and Kokang.
translations.idiomatic: Minister O'Conor claimed the districts were Burmese Chiang Hung, charged China with breach of treaty, and demanded the hill tract north of Bhamo from Sabaping to Zhedao, down the Namwan and Ruili rivers to Mengmao, and south through Gonglong, Baguan, and Kokang.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: China refused.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing refused.

sentences.zh: 英忽請允西江通商，再議野人山地，許之。

translations.literal: Britain suddenly asked permission for trade on the West River and to reopen the hill-country question; China assented.
translations.idiomatic: Britain then offered West River trade in exchange for reopening the hill-country issue, and China agreed.

sentences.zh: 復要求在肇慶、梧州、桂林、潯州、南寧五府設立領事，佛山、高要、封川、南新墟等處停泊輪船，由廣州澳門出入。

translations.literal: It further demanded consulates at Zhaoqing, Wuzhou, Guilin, Xunzhou, and Nanning, and steamers moored at Foshan, Gaoyao, Fengchuan, Nanxin Market, and elsewhere, entering and leaving through Guangzhou and Macao.
translations.idiomatic: London also sought consulates at Zhaoqing, Wuzhou, Guilin, Xunzhou, and Nanning and steamers at Foshan, Gaoyao, Fengchuan, and Nanxinxu, entering via Guangzhou and Macao.

sentences.zh: 中國以野人山地減索無幾，而通商口岸太多，且桂林在北江之北，潯州、南寧在藤江、龔江上游，並非西江，豈能強索？

translations.literal: China held that the hill country yielded little, whereas the trading ports requested were too many; moreover Guilin lay north of the Bei River, and Xunzhou and Nanning lay on the upper Teng and Gong rivers—not on the West River—so how could they be demanded by force?
translations.idiomatic: Beijing replied that the hill cession was minor but the port demands excessive; Guilin lies north of the Bei River and Xunzhou and Nanning on upstream tributaries, not the West River, and could not be forced open.

sentences.zh: 阻止之。

translations.literal: China blocked these demands.
translations.idiomatic: China resisted.

sentences.zh: 英外部又以北丹尼、科干兩地原屬緬，為前薛福成定界時誤畫入華，求索回；

translations.literal: The Foreign Office also said North Theinni and Kokang had originally belonged to Burma and had been mistakenly drawn into China when Xue Fucheng fixed the boundary, and asked that they be returned;
translations.idiomatic: The Foreign Office claimed North Theinni and Kokang had been wrongly assigned to China in Xue Fucheng's boundary settlement and demanded their return;

sentences.zh: 又請于騰越、順甯、思茅三處設領事；

translations.literal: it also requested consulates at Tengyue, Shunning, and Simao;
translations.idiomatic: it sought consulates at Tengyue, Shunning, and Simao;

sentences.zh: 及緬甸現有及將來續開之鐵路接入中國；

translations.literal: and that existing and future Burmese railways be linked into China;
translations.idiomatic: and connection of Burmese railways, present and future, to China;

sentences.zh: 又請援照俄、法條約利益，於新疆設領事。

translations.literal: and, citing Russian and French treaty benefits, consulates in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: and, citing Russian and French treaty privileges, consulates in Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 再三駮論，始允將新疆設埠及援照俄、法利益一節刪去；

translations.literal: After repeated rebuttal China at last secured deletion of opening ports in Xinjiang and the clause on Russian and French benefits;
translations.idiomatic: After repeated argument Beijing deleted the Xinjiang ports and the most-favored-nation clause;

sentences.zh: 滇、緬接路一節，改為俟中國鐵路展至緬界時彼此相接；

translations.literal: the Yunnan–Burma railway clause was changed to connection only when China's railways reached the Burmese frontier;
translations.idiomatic: the railway article was limited to connection once Chinese lines reached the border;

sentences.zh: 滇界領事一節，改為將已設之蠻允領事，改駐或順寧或騰越一處，其思茅領事，系援利益均霑之例，非英獨創；

translations.literal: the consulate on the Yunnan border was changed so that the existing Manwun consul might be moved to either Shunning or Tengyue, while the Simao consul followed the equal-benefits precedent and was not a British innovation;
translations.idiomatic: the Yunnan consulate issue was settled by relocating Manwun to Shunning or Tengyue, with Simao governed by equal-benefits precedent;

sentences.zh: 其野人山界線，改為南坎一處作為永租，餘俟兩國派員勘定。

translations.literal: and the Wild Headman boundary was changed so that Nankan alone would be permanently leased, the rest to be surveyed by commissioners of both states.
translations.idiomatic: and the hill boundary was revised to a permanent lease of Nankan only, with the rest to be surveyed jointly.

sentences.zh: 惟西江通商一節，允至梧州而止，梧州之東，祗開三水縣城、江根墟兩地，商船由磨刀門進口，其由香港至廣州省城，本系舊約所許，仍限江門、甘竹、肇慶、德慶四處，遂定議立中緬條約附款。

translations.literal: Only on West River trade was agreement reached—to Wuzhou, and east of Wuzhou only Sanshui county town and Jianggen Market, with merchant vessels entering through Modaomen; travel from Hong Kong to Guangzhou remained as the old treaty allowed, limited to Jiangmen, Ganzhu, Zhaoqing, and Deqing. The supplementary Sino-Burmese treaty was then concluded.
translations.idiomatic: West River trade alone was conceded as far as Wuzhou, with only Sanshui and Jianggenxu beyond, entered via Modaomen; the Hong Kong–Guangzhou route remained limited to Jiangmen, Ganzhu, Zhaoqing, and Deqing. A supplementary Sino-Burmese treaty was signed.

sentences.zh: 時二十三年正月也。

translations.literal: This was in the first month of the twenty-third year.
translations.idiomatic: That was in the first month of Guangxu 23.

sentences.zh: 是年英主維多利亞在位六十年，命張廕桓前往致賀。

translations.literal: That year Queen Victoria completed sixty years on the throne, and Zhang Yinhuan was ordered to go and offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Victoria's Diamond Jubilee, Zhang Yinhuan was sent to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 二十四年四月，議展香港界址至九龍城，租期九十九年。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fourth year the Hong Kong boundary was extended to Kowloon City on a ninety-nine-year lease.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Guangxu 24 Hong Kong's bounds were extended to Kowloon City for ninety-nine years.

sentences.zh: 五月，英租威海衛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Britain leased Weihaiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Britain leased Weihaiwei.

sentences.zh: 初，威海為日本軍佔領，英人致書日相伊藤博文，原代繳償款，要求早撤兵。

translations.literal: At first, while Weihai was occupied by Japanese forces, the British wrote to Japanese Prime Minister Ito Hirobumi offering to pay the indemnity on China's behalf and requesting early withdrawal of troops.
translations.idiomatic: Weihai was initially held by Japan. Britain wrote to Prime Minister Ito offering to pay China's indemnity if Japanese troops withdrew promptly.

sentences.zh: 會我償款繳清，北洋大臣派員收回，英使竇納樂遂請租借。

translations.literal: When China's indemnity was paid in full the Beiyang minister dispatched officers to recover the place; British minister MacDonald then requested a lease.
translations.idiomatic: Once China finished paying indemnities, Beiyang officials took possession; Minister MacDonald then sought a lease.

sentences.zh: 政府派慶親王奕劻、尚書廖壽恆與立約，文云：「以劉公島並在威海灣之群島及威海全灣沿岸以內十英里之地租與英國，威海衛城牆以內仍由中國自行管理。

translations.literal: The government appointed Prince Qing Yikuang and Minister Liao Shouheng to conclude the treaty, which read: "Liugong Island and the islands in Weihai Bay, together with all land within ten miles of the entire bay shore, are leased to Britain; within the walls of Weihaiwei city China shall continue its own administration.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qing (Yikuang) and Minister Liao Shouheng signed a treaty leasing Liugong Island, the islands of Weihai Bay, and ten miles of shoreline to Britain while Weihaiwei city itself remained under Chinese administration.

sentences.zh: 又所租於英國之水面，中國兵船無論在局內局外仍可享用。」

translations.literal: Chinese warships, whether inside or outside the leased waters, may continue to use them as before."
translations.idiomatic: Chinese warships might still use the leased waters inside and outside the bay.

sentences.zh: 並另備照會，謂「中國重整海軍，船舶可泊港內，請英人代為訓練」。

translations.literal: A separate note also stated: "As China rebuilds its navy, its vessels may anchor in the harbor; Britain is asked to assist in training."
translations.idiomatic: A separate note added that as China rebuilt its navy its ships might anchor in the harbor and requested British training assistance.

sentences.zh: 是月，英領事因沙市教案，照請開辦湖南通商口岸。

translations.literal: That month, because of the Shashi case, the British consul formally requested the opening of Hunan to foreign trade.
translations.idiomatic: That month, citing the Shashi outrage, the British consul demanded treaty ports in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 張之洞以岳州系奉准開埠，尚須體察詳商辦理，致總署請商緩。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong noted that Yuezhou had already been approved for opening but still required careful study and consultation, and wrote the Yamen requesting delay.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong replied that Yuezhou's opening still required study and asked the Yamen to negotiate a postponement.

sentences.zh: 總署擬推展兩年，英使不允。

translations.literal: The Yamen proposed postponing two years; the British minister refused.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen offered a two-year delay; the British minister refused.

sentences.zh: 總署以湖南系我自開口岸，與他口不同，不許，亦不許牽入沙案。

translations.literal: The Yamen held that Hunan was a port China had opened on its own initiative, unlike other ports, and would not permit it; it also refused to link the matter to the Shashi case.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen insisted Hunan was a self-opened port unlike treaty ports and refused to tie it to Shashi.

sentences.zh: 久不決。

translations.literal: No decision was reached for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: The dispute dragged on.

sentences.zh: 二十五年五月，駐漢英領事牒鄂督張之洞云：「本國巴管帶欲乘威拉小兵輪往洞庭湖上下游，先至岳州，再往湘陰、長沙，後往沅江、龍陽、常德、安鄉等處。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year the British consul at Hankou notified Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of Hubei: "An officer of our nation named Ba wishes to take a small armed steamer up and down the Dongting Lake, first to Yuezhou, then to Xiangyin and Changsha, and afterward to the Yuan River, Longyang, Changde, Anxiang, and other places."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Guangxu 25 Hankou's British consul notified Zhang Zhidong that a Commander Ba wished to send a small gunboat up the Dongting region—to Yuezhou, Xiangyin, Changsha, and then the Yuan, Longyang, Changde, and Anxiang.

sentences.zh: 張之洞以條約並無兵輪准往內地之說，阻之。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong blocked it on the ground that treaties contained no provision permitting gunboats in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang blocked the move, noting that no treaty allowed gunboats inland.

sentences.zh: 十二月，英參贊璧閣銜欲由湖南長沙取道常德、永順入川，過酉陽州抵重慶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month British counselor Bland wished to travel from Changsha in Hunan by way of Changde and Yongshun into Sichuan, passing Youyang Prefecture to reach Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Counselor Bland planned to go from Changsha through Changde and Yongshun into Sichuan via Youyang to Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 張之洞復阻之。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong again blocked him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong again refused.

sentences.zh: 尋允改由宜昌入川。

translations.literal: Permission was soon granted to enter Sichuan by way of Yichang instead.
translations.idiomatic: He was later allowed to enter Sichuan via Yichang instead.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪起。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxers rose.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26 the Boxer movement erupted.

sentences.zh: 五月，漢口英領事法磊斯見張之洞，面述沙侯電云：「如長江一帶佈置彈壓，英原以水師相助。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month the British consul at Hankou, Fraser, called on Zhang Zhidong and relayed a telegram from Lord Salisbury: "If suppression is arranged along the Yangtze, Britain is willing to assist with naval forces."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Hankou consul Fraser told Zhang Zhidong that Lord Salisbury had wired: "If the Yangtze region needs policing, Britain will help with warships."

sentences.zh: 張之洞答以當與江督劉坤一力任保護，不須外助，力阻之。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong replied that he and Liangjiang governor-general Liu Kunyi would undertake protection themselves and needed no foreign aid, and firmly blocked it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang replied that he and Liu Kunyi would keep order themselves and firmly refused foreign help.

sentences.zh: 時英以保全東南商務為辭，已派水師提督西摩入長江。

translations.literal: By then Britain, citing protection of southeastern commerce, had already sent Admiral Seymour into the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Britain had already sent Admiral Seymour up the Yangtze to "protect" southeastern trade.

sentences.zh: 七月二十日，聯軍入京，英軍從廣渠門入，各據地段。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of the seventh month the allied armies entered the capital; British troops entered through Guangqu Gate, each nation occupying its sector.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth day of the seventh month allied forces entered Beijing; British troops came through Guangqu Gate and each power took its sector.

sentences.zh: 八月，英與德結保護中國商務土地條款，又欲代中國理財、練兵，卻之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Britain and Germany concluded an agreement on protecting Chinese commercial property and territory, and also wished to manage China's finances and train its troops; China refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Britain and Germany agreed on protecting Chinese commerce and territory, then offered to manage Chinese finances and training; Beijing refused.

sentences.zh: 西摩欲派小輪入襄河探水道，張之洞阻之。

translations.literal: Seymour wished to send small steamers into the Xiang River to survey the channel; Zhang Zhidong blocked it.
translations.idiomatic: Seymour wanted gunboats on the Han River to survey channels; Zhang Zhidong again refused.

sentences.zh: 既復議浙衢教案。

translations.literal: Thereupon they again deliberated on the Zhejiang-Quzhou missionary case.
translations.idiomatic: Talks resumed over the missionary disturbance at Quzhou in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時湘案未結，英又欲派兵輪往，屢阻之。

translations.literal: At that time the Hunan case was still unsettled; England again wished to dispatch gunboats there, and [China] repeatedly blocked it.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan incident was still open when Britain again sought to send warships; Beijing repeatedly refused.

sentences.zh: 是年英君主逝，國書致唁，皇太后復專電弔唁之。

translations.literal: That year the British sovereign passed away; [China] sent a state letter of condolence, and the Empress Dowager also sent a special telegram of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: That year Queen Victoria died. China sent a letter of condolence, and the Empress Dowager cabled her own message of sympathy.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，既與各國議定和約大綱十二條，四月，英人請直隸、山西停考。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year [Guangxu 27, 1901], after the twelve-article general treaty outline had been agreed with the various powers, in the fourth month the English requested that Zhili and Shanxi suspend the civil-service examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In 1901, once the twelve-point Boxer settlement had been agreed with the powers, Britain asked in the fourth month that examinations be suspended in Zhili and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 張之洞以所請與大綱條約第十條不符，辨駮久之，七月，始定議。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong held that the request did not conform to Article 10 of the general treaty outline and argued for a long time; only in the seventh month was the matter finally settled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong argued at length that the request violated Article 10 of the settlement; agreement was reached only in the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 八月，英商立德欲在川河行駛輪船，沿江購地七處，請地方官註冊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the English merchant Little wished to run steamers on Sichuan rivers, purchased land at seven places along the banks, and asked local officials to register them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Archibald Little sought to run steamers on Sichuan waterways, bought land at seven riverside sites, and asked local officials to register the purchases.

sentences.zh: 英領事照會到鄂，以條約非通商口岸，無准洋商置買地基產業之條，拒之。

translations.literal: The English consul's note reached Hubei; on the grounds that these were not treaty ports and there was no article permitting foreign merchants to purchase land and property, [the authorities] refused.
translations.idiomatic: The British consul's note reached Hubei, but officials refused: these were not treaty ports, and no treaty clause allowed foreigners to buy land or buildings.

sentences.zh: 十一月，英使馬凱赴江、鄂，與劉坤一、張之洞商議免釐，答以去年在京與赫德籌議洋貨稅釐並徵，必須稅至值百抽二五方能免釐。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the English envoy Mackay went to Jiangsu and Hubei to discuss with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong the abolition of likin; they replied that last year in Beijing they had deliberated with Hart on levying import duty and likin together on foreign goods, and that duties must reach two and a half per cent of value before likin could be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Minister Mackay went to Jiangsu and Hubei to negotiate likin abolition with Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong. They replied that Hart had already agreed in Beijing to combine import duty and likin on foreign goods, and that likin could be abolished only once the tariff reached 2.5 per cent ad valorem.

sentences.zh: 馬凱允加進口稅而不欲多加。

translations.literal: Mackay agreed to raise import duties but did not wish to raise them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Mackay accepted a higher import tariff but resisted a large increase.

sentences.zh: 於是朝命尚書呂海寰為辦理商約大臣，侍郎盛宣懷副之，並命劉坤一、張之洞皆與議。

translations.literal: Thereupon the court appointed Minister Lü Haihuan commissioner for the commercial treaty, with Vice Minister Sheng Xuanhuai as his deputy, and also ordered Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong to take part in the deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: The court then named Lü Haihuan commissioner for the commercial treaty, with Sheng Xuanhuai as deputy, and ordered Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong to join the talks.

sentences.zh: 研商數月，海寰等乃會奏：「臣等奉命會辦商約，英使馬凱開送約稿二十四款，聚議六十餘次。

translations.literal: After months of study, Haihuan and others jointly memorialized: "Your servants were ordered to confer on the commercial treaty; the English envoy Mackay submitted a draft of twenty-four articles, and [we] met more than sixty times.
translations.idiomatic: After months of negotiation Lü Haihuan and his colleagues jointly reported: "We were ordered to negotiate the commercial treaty. Minister Mackay submitted a draft of twenty-four articles, and we met more than sixty times.

sentences.zh: 加稅免釐一款，業經奏明，允如所請。

translations.literal: The article on raising duties and abolishing likin has already been memorialized and approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: The tariff increase and likin abolition clause has already been approved as requested.

sentences.zh: 此外各款，均經臣等隨時會奏。

translations.literal: All other articles have been reported to the throne by your servants as deliberations proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: We reported each of the other articles to the throne as negotiations proceeded.

sentences.zh: 惟第十款內港行輪，續經妥定章程，第十一款通商口岸權利，共議列三條，馬凱自請刪除。

translations.literal: Only Article 10 on inland steam navigation was later settled by regulations; on Article 11, treaty-port privileges, three clauses were jointly drafted, and Mackay himself asked to delete them.
translations.idiomatic: Article 10 on inland steam navigation was later settled by separate regulations. On Article 11, treaty-port privileges, we drafted three clauses, which Mackay himself asked to drop.

sentences.zh: 統核所索二十四款，駮拒未允者七：曰洋鹽進口，曰內地僑居貿易，曰郵政電報，曰設海上律例，曰整頓上海會審衙門，曰口岸免釐界限，曰貨物同在一河免復進口稅。

translations.literal: Reviewing in total the twenty-four articles sought, seven were rejected and not granted: foreign salt imports; inland residence and trade; postal and telegraph services; establishment of maritime law; reorganization of the Shanghai Mixed Court; boundaries for likin exemption at ports; and exemption from re-import duty for goods on the same river.
translations.idiomatic: Of the twenty-four articles requested, seven were rejected outright: foreign salt imports; inland residence and trade; postal and telegraph rights; maritime law courts; reform of the Shanghai Mixed Court; boundaries for likin exemption at ports; and exemption from re-import duty for goods carried on the same river.

sentences.zh: 議定後而又刪除者一：曰通商口岸利權歸入加稅免釐款內並議。

translations.literal: One agreed upon and then deleted: treaty-port privileges to be folded into the tariff-and-likin article for joint discussion.
translations.idiomatic: One clause was agreed and then struck: treaty-port privileges, which were to be folded into the tariff-and-likin article.

sentences.zh: 藉為抵制者五：曰新開口岸，曰減出口稅，曰三聯單，曰子口單，曰常關歸新關筦理。

translations.literal: Five were used as counters: new treaty ports; reduction of export duties; triplicate certificates; transit passes; and placing native customs under maritime-customs management.
translations.idiomatic: Five were held back as bargaining chips: new treaty ports; lower export duties; triplicate certificates; transit passes; and placing native customs under maritime-customs control.

sentences.zh: 商允改妥者十一：曰存票，曰國幣，曰廣東民船輪船稅則一律，曰華洋合股，曰整頓珠江、川江，曰推廣關棧，曰保護牌號，曰加稅免釐，曰礦務章程，曰內港行輪，曰米穀禁令。

translations.literal: Eleven were negotiated and revised to satisfaction: deposit receipts; national currency; uniform taxation on Guangdong native junks and steamers; Sino-foreign joint ventures; regulation of the Pearl and Sichuan rivers; expansion of bonded warehouses; protection of trademarks; tariff increase and likin abolition; mining regulations; inland steam navigation; and the grain-export ban.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven were negotiated into acceptable form: deposit receipts; national currency; uniform taxes on Guangdong junks and steamers; Sino-foreign joint ventures; regulation of the Pearl and Sichuan rivers; bonded warehouses; trademark protection; tariff increase and likin abolition; mining regulations; inland steam navigation; and the grain-export ban.

sentences.zh: 此就馬凱原議款目分別刪改歸併者也。

translations.literal: This is the classification by deletion, revision, and consolidation of Mackay's original proposed articles.
translations.idiomatic: This is how Mackay's original articles were classified, revised, and consolidated.

sentences.zh: 臣之洞等復向馬凱索議，彼允入約者三款：曰治外法權，曰籌議教案，曰禁止嗎啡。

translations.literal: Your servants Zhidong and others again pressed Mackay for further articles; he agreed to three in the treaty: extraterritorial jurisdiction; deliberation on missionary cases; and prohibition of morphine.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong and others pressed Mackay further, and he agreed to three additional clauses: extraterritorial jurisdiction; consultation on missionary cases; and a ban on morphine.

sentences.zh: 皆我補救國計民生要圖，幸就範圍，實有裨益。

translations.literal: All are essential measures for remedying state finances and people's livelihood; fortunately they fell within scope and are truly beneficial.
translations.idiomatic: Each addressed urgent needs of state finance and public welfare; securing them within the treaty is a real gain.

sentences.zh: 馬凱於定議後補請入約者二款：曰修改稅則年限，曰約文以英文為憑。

translations.literal: After terms were fixed Mackay additionally requested two articles in the treaty: revision of the tariff schedule period, and that the treaty text be authenticated in English.
translations.idiomatic: After the main terms were settled Mackay added two requests: revision of the tariff revision period, and English as the authentic treaty text.

sentences.zh: 查系照舊約辦理，為約中應有之義。

translations.literal: Investigation shows these follow old treaty practice and are proper provisions for a treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Both follow established treaty practice and are standard treaty provisions.

sentences.zh: 共計十六款。

translations.literal: In all, sixteen articles.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen articles in all.

sentences.zh: 臣等按馬凱所請加稅之款，意在不得抵原撥釐金五百萬以外之洋債賠款及挪作別用，恐各省再將貨物收捐，業已先後奏明。

translations.literal: Your servants observe that Mackay's requested tariff-increase article aims to ensure it may not offset foreign indemnity beyond the original five million taels of likin allocated, nor be diverted to other uses, fearing the provinces would again levy donations on goods—this has already been memorialized in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Mackay's tariff clause was meant to ensure the increase could not cover foreign indemnity beyond the original five million taels of likin, nor be diverted elsewhere, and to prevent provinces from levying new transit charges on goods. We have already reported this to the throne.

sentences.zh: 本定八月初二日畫押，馬凱又接英廷來電，必欲增敘詳明，以慰加稅洋商之意。

translations.literal: Signing was originally set for the second day of the eighth month; Mackay then received a telegram from the English court insisting on fuller wording to satisfy foreign merchants who favored the tariff increase.
translations.idiomatic: Signing was set for the second day of the eighth month, but Mackay then received a telegram from London insisting on fuller wording to reassure foreign merchants backing the tariff increase.

sentences.zh: 駐英使臣張德彝亦稱英外部謂擬加之稅務須降旨歸督撫提用，否則不能畫押，似英廷用意總慮稅加而釐不能撤。

translations.literal: Resident envoy in England Zhang Deyi also reported that the English Foreign Office said the proposed additional revenue must be ordered by imperial edict to be drawn by governors-general and governors, otherwise they could not sign; it seems the English court's intent was chiefly to fear duties would rise while likin could not be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Zhang Deyi in London reported that the Foreign Office required an edict assigning the new revenue to provincial governors, otherwise Britain would not sign—suggesting London feared higher tariffs without real likin abolition.

sentences.zh: 臣等詳細審度，彼雖請全數撥還各省，而內敘各省向解北京及應還洋債仍如數照撥。

translations.literal: Your servants examined this in detail: although they asked that the full sum be returned to the provinces, the text also stated that what the provinces had formerly remitted to Beijing and what was due on foreign debt would still be remitted in full.
translations.idiomatic: On close review, although Britain asked that the full sum go to the provinces, the text still required remittances to Beijing and foreign-debt payments in full.

sentences.zh: 我復照會，聲明應撥各項即留存海關，聽候戶部與各省商定抵解。

translations.literal: We replied by note, declaring that items due for allocation would remain at the customs, awaiting settlement between the Board of Revenue and the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: We replied by note that allocated sums would remain at customs pending settlement between the Board of Revenue and the provinces.

sentences.zh: 將來戶部如何商定派撥劃抵，由我自主，彼亦無從過問。

translations.literal: How the Board of Revenue would later agree on distribution and offset would be for us to decide autonomously; they would have no grounds to interfere.
translations.idiomatic: How the Board of Revenue would later allocate and offset those funds would remain entirely under our control, without foreign interference.

sentences.zh: 且現議償款易金還銀，正以我財力竭蹶為言，則加稅聲明祗抵裁釐，不涉賠款，可見毫無盈餘，藉可杜列國之口實。

translations.literal: Moreover, the present discussion of indemnity payment in gold rather than silver was precisely on the grounds of our financial exhaustion; declaring that the tariff increase was only to offset likin reduction and did not touch indemnity shows there was no surplus at all, which could block other powers from using it as a pretext.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, talks were already turning indemnity payments from gold to silver on grounds of China's financial exhaustion. Stating that the tariff increase would only offset likin abolition and not touch indemnity shows there would be no surplus—blocking other powers from making further claims.

sentences.zh: 畫押已延多日，即於八月初四日亥刻，會同英使馬凱在上海畫押蓋印。」

translations.literal: Signing had been delayed many days; on the fourth day of the eighth month at the hour of hai [9–11 p.m.], [we] together with the English envoy Mackay initialed and sealed [the treaty] in Shanghai."
translations.idiomatic: After many days' delay, the treaty was signed and sealed with Minister Mackay in Shanghai on the fourth day of the eighth month, late in the evening.

sentences.zh: 疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; report was heard.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 同時又續改內港行輪章程十款。

translations.literal: At the same time the regulations on inland steam navigation were further revised in ten articles.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the inland steam-navigation regulations were revised in ten articles.
