translations.idiomatic: both starting from Fuzhou).

sentences.zh: 又議湖南辰州府斃英教士案。

translations.literal: They also deliberated on the case of the English missionary killed in Chenzhou Prefecture, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: They also settled the case of the British missionary killed at Chenzhou in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 是月，英交還關內外鐵路。

translations.literal: That month England returned the railways inside and outside the passes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Britain returned the railways in North China.

sentences.zh: 是年，英皇愛惠將加冕，特命貝子載振為專使往賀。

translations.literal: That year King Edward was to be crowned; the court specially appointed Prince Zaizhen as envoy to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That year King Edward VII was to be crowned, and Prince Zaizhen was appointed special envoy to attend.

sentences.zh: 先期遞國書，向例須候各國專使齊集同見，英皇特定單班先見。

translations.literal: Beforehand he presented the state letter; by precedent one had to wait until all countries' special envoys were assembled for a joint audience, but the English king specially ordered a separate audience first.
translations.idiomatic: He presented his letter of credence in advance. By precedent envoys waited for a joint audience with all delegations assembled, but Edward arranged a separate audience first for the Chinese mission.

sentences.zh: 屆期行鞠躬禮，英主答禮，各述頌詞、答詞。

translations.literal: When the day arrived they performed the bow; the English sovereign returned the courtesy, and each delivered congratulatory and responsive addresses.
translations.idiomatic: At the ceremony they exchanged bows; the King returned the courtesy, and each side delivered its congratulatory address and reply.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春二月，與英訂滬甯鐵路借款合同。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month of the twenty-ninth year [Guangxu 29, 1903], [China] concluded with England the loan contract for the Shanghai-Nanjing Railway.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of 1903 China signed the Shanghai–Nanjing Railway loan agreement with Britain.

sentences.zh: 初，英於欲攬自滬至寧鐵路，令英商怡和承辦。

translations.literal: At first England wished to take over the railway from Shanghai to Nanjing and had the English firm Jardine Matheson undertake it.
translations.idiomatic: Britain had first sought to take the Shanghai–Nanjing line and assigned it to Jardine Matheson.

sentences.zh: 已議草約，旋以拳匪亂延緩。

translations.literal: A draft agreement had already been discussed, but it was then delayed by the Boxer turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: A draft agreement had been negotiated, then set aside by the Boxer uprising.

sentences.zh: 久之，始定議以年息五釐，借英金三百二十五萬鎊。

translations.literal: After a long time terms were finally fixed at five per cent annual interest, borrowing three million two hundred fifty thousand pounds sterling.
translations.idiomatic: Years later terms were fixed: a loan of £3.25 million at five per cent annual interest.

sentences.zh: 張之洞乃上奏，言：「借英金三百二十五萬鎊，虛數九扣，年息五釐，五十年為期，准其分次印售金鎊小票。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong then memorialized, saying: "To borrow three million two hundred fifty thousand pounds sterling, at a nominal discount of ten per cent, five per cent annual interest, a term of fifty years, permitting installment issue and sale of small sterling notes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong then reported: "The loan is £3.25 million sterling, issued at ninety per cent of face value, at five per cent interest for fifty years, with permission to issue bonds in installments.

sentences.zh: 如中國國家有款撥給，或中國紳富集資原購，借款總數便應照減，撥還淞滬鐵路工價後，即將已成車路暨備造滬甯全路作為借款抵押，所獲餘利，銀公司得五分之一，即照售票應分之數，另給餘利憑票，十二年半後，每百鎊加給二鎊半，隨時可將小票贖還，二十五年後，便照一百鎊原價取贖，毋庸加給。

translations.literal: If the Chinese state had funds to allocate, or Chinese gentry and merchants raised capital to buy back [bonds], the total loan should be reduced accordingly; after repaying the cost of the Wusong-Shanghai Railway section, the completed track together with the full Shanghai-Nanjing line to be built would serve as collateral for the loan; of surplus profits gained, the banking company would receive one-fifth, that is according to the share due on bonds sold, with separate profit coupons issued; after twelve and a half years, two and a half pounds would be added per hundred; small notes could be redeemed at any time; after twenty-five years they could be redeemed at the original hundred pounds without additional payment.
translations.idiomatic: If the state advanced funds or Chinese investors bought bonds back, the loan total would be reduced accordingly. After repaying the Wusong–Shanghai section, the completed line and the full Shanghai–Nanjing railway would serve as collateral. Of net profits the bank would receive one-fifth, matching its bond share, with separate profit coupons; after twelve and a half years an extra £2.5 per £100 would be paid. Bonds could be redeemed at any time; after twenty-five years at face value without premium.

sentences.zh: 至餘利憑票年期屆滿，分給餘利即時作廢，毋庸取贖。

translations.literal: When the term of the profit coupons expired, distribution of surplus profit would cease at once and there would be no need to redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: When profit coupons expired, surplus-profit payments would cease and the coupons would not be redeemed.

sentences.zh: 造路期內，就本付息，路成以後，贖票撥本，悉在鐵路進款支給。

translations.literal: During construction, interest would be paid on principal; after the road was completed, bond redemption and principal repayment would all be paid from railway receipts.
translations.idiomatic: During construction interest would be paid on principal; after completion bond redemption and principal would come from railway revenue.

sentences.zh: 全路訂定五年全竣。

translations.literal: The entire line was set to be completed within five years.
translations.idiomatic: The full line was to be completed within five years.

sentences.zh: 設無事故，逾此期限，銀公司五年內應得餘利全行扣罰。

translations.literal: If there were no mishap but this deadline was exceeded, all surplus profit due the banking company for five years would be entirely forfeited.
translations.idiomatic: If completion slipped without cause, the bank would forfeit all surplus profit for five years.

sentences.zh: 上海設立總管理處一所，本省督撫與督辦大臣會派總辦兩員，會同英員專理工程，另由南洋大臣加派一員，職銜相當，隨時查閱賬目，稟報督撫稽核。

translations.literal: One general management office would be established in Shanghai; the provincial governor-general and governor together with the supervising minister would jointly appoint two general managers to administer engineering together with English staff; the Nanyang minister would additionally appoint one official of equivalent rank to inspect accounts at any time and report to the governor-general and governor for audit.
translations.idiomatic: A headquarters would be set up in Shanghai. The provincial governor and the supervising minister would each appoint a general manager to oversee construction with British engineers, and the Nanyang minister would appoint an official of equal rank to audit accounts and report to the governors.

sentences.zh: 洋工司祗管工程，不能干預地方公事。

translations.literal: Foreign engineering supervisors would manage only engineering and could not interfere in local public affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign engineers would manage construction only and could not interfere in local administration.

sentences.zh: 凡所建築，悉應順洽華人意見，尊敬中國官員。

translations.literal: All construction should fully accord with Chinese views and respect Chinese officials.
translations.idiomatic: All construction was to respect Chinese views and Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 借款期內，不收專稅。

translations.literal: During the loan period no special tax would be collected.
translations.idiomatic: No special railway tax would be levied during the loan period.

sentences.zh: 如日後中國推設各項稅捐，如印花稅之類，別項商稅一律徵收，則滬甯鐵路亦應照準。

translations.literal: If hereafter China introduced various taxes and levies, such as stamp duties, and collected other commercial taxes uniformly, the Shanghai-Nanjing Railway would also be taxed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: If China later introduced general taxes such as stamp duties, the Shanghai–Nanjing line would be taxed on the same basis.

sentences.zh: 全路雙軌。

translations.literal: The entire line would be double-tracked.
translations.idiomatic: The line would be double-tracked throughout.

sentences.zh: 地畝總公司自備，仍由銀公司墊款，另須購地於標界之外，預備日後推展商務所必需，一併加售小票，綜計不得逾英金二十五萬鎊，年息六釐，在中國應得餘利項下支給，不能仍由鐵路進款支付。

translations.literal: Land would be provided by the land company itself, still advanced by the banking company; land must also be purchased beyond the survey boundaries to meet future commercial expansion needs, with additional small notes sold together, totaling not more than two hundred fifty thousand pounds sterling, at six per cent annual interest, paid from China's share of surplus profit and not again from railway receipts.
translations.idiomatic: Land would be supplied by a land company, with advances from the bank. Extra land beyond the survey line could be bought for future development, funded by additional bonds of up to £250,000 at six per cent, paid from China's share of surplus profit rather than railway revenue.

sentences.zh: 此項加售購地小票，並無年限，隨時可以取贖。

translations.literal: These additional land-purchase notes had no term limit and could be redeemed at any time.
translations.idiomatic: These land-purchase bonds had no fixed term and could be redeemed at any time.

sentences.zh: 造路購用中外材料，按照西例，每百給五，此外別無絲毫加用。

translations.literal: For Chinese and foreign materials purchased for construction, according to Western practice five per cent per hundred would be given, with no other addition whatsoever.
translations.idiomatic: Materials bought for construction would carry a five per cent commission under Western practice, with no other markup.

sentences.zh: 漢陽鐵廠自造料件，訂明侭先購用。

translations.literal: Parts manufactured by the Hanyang Iron Works were stipulated to be purchased first in preference.
translations.idiomatic: Materials from the Hanyang Iron Works were to be bought first when available.

sentences.zh: 凡遇調兵、運械、賑饑各事，照核定車價減半給發，侭先載運。

translations.literal: Whenever troops were moved, arms transported, or famine relief carried, fares would be charged at half the approved rate with priority carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Troop movements, arms transport, and famine relief would travel at half fare with priority loading.

sentences.zh: 侵礙中國主權，概不得經由此路。

translations.literal: Anything infringing Chinese sovereignty must in no case pass by this railway.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing infringing Chinese sovereignty might use the line.

sentences.zh: 正約簽定，草約作廢。

translations.literal: The formal agreement was signed and the draft agreement voided.
translations.idiomatic: The formal agreement was signed and the draft superseded.

sentences.zh: 十二個月不興工，即將正約註銷。

translations.literal: If work did not begin within twelve months, the formal agreement would be cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: If construction did not begin within twelve months, the formal agreement would be voided.

sentences.zh: 中國祗認英國銀公司，不准轉與他國及他國之人民。」

translations.literal: China would recognize only the British banking company and would not permit transfer to other states or their nationals."
translations.idiomatic: China recognized only the British banking company and forbade transfer of the concession to any other state or its nationals.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The terms were reported and approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，又與英訂滬寧路電交接辦法合同。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, another contract was concluded with Britain on the method of handing over the Shanghai-Nanjing railway telegraph line.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, China and Britain also signed a contract governing the handover of the Shanghai–Nanjing railway telegraph line.

sentences.zh: 三十年四月，英新任水師提督率大小兵船十艘抵滬，欲進長江。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirtieth year, the newly appointed British naval commander-in-chief led ten large and small warships to Shanghai, intending to enter the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirtieth year (1904), Britain's newly appointed naval commander-in-chief arrived at Shanghai with ten warships of various sizes, intending to sail up the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 張之洞聞之，電阻，英提督僅以四艘入江，至江寧而止。

translations.literal: When Zhang Zhidong heard of it, he telegraphed to obstruct them; the British commander entered the river with only four ships and stopped at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong learned of this and telegraphed to block the move. The British admiral sent only four vessels upriver, and they went no farther than Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 是年與英訂保工條約。

translations.literal: That year a labour-protection treaty was concluded with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: That year China and Britain concluded a treaty on the protection of Chinese labourers abroad.

sentences.zh: 時英于南斐洲新屬欲招華工開礦，政府援咸豐十年約，與訂專章。

translations.literal: At the time Britain, in its new possessions in South Africa, wished to recruit Chinese labourers to open mines; the government, citing the treaty of the tenth year of Xianfeng, concluded a special chapter with them.
translations.idiomatic: Britain then wished to recruit Chinese workers for mining in its new South African possessions. The Qing government, invoking the Convention of 1860, negotiated a special agreement.

sentences.zh: 至是，約成，遣領事於華工駐在地善視之。

translations.literal: By then the treaty was completed, and consuls were dispatched to the places where Chinese labourers resided to look after them well.
translations.idiomatic: When the treaty was concluded, consuls were posted to the districts where Chinese workers lived to ensure their proper treatment.

sentences.zh: 三十一年四月，與英續訂滇緬電線約款。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-first year, supplementary articles on the Yunnan-Burma telegraph line were renewed with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-first year (1905), China and Britain renewed the articles governing the Yunnan–Burma telegraph line.

sentences.zh: 英派委印度電務司貝林登為議約專員，電政大臣袁世凱委道員硃寶奎與議。

translations.literal: Britain appointed Billington of the Indian Telegraph Department as treaty commissioner; Yuan Shikai, Minister of Telegraph Administration, commissioned the intendant Zhu BaoKui to negotiate with him.
translations.idiomatic: Britain appointed Billington of the Indian Telegraph Department as its treaty commissioner. Yuan Shikai, the telegraph minister, commissioned the intendant Zhu Bao Kui to negotiate on China's behalf.

sentences.zh: 貝林登又請添造江通至思茅副線一條，不許。

translations.literal: Billington further requested an additional branch line from Jiangtong to Simao; permission was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Billington also asked to add a branch line from Jiangtong to Simao, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 遂定議簽押。

translations.literal: The terms were then settled and signed.
translations.idiomatic: The parties then settled the terms and signed the agreement.

sentences.zh: 又與英訂道清鐵路借款行車合同。

translations.literal: Another loan and operating contract for the Daoqing Railway was concluded with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: China and Britain also concluded a loan and operating contract for the Daoqing Railway.

sentences.zh: 初，英使向總署索英商承造鐵路五條，不許。

translations.literal: At first the British minister asked the Zongli Yamen for permission for British merchants to build five railways; permission was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the British minister asked the Zongli Yamen to let British firms build five railways, but the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 英復援礦務合同許有修築鐵路由礦山運送礦產至河口以達長江，欲修澤襄鐵路。

translations.literal: Britain again cited the mining contract, which permitted building a railway to transport ore from the mines to the river mouth to reach the Yangtze, and sought to build the Ze-Xiang Railway.
translations.idiomatic: Britain then cited the mining agreement, which allowed a railway from the mines to a river port on the Yangtze, and pressed to build the Ze–Xiang line.

sentences.zh: 嗣以襄陽至漢口水道不能通暢，請改道澤鐵路，欲在河南懷慶府與盧漢銜接；

translations.literal: Later, because the water route from Xiangyang to Hankou could not be kept open, they asked to change to the Ze Railway, wishing to connect at Huaiqing Prefecture in Henan with the Lu-Han line;
translations.idiomatic: When the Xiangyang–Hankou waterway proved impracticable, they sought a Zezhou line instead, proposing to join the Beijing–Hankou railway at Huaiqing in Henan;

sentences.zh: 渡河後，折入安徽正陽關以達江蘇江浦縣之浦口，改名懷浦鐵路。

translations.literal: after crossing the river, turning into Zhengyang Pass in Anhui to reach Pukou in Jiangpu County, Jiangsu, and renaming it the Huai-Pu Railway.
translations.idiomatic: then, after crossing the Yellow River, turning through Zhengyang Pass in Anhui to Pukou in Jiangsu and renaming the project the Huai–Pu Railway.

sentences.zh: 總署以懷浦遠跨豫、皖，名為緯路，實已斜亙南北，隱然增一幹路，以為有妨盧漢，仍不許。

translations.literal: The Yamen held that Huai-Pu, though called a branch line, in fact stretched obliquely across north and south through Henan and Anhui and would tacitly add a trunk route, and therefore still refused on the ground that it would hinder the Lu-Han line.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen held that although the line was styled a branch, the Huai–Pu route would cut diagonally across Henan and Anhui and in effect create another north–south trunk, interfering with the Beijing–Hankou railway, and again refused.

sentences.zh: 英使乃請修由澤州至道口鐵路，許之。

translations.literal: The British minister then requested construction of the railway from Zezhou to Daokou, and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The British minister then asked to build the line from Zezhou to Daokou, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 鐵路大臣盛宣懷等與議借款，為目二十一，行車款十，英金七十萬鎊，五釐行息，九扣交付，折實六十三萬鎊。

translations.literal: The Railway Minister Sheng Xuanhuai and others negotiated the loan: twenty-one items in all, ten for operation; seven hundred thousand pounds sterling at five per cent interest, delivered at ninety per cent, amounting in fact to six hundred thirty thousand pounds.
translations.idiomatic: Railway Minister Sheng Xuanhuai and others negotiated the loan in twenty-one articles, including ten on operation: £700,000 at five per cent interest, paid at ninety per cent of face value, yielding £630,000 net.

sentences.zh: 又同時訂擬設山西鎔化廠及合辦礦務合同，並請修廣州九龍鐵路。

translations.literal: At the same time draft contracts were drawn up to establish a Shanxi smelting plant and for joint mining operations, and permission was also sought to build the Guangzhou-Kowloon Railway.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time draft agreements were made for a Shanxi smelting works and joint mining ventures, and Britain again sought permission to build the Guangzhou–Kowloon Railway.

sentences.zh: 英使復請借款合同須由外務部將上諭照會立案，方允畫押，許之。

translations.literal: The British minister again requested that the loan contract must be registered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs through an imperial rescript and note before he would sign; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The British minister further insisted that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs register the loan contract by imperial rescript and diplomatic note before he would sign; China agreed.

sentences.zh: 三十二年四月，與英訂藏印條約。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-second year, a Tibet-India treaty was concluded with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirty-second year (1906), China and Britain concluded the renewed Tibet–India convention.

sentences.zh: 初，中國於光緒十六、十九兩年與英訂藏印條約，然藏、哲界牌既未建立，英人入藏細則又久未定。

translations.literal: At first China had concluded Tibet-India treaties with Britain in the sixteenth and nineteenth years of Guangxu, yet boundary markers between Tibet and Bhutan had not been erected, and detailed rules for British entry into Tibet had long remained unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: China had earlier concluded Tibet–India agreements with Britain in 1890 and 1893, but boundary markers between Tibet and Bhutan had never been set up, and the rules governing British access to Tibet had long remained unsettled.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，印督遣兵入藏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Indian governor-general sent troops into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year (1903) the governor-general of India sent troops into Tibet.

sentences.zh: 次年春，度大吉嶺，據江孜；

translations.literal: The next spring they crossed the Darjeeling pass and occupied Gyantse;
translations.idiomatic: The following spring they crossed from Darjeeling and seized Gyantse;

sentences.zh: 其夏，遂入拉薩。

translations.literal: that summer they then entered Lhasa.
translations.idiomatic: and that summer they entered Lhasa.

sentences.zh: 及達賴私與英訂約，駐藏大臣有泰始入告，而英、藏約已成。

translations.literal: By the time the Dalai Lama had privately concluded a treaty with Britain and the resident commissioner You Tai first entered to report it, the Anglo-Tibetan treaty was already concluded.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the Dalai Lama had privately signed a treaty with Britain and Resident Commissioner You Tai reported the fact to Beijing, the Anglo-Tibetan agreement was already a fait accompli.

sentences.zh: 政府命有泰與英議廢約，無效。

translations.literal: The government ordered You Tai to negotiate with Britain to annul the treaty, but to no effect.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered You Tai to negotiate the annulment of the treaty with Britain, but the effort failed.

sentences.zh: 復命外務部左侍郎唐紹儀為議約全權大臣，赴印度，與英外部專使費利夏會議。

translations.literal: The government again ordered Left Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Tang Shaoyi to serve as plenipotentiary treaty commissioner, to go to India and confer with the British special commissioner Fraser.
translations.idiomatic: The court then appointed Tang Shaoyi, vice minister of foreign affairs, plenipotentiary commissioner, and sent him to India to negotiate with the British special envoy S. M. Fraser.

sentences.zh: 費利夏欲我認印藏新約，方允改訂，紹儀不可，英遂欲停議。

translations.literal: Fraser wished China to recognize the new Anglo-Indian-Tibetan treaty before he would agree to revise it; Shaoyi would not, and Britain then wished to suspend negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: Fraser demanded Chinese recognition of the new Anglo-Tibetan treaty before he would agree to revisions. Tang refused, and the British side threatened to break off talks.

sentences.zh: 紹儀不得已，與商訂約稿六條。

translations.literal: Shaoyi, having no alternative, negotiated a draft treaty of six articles with him.
translations.idiomatic: Tang, left with little choice, negotiated a six-article draft with him.

sentences.zh: 外務部王大臣以約內第一款有「英國國家允認中國為西藏之上國」一語最有關係，電紹儀使改「上國」為「主國」，費利夏持不可。

translations.literal: The senior minister of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs held that the phrase in Article One, "the British state recognizes China as the superior state of Tibet," was most important, and telegraphed Shaoyi to change "superior state" to "sovereign state"; Fraser would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Senior ministers at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarded the phrase in Article One—"the British Government recognizes China as the superior state of Tibet"—as crucial and telegraphed Tang to change "superior state" to "sovereign state." Fraser refused.

sentences.zh: 約久未定。

translations.literal: The treaty long remained unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: The treaty remained unsettled for a long time.

sentences.zh: 九月，召紹儀回京，而以參贊張廕棠為大臣，接辦約事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Shaoyi was recalled to the capital, and Counsellor Zhang Yintang was made commissioner to take over the treaty affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Tang was recalled to Beijing and Counsellor Zhang Yintang was appointed commissioner to continue the negotiations.

sentences.zh: 外務部商諸英使薩道義，刪約稿第一條，英政府允諾，而其他條款則不容再改。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs negotiated with the British minister Satow to delete the first article of the draft; the British government consented, but would not permit any further changes to the other articles.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry negotiated with the British minister Satow to delete the first article of the draft; London agreed, but would allow no further changes to the remaining articles.

sentences.zh: 然費利夏仍堅持初議，數促廕棠畫諾，即第一條亦不能增減一字，廕棠力拒之。

translations.literal: Yet Fraser still held to his original position, repeatedly urging Yintang to sign, insisting that not even a single word of the first article might be added or removed; Yintang firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Fraser, however, still held to his original terms and repeatedly pressed Zhang to sign, refusing even a single word's change to Article One. Zhang firmly resisted.

sentences.zh: 會英廷新易政府，繼任者乃飭薩道義在京續商。

translations.literal: It happened that the British government changed; the successor then ordered Satow to continue negotiations in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When a new British cabinet took office, the incoming government ordered Satow to resume negotiations in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 久之始議訂正約五條。

translations.literal: After a long time the formal treaty of five articles was at last negotiated and concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Only after prolonged talks was the formal five-article convention finally agreed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，片馬交涉又起。

translations.literal: Before long the Pianma dispute arose again.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Pianma boundary dispute flared up again.

sentences.zh: 片馬處滇、緬交界之間，屬於騰越。

translations.literal: Pianma lies between the Yunnan-Burma border and belongs to Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: Pianma lay on the Yunnan–Burma frontier within Tengyue district.

sentences.zh: 英並緬甸，至是兩國會勘境界。

translations.literal: After Britain annexed Burma, the two states now jointly surveyed the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: After Britain annexed Burma, the two countries undertook a joint boundary survey.

sentences.zh: 至片馬附近，各執為本國土地，久不決。

translations.literal: Near Pianma each side claimed the land as its own territory, and for a long time no decision was reached.
translations.idiomatic: Near Pianma each side claimed the territory as its own, and the dispute dragged on unresolved.

sentences.zh: 時英又欲遣工程師勘騰越至大理中間道路，請中國保護。

translations.literal: At the time Britain again wished to send engineers to survey the road between Tengyue and Dali and requested Chinese protection.
translations.idiomatic: Britain then wished to send engineers to survey the route between Tengyue and Dali and asked China to provide protection.

sentences.zh: 滇督丁振鐸照會英領事，以滇現奏設公司自行修造，與前會勘時情形不同，請勿派往。

translations.literal: The Yunnan governor Ding Zhenduo noted to the British consul that Yunnan had now memorialized to establish a company to build the line itself, that circumstances differed from the earlier joint survey, and asked that they not be sent.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Governor Ding Zhenduo notified the British consul that the province had memorialized to build the line through its own company and that conditions differed from those of the earlier survey, and he asked that no engineers be sent.

sentences.zh: 英使硃爾典旋照會外務部，云：「據二月初七日照會，英得有承造新街至騰越鐵路之權，而承辦此段較短之鐵路，英政府不能視為足抵光緒二十四年三月准法政府或法政府所指之法商修造勞開至雲南府鐵路之利益。」

translations.literal: The British minister Jordan then noted to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, saying: "According to the note of the seventh day of the second month, Britain has the right to undertake construction of the railway from Hsinching to Tengyue, yet undertaking this shorter section of railway, the British government cannot regard it as sufficient to offset the benefits of the permission granted in the third month of the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu to the French government or to French merchants designated by the French government to build the railway from Laokai to Yunnan Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: The British minister Jordan then notified the Ministry of Foreign Affairs: "Your note of the seventh day of the second month states that Britain has the right to build the railway from Hsinching to Tengyue. The British Government cannot regard this shorter line as equivalent to the concession granted in March 1898 to France or to French firms designated by France to build the Laokai–Yunnan railway."

sentences.zh: 外務部覆，引中緬附約，謂：「第十二條載明中國答允將來審量在雲南修建鐵路與貿易有無裨益，如果修建，即允與緬甸鐵路相接。

translations.literal: The Ministry replied, citing the supplementary Sino-Burmese treaty: "Article Twelve states that China undertakes to weigh in future whether building railways in Yunnan would benefit trade, and if built, to permit connection with the Burmese railway.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry replied, citing the supplementary Sino-Burmese treaty: "Article Twelve provides that China will consider in future whether railways in Yunnan would benefit trade and, if built, will allow connection with the Burmese railway.

sentences.zh: 是該處中國境內鐵路應由中國自行審量。

translations.literal: Thus railways within Chinese territory in that region should be weighed by China itself.
translations.idiomatic: Railways within Chinese territory there are therefore for China itself to decide.

sentences.zh: 迨九月十九、十月十六等日，本部先後復薩前大臣照會，均一再守此旨，並聲明法國鐵路由雲南邊界修至雲南，本為條約所准，與滇緬約意不同。

translations.literal: Subsequently on the nineteenth day of the ninth month, the sixteenth day of the tenth month, and other dates, this ministry successively replied to former Minister Satow's notes, repeatedly holding to this intent, and declaring that the French railway from the Yunnan border to Yunnan was permitted by treaty and differed in intent from the Yunnan-Burma treaty.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth day of the ninth month, the sixteenth day of the tenth month, and on other dates, this ministry replied repeatedly to former Minister Satow's notes, holding firm to this position and stating that the French line from the Yunnan frontier to Kunming was authorized under a separate treaty and was not comparable to the Yunnan–Burma agreement.

sentences.zh: 緣兩國交涉各有約章可據，固不能相提並論也。

translations.literal: Because negotiations between the two states each have treaties on which to rely, they naturally cannot be discussed on the same footing.
translations.idiomatic: Each negotiation rests on its own treaty and the two cannot be equated.

sentences.zh: 逮二十八年二月初三日准薩前大臣照稱本國署理騰越烈領事不日將往雲南府，與滇督面商鐵路邊界各事宜，滇緬鐵路相接為振興商務之舉，凡在滇省，允給法商之利益，應一體允給英商。

translations.literal: By the third day of the second month of the twenty-eighth year permission was granted on former Minister Satow's note stating that Britain's acting Tengyue consul Litton would shortly go to Yunnan Prefecture to discuss railway and boundary matters face to face with the Yunnan governor; connecting the Yunnan-Burma railways was a measure to promote commerce, and whatever benefits granted in Yunnan to French merchants should be granted equally to British merchants.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day of the second month of the twenty-eighth year (1902) this ministry acknowledged former Minister Satow's note stating that Acting Consul Litton of Tengyue would soon visit Kunming to discuss railway and boundary matters with the governor. Connecting the Yunnan and Burmese railways would promote trade, and any benefit granted in Yunnan to French merchants should be granted equally to British merchants.

sentences.zh: 本部當以原照所稱面商鐵路邊界各事宜，又稱滇緬鐵路相接，曰邊界，曰相接，均系按照原約立論，故於是月初七日以據咨滇督也。

translations.literal: This ministry then took the original note's references to discussing railway and boundary matters face to face and to connecting the Yunnan-Burma railways—whether "boundary" or "connection"—as all based on the original treaty, and therefore on the seventh day of that month reported this to the Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: This ministry understood the original note's references to discussing railways and boundaries and to connecting the Yunnan and Burmese lines—whether "boundary" or "connection"—as grounded in the original treaty, and on the seventh day of that month so informed the Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 嗣于本年正月准滇督文，稱准英務領事照會，接烈領事來電，奉緬政府電，擬由新街達騰越修造一鐵路，以便商人運貨，先派公司勘明可否能修，再議商辦。

translations.literal: Later, in the first month of this year, permission was granted on the Yunnan governor's dispatch stating that the British consul's note had been received, together with Consul Litton's telegram, reporting the Burmese government's telegram that they proposed to build a railway from Hsinching to Tengyue to facilitate merchants' transport of goods, first dispatching a company to survey whether construction was feasible, and then negotiating commercial operation.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in the first month of this year, the ministry received the Yunnan governor's report citing a note from the British consul and a telegram from Consul Litton: the Burmese government proposed building a railway from Hsinching to Tengyue for commercial transport, first sending a company to survey feasibility and then negotiating terms.

sentences.zh: 當復以派員會勘，各修各路、各出各費等語，是滇與英領事所迭次議商者，亦均扼定約章鐵路相接之一語，毫無刺謬。

translations.literal: The reply then used such phrases as dispatching officers for joint survey, each side building its own routes and bearing its own costs; thus what Yunnan and the British consul discussed repeatedly also all adhered strictly to the treaty phrase on connecting railways, without the slightest contradiction.
translations.idiomatic: The reply stipulated joint survey, separate construction of each section, and separate funding. The exchanges between Yunnan and the British consul therefore adhered strictly to the treaty's language on railway connection, without contradiction.

sentences.zh: 本年五月，滇督奏請修理騰越小鐵路，籌款自辦，奉旨允准，原期中國雲南境內次第修建，以符與緬路相接之權。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of this year the Yunnan governor memorialized to repair the short Tengyue railway with self-raised funds; the imperial decree approved it, originally expecting that within Chinese Yunnan construction would proceed in stages to accord with the right to connect with the Burmese line.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of this year the Yunnan governor memorialized to build the short Tengyue line with provincial funds. The throne approved, expecting that China would construct its Yunnan sections in stages in accordance with the right to connect with the Burmese railway.

sentences.zh: 乃貴大臣來照，以為英政府得有承造新街至騰越鐵路之權，並引二十八年二月初七日之文為據，而以允給法商之利益相比例，實與中緬附約暨本部迭次照會之意不符。」

translations.literal: Yet Your Excellency's note holds that the British government has the right to undertake construction of the Hsinching-Tengyue railway, citing the document of the third day of the second month of the twenty-eighth year as evidence and comparing it to benefits granted French merchants; this truly does not accord with the supplementary Sino-Burmese treaty and the intent of this ministry's successive notes."
translations.idiomatic: Your Excellency's note now claims that the British Government has the right to build the Hsinching–Tengyue railway, citing the document of the third day of the second month of the twenty-eighth year and equating it with benefits granted to French merchants. This does not accord with the supplementary Sino-Burmese treaty or with the repeated notes of this ministry."

sentences.zh: 蓋不認英有造騰越鐵路之權也。

translations.literal: Thus Britain's right to build the Tengyue railway was not recognized.
translations.idiomatic: In effect, China denied Britain any right to build the Tengyue railway.

sentences.zh: 三十三年正月，與英訂九廣鐵路借款正合同。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-third year the formal loan contract for the Jiu-Guang Railway was concluded with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirty-third year (1907), China and Britain signed the formal loan contract for the Guangzhou–Kowloon Railway.

sentences.zh: 初，英既得九龍，即請承修由廣州至九龍鐵路。

translations.literal: At first, once Britain had obtained Kowloon, it immediately requested to undertake construction of the railway from Guangzhou to Kowloon.
translations.idiomatic: Once Britain had obtained Kowloon, it had immediately sought permission to build the railway from Guangzhou to Kowloon.

sentences.zh: 總署令督辦鐵路大臣盛宣懷與英商怡和洋行議辦，已簽草合同五條，旋因事未行。

translations.literal: The Yamen ordered Railway Superintendent Sheng Xuanhuai to negotiate with the British firm Jardine Matheson; a draft contract of five articles was signed, but shortly thereafter, because of circumstances, it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen ordered Railway Superintendent Sheng Xuanhuai to negotiate with Jardine Matheson. A five-article draft was signed, but the project was soon shelved.

sentences.zh: 至是，又以為請。

translations.literal: By then the request was made again.
translations.idiomatic: Britain now renewed the request.

sentences.zh: 外務部電知粵督岑春煊，以此項草約雖云仿照滬寧辦法，而滬甯路長費钜，九廣路短費少，情形不同，應查酌第二款，熟權利弊，派員與中英公司研商，以符原議。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs telegraphed Governor-General Cen Chunxuan of Guangdong that although this draft agreement was said to follow the Shanghai-Nanjing method, the Shanghai-Nanjing line was long with huge costs while the Jiu-Guang line was short with lesser costs and circumstances differed; he should examine Article Two, weigh advantages and disadvantages carefully, and dispatch officers to study with the Sino-British company to accord with the original intent.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs telegraphed Guangdong Governor Cen Chunxuan that although the draft was said to follow the Shanghai–Nanjing model, the Guangzhou–Kowloon line was shorter and cheaper and the circumstances differed. He should review Article Two, weigh the pros and cons carefully, and send officers to negotiate with the Sino-British company in keeping with the original understanding.

sentences.zh: 四月，與英公司代理人羅士、濮蘭德議，岑春煊欲照津榆鐵路辦法。

translations.literal: In the fourth month negotiations were held with the British company's agents Ross and Bland; Cen Chunxuan wished to follow the Tianjin-Yulin Railway method.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month negotiations were held with the company's agents Ross and Bland. Cen Chunxuan wished to follow the Tianjin–Yulin railway model.

sentences.zh: 濮蘭德以成議在先，不允，由粵到京，與唐紹儀等接議。

translations.literal: Bland held that agreement had already been reached and would not consent; he came from Guangdong to the capital to continue negotiations with Tang Shaoyi and others.
translations.idiomatic: Bland refused, citing a prior agreement, and came from Guangdong to Beijing to continue talks with Tang Shaoyi and others.

sentences.zh: 久之約成，議借英金一百五十萬鎊，照虛九四折納，年息五釐，以本路作抵押，三十年為期滿，十二年半後按照列表分期還本。

translations.literal: After a long time the treaty was concluded: a loan of one million five hundred thousand pounds sterling was agreed, subscribed at ninety-four per cent of face value, five per cent annual interest, with this railway as security, thirty years to maturity, and after twelve and a half years principal repaid in installments according to the schedule.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged negotiation the agreement was reached: a loan of £1,500,000 at ninety-four per cent of face value and five per cent annual interest, secured on the railway, with a thirty-year term and principal repayments in installments after twelve and a half years according to schedule.

sentences.zh: 二十五年以前，如欲於表額外多還股本，每英金一百鎊加還兩鎊半。

translations.literal: Before twenty-five years, if one wished to repay capital beyond the schedule, for every one hundred pounds an additional two and a half pounds would be repaid.
translations.idiomatic: Before the twenty-fifth year, any principal repaid above the scheduled amount would carry a premium of £2 10s. per £100.

sentences.zh: 中英公司代售此項股票。

translations.literal: The Sino-British company would sell these shares on behalf of the parties.
translations.idiomatic: The Sino-British company would place the loan bonds.

sentences.zh: 其股票填明價值若干鎊，由中國駐英大臣與英公司商定，所有建路及一切工需，均由粵督督辦。

translations.literal: The shares would state their value in pounds, to be fixed by China's minister in Britain in consultation with the British company; all construction and engineering needs would be supervised by the Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: The bonds would state their value in pounds sterling as agreed between China's minister in London and the company. All construction and engineering would be supervised by the Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 其重要職司，應用中國人，允當開工時，即于廣州設立總局一所，總理造路行車各事，由總督派中國總辦一人管理，佐以英國總工程司及總管帳各一人，均由總督核准。

translations.literal: Important posts should employ Chinese; when work was permitted to begin, a general bureau would at once be established in Guangzhou to oversee all matters of construction and operation; the governor would appoint one Chinese general superintendent to manage it, assisted by one British chief engineer and one chief accountant, all approved by the governor.
translations.idiomatic: Important posts were to be held by Chinese. When construction began, a headquarters would be established in Guangzhou to oversee building and operation. The governor would appoint a Chinese general superintendent, assisted by a British chief engineer and chief accountant, all subject to gubernatorial approval.

sentences.zh: 英公司辦事出力，給予酬金三萬五千鎊，兩期交付，其一切用錢暨酬勞費均在內。

translations.literal: For the British company's efforts in handling affairs, a remuneration of thirty-five thousand pounds would be given, paid in two installments, with all expenses and fees included therein.
translations.idiomatic: The British company would receive £35,000 in remuneration for its services, paid in two installments, covering all expenses and fees.

sentences.zh: 並聲明此路確系中國產業。

translations.literal: It was also declared that this railway was truly Chinese property.
translations.idiomatic: The contract also declared the railway to be Chinese property.

sentences.zh: 倘自本合同簽定之日起，八個月並未興工，即作廢紙。

translations.literal: If within eight months from the date of signing this contract work had not begun, it would become void paper.
translations.idiomatic: If construction had not begun within eight months of signing, the contract would be void.

sentences.zh: 所載權利，均不得讓給他國，中國亦不得另建一路以奪本路利益。

translations.literal: The rights recorded might not be transferred to other states, nor might China build another route to seize this route's benefits.
translations.idiomatic: None of the rights granted might be transferred to another state, nor might China build a competing line that would diminish this railway's profits.

sentences.zh: 旋簽押。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter it was signed.
translations.idiomatic: The contract was then signed.

sentences.zh: 六月，政府命湖南巡撫岑春蓂查辦雲南與英畫界失地案。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the government ordered Hunan Governor Cen Chunming to investigate the case of territory lost in the Yunnan-British boundary demarcation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the government ordered Hunan Governor Cen Chunming to investigate the loss of territory in the Sino-British boundary demarcation in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 先是雲貴總督丁振鐸委候補知府石鴻韶與英領事烈敦會勘騰越北段尖高山以北界，從尖高山起向北勘，越高黎共雪山直抵麗江府所管地。

translations.literal: Earlier the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Ding Zhenduo had commissioned the expectant prefect Shi Hongshao and British consul Litton jointly to survey the boundary north of Jian'gao Mountain on the northern section of Tengyue; from Jian'gao Mountain they surveyed northward, crossing the Gaoligong Mountains straight to territory under Lijiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yunnan–Guizhou Governor-General Ding Zhenduo had commissioned Expectant Prefect Shi Hongshao and British Consul Litton to survey the boundary north of Jian'gao Mountain on Tengyue's northern sector, running north from that peak across the Gaoligong range to the jurisdiction of Lijiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 烈敦執定以大啞口為界，石鴻韶執定以小江邊為界。

translations.literal: Litton insisted on taking Dayakou as the boundary; Shi Hongshao insisted on taking the Little River bank as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Litton insisted on Dayakou as the boundary line; Shi Hongshao insisted on the Little River.

sentences.zh: 貴州提學使陳榮昌奏參石鴻韶定界有失地事，政府命岑春蓂查辦。

translations.literal: Guizhou Education Commissioner Chen Rongchang memorialized impeaching Shi Hongshao for losing territory in fixing the boundary; the government ordered Cen Chunming to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou Education Commissioner Chen Rongchang memorialized accusing Shi Hongshao of ceding territory in the demarcation. The government ordered Cen Chunming to investigate.

sentences.zh: 春蓂派候補道沈祖燕往勘，旋覆稟云：「卷查烈領事此次所勘之界，系從尖高山起，東至阻札山，過狼牙山、磨石河頭、搬瓦丫口、姊妹山、大啞口、茨竹丫口、片馬丫口直上高黎共雪山北往西藏。

translations.literal: Chunming dispatched expectant circuit intendant Shen Zuyan to survey; he soon reported: "Reviewing Consul Litton's surveyed boundary on this occasion, it runs from Jian'gao Mountain east to Zuzha Mountain, passing Langya Mountain, Moshi River head, Banwa Pass, Sister Mountains, Dayakou, Cizhu Pass, Pianma Pass, straight up the north of the Gaoligong Mountains toward Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Cen dispatched Expectant Circuit Intendant Shen Zuyan to review the survey. Shen soon reported: "Consul Litton's proposed line runs from Jian'gao Mountain east to Zuzha Mountain, passing Langya Mountain, the Moshi River head, Banwa Pass, Sister Mountains, Dayakou, Cizhu Pass, and Pianma Pass, then north along the Gaoligong range toward Tibet.

sentences.zh: 所云大啞口，即為恩買卡河與潞江中間之分水嶺。

translations.literal: The so-called Dayakou is precisely the watershed between the Enmai River and the Lu River.
translations.idiomatic: Dayakou is the watershed between the Enmai River and the Salween (Lujiang).

sentences.zh: 其照會石道有云，由明光河頭直上高黎共雪山頂，由山頂北往西藏，凡水入金沙江者，概歸緬甸管理等語。

translations.literal: His note to Prefect Shi stated that from the head of the Mingguang River one goes straight up to the summit of the Gaoligong Mountains, and from the summit north toward Tibet, and that all waters entering the Jinsha River would in general be assigned to Burma, and similar language.
translations.idiomatic: In his note to Prefect Shi he proposed running from the Mingguang River head to the summit of the Gaoligong range, then north toward Tibet, assigning to Burma all watersheds draining into the Jinsha River.

sentences.zh: 若不幸照此定界，則是由滇而蜀而藏，邊界之地所被其割去者，當以數千里計。

translations.literal: If unfortunately the boundary were fixed according to this, then from Yunnan through Sichuan to Tibet the territory that would be cut away would amount to several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: If this line were accepted, the territory ceded from Yunnan through Sichuan into Tibet would amount to thousands of li.

sentences.zh: 外務部所謂『直是分割華境，是斷不能允從，可無庸置議』者也。

translations.literal: This is what the Ministry of Foreign Affairs called "outright partition of Chinese territory, absolutely impossible to grant, and not worth discussing."
translations.idiomatic: This was precisely what the Ministry of Foreign Affairs had called "outright partition of Chinese territory—absolutely unacceptable and not open to discussion."

sentences.zh: 若石道所擬以小江邊為界，系從尖高山起，由磨石河頭直上歪頭山，過之非河，經張家坡，登高良共山，又抵九角塘河，順小江邊，復另行橫出，上至小江源，又至板廠山為止。

translations.literal: If Prefect Shi's proposed boundary along the Little River bank is considered, it runs from Jian'gao Mountain from Moshi River head straight up to Waitou Mountain, crossing the Fei River, passing Zhangjiapo, ascending Gaoliangong Mountain, reaching Jiujiaotang River, following the Little River bank, then separately turning out crosswise, ascending to the Little River source, and ending at Banchang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Shi's proposed line along the Little River would run from Jian'gao Mountain up from the Moshi River head to Waitou Mountain, cross the Fei River, pass Zhangjiapo, ascend Gaoliangong Mountain, reach Jiujiaotang River, follow the Little River, then branch off crosswise to the river's source and end at Banchang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 查其所勘之界，於騰越、保山、雲龍、龍陵各屬土司素所管轄之地，數百年來向化中國者，一旦棄去不少。

translations.literal: Examining the boundary he surveyed, in territories long under the jurisdiction of native officials of Tengyue, Baoshan, Yunlong, and Longling, places that for several hundred years had looked to China, a great deal would at once be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Even this line would abandon much territory under the native officials of Tengyue, Baoshan, Yunlong, and Longling—lands that had acknowledged Chinese suzerainty for centuries.

sentences.zh: 又言北段界務，自以外務部所言之界線，由尖高山起至石我、獨木二河之間，循恩買卡河至小江西恩買卡河之東之分水嶺為界。

translations.literal: He also said that for the northern boundary affair, taking the line spoken of by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, from Jian'gao Mountain to between the Shiwo and Dumu rivers, following the Enmai River to the watershed east of the Enmai River west of the Little River as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: He argued that for the northern sector the proper line was that proposed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs: from Jian'gao Mountain to the stretch between the Shiwo and Dumu rivers, then along the Enmai River to the watershed east of the Enmai where it meets the Little River.

sentences.zh: 按此嶺當是他戛甲大山，最為持平。

translations.literal: This ridge should be the Tagajia Great Mountain and is the most equitable.
translations.idiomatic: This ridge should be the Tagajia range—the most equitable boundary.

sentences.zh: 且英使本有以小江即恩買卡河以東之分水嶺作為定界，又云天然界線系自東流入恩買卡河即小江諸江之分水嶺等語，與此正合。

translations.literal: Moreover the British minister had originally proposed taking the watershed east of the Little River, that is the Enmai River, as the fixed boundary, and also said that the natural boundary line was the watershed of streams flowing from the east into the Enmai River, that is the Little River, and similar language, which accords exactly with this.
translations.idiomatic: The British minister had originally proposed the watershed east of the Little River (the Enmai) as the boundary and had spoken of a natural line along the divide of streams flowing east into the Enmai—language that matched this proposal exactly.

sentences.zh: 則此次勘界，即於恩買卡河循流而行，至小江止，已足滿意。

translations.literal: Then for this boundary survey, simply following the Enmai River to the Little River would already be fully satisfactory.
translations.idiomatic: For this survey, following the Enmai River to its junction with the Little River would be fully satisfactory.

sentences.zh: 且所勘滇、緬北段，本祗為騰越與野人山之界，則必執定騰越諸土司之屬地及野人山之分界處以畫界，自是一定不易之理。

translations.literal: Moreover the northern Yunnan-Burma section surveyed was originally only the boundary between Tengyue and the Wild Headmen Hills; one must therefore hold firmly to the territories under Tengyue's native officials and the boundary with the Wild Headmen Hills in drawing the line—this is naturally an unalterable principle.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the northern Yunnan–Burma sector under survey concerned only the boundary between Tengyue and the Wild Headmen Hills. The line must therefore be drawn at the limit of Tengyue's native jurisdictions and the Wild Headmen Hills—a principle that could not be altered.

sentences.zh: 而與小江即恩買卡河以東之分水嶺，又自東流入恩買卡河，即小江諸江之分水嶺，並與譯出薛星使福成二十年簽押英文圖內之恩買卡分水嶺，其部位亦均相符合。

translations.literal: And the watershed east of the Little River, that is the Enmai River, and again the watershed of streams flowing from the east into the Enmai River, that is the Little River, also correspond in position with the Enmai watershed in the English map signed and sealed in the twentieth year by Minister Xue Fucheng, as translated.
translations.idiomatic: The watershed east of the Little River (the Enmai) and the divide of streams flowing east into the Enmai also correspond in position with the Enmai watershed shown on the English map signed by Minister Xue Fucheng in 1894.

sentences.zh: 石道並不先自詳審界限，而惟處處曲徇，以致失誤，此真為人意料所不及者也。

translations.literal: Prefect Shi did not first examine the boundary carefully himself but only yielded everywhere, thereby causing error—this truly exceeded what anyone could have expected.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Shi had failed to examine the boundary carefully and had yielded at every turn, causing these errors—an outcome no one could have foreseen.

sentences.zh: 查此次勘界，英使既言以小江即恩買卡河以東之分水嶺為界，又言自東流入恩買卡河即小江諸河之分水嶺，既明曰以東，又明曰自東流入，何以任烈領事之混為西流，竟勘至狼牙山迤北至大啞口而止？

translations.literal: Examining this boundary survey, since the British minister had said the boundary was the watershed east of the Little River, that is the Enmai River, and also said the watershed of streams flowing from the east into the Enmai River, that is the Little River, having clearly said "east" and clearly said "flowing in from the east," why was Consul Litton allowed to confuse this with west-flowing streams and survey as far north as Langya Mountain to Dayakou?
translations.idiomatic: The British minister had specified the watershed east of the Little River (the Enmai) and the divide of streams flowing east into the Enmai—clearly stating "east" and "flowing in from the east." Why then did Consul Litton confuse east- and west-flowing streams and survey north as far as Langya Mountain and Dayakou?

sentences.zh: 此其誤者一。

translations.literal: This was his first error.
translations.idiomatic: This was his first error.

sentences.zh: 又外務部覆稱明有『各守邊界』之文，此為甘稗地、茨竹、派賴燒殺之役而起，各守之地，自即在此。

translations.literal: Moreover the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' reply clearly had the phrase "each side guarding its own boundary," arising from the burning and killing affair at Ganbai, Cizhu, and Pailai; the territory each side was to guard was naturally here.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry's reply had also cited the phrase "each side guarding its own boundary," arising from the attacks at Ganbai, Cizhu, and Pailai. The territory each side was to guard lay precisely here.

sentences.zh: 何以不實守此小江邊界之說，至小江順流而下，而反另向東行，指鹿為馬，再直上別尋一小江源至板廠山為界？

translations.literal: Why was the claim to hold to this Little River boundary not honestly upheld, but instead, after following the Little River downstream, one turned separately eastward, calling a stag a horse, and again went straight up to seek another Little River source to Banchang Mountain as the boundary?
translations.idiomatic: Why did Shi fail to hold to the Little River boundary, but instead, after following the Little River downstream, turn eastward in a contrary direction—calling a stag a horse—and seek another headwater of the Little River up to Banchang Mountain?

sentences.zh: 此其誤者二。

translations.literal: This was his second error.
translations.idiomatic: This was his second error.

sentences.zh: 又英使所言天然界線，乃自東流入恩買卡河即小江諸水之分水嶺，而烈領事所勘，乃指恩買卡河與龍江之分水嶺，謂嶺之東所有溪河均入明光龍江，嶺之西所有溪河均入恩買卡、金沙江，以此嶺之東西為中、緬之分界。

translations.literal: Moreover the natural boundary line spoken of by the British minister was the watershed of waters flowing from the east into the Enmai River, that is the Little River, whereas what Consul Litton surveyed was the watershed between the Enmai River and the Long River, holding that all streams east of the ridge entered the Mingguang Long River and all streams west entered the Enmai and Jinsha rivers, taking east and west of this ridge as the Sino-Burmese boundary.
translations.idiomatic: The natural boundary the British minister described was the divide of streams flowing east into the Enmai (the Little River). Consul Litton instead surveyed the watershed between the Enmai and the Salween (Long River), assigning streams east of the ridge to the Mingguang–Salween system and streams west to the Enmai and Jinsha, and taking the east–west divide of that ridge as the Sino-Burmese boundary.

sentences.zh: 石道不能明據小江東流，力為駮斥，而乃以山形水勢則然一語，含混答覆，而竟任烈領事之隨意所指，東西自便。

translations.literal: Prefect Shi could not clearly rely on the eastward flow of the Little River and rebut forcefully, but answered vaguely with the phrase "such is the mountain form and water trend," and ultimately allowed Consul Litton to point wherever he pleased, convenient east or west as he wished.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Shi failed to rebut Litton's line by citing the eastward flow of the Little River and instead answered vaguely that "such is the lay of the mountains and waters," allowing the consul to fix the boundary wherever he chose, east or west at his convenience.

sentences.zh: 此其誤者三。

translations.literal: This was his third error.
translations.idiomatic: This was his third error.

sentences.zh: 且即如英使照會恩買卡河與潞江之分水嶺之說，此嶺即為大啞口，亦祗西勘至片馬丫口為止，何以任烈領事直上高黎共雪山，竟偕測繪王生，勘至麗江府屬蘭州邊界始回也？

translations.literal: Moreover, even accepting the British minister's note on the watershed between the Nmaikha and the Nu River, that ridge is Dayakou and surveying west should stop only at Pianmayakou—why did Consul Renlie go straight up Gaoligong Snow Mountain with surveyor Wang and survey as far as the Lanzhou border of Lijiang prefecture before returning?
translations.idiomatic: Even on Britain's own watershed claim between the Nmaikha and the Nu, the line is Dayakou and should end at Pianmayakou to the west—so why did Consul Litton climb Gaoligong with Surveyor Wang and run the line all the way to Lanzhou in Lijiang before turning back?

sentences.zh: 此其誤者四。

translations.literal: This was his fourth error.
translations.idiomatic: That was the fourth mistake.

sentences.zh: 又小江外如噬戛等寨，系騰越屬之茨竹、大塘土司所轄，籠榜系保山屬之登埂土司所轄，確鑿可據。

translations.literal: Again, beyond the Little River, villages such as Shiga were under the Cizhu and Datang native officials of Tengyue, and Longbang under the Denggeng native official of Baoshan—matters of solid record.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Little River, villages like Shiga fell under Tengyue's Cizhu and Datang chiefs, and Longbang under Baoshan's Denggeng chief—well documented in the records.

sentences.zh: 乃烈領事照會言『貴道來示，謂已摒諸化外』，而石道覆稱又言『業經聲明久在化外』。

translations.literal: Yet Consul Lie's note said, "Your Excellency's communication states they have been cast beyond the pale," while Commissioner Shi's reply again said, "It has already been declared that they have long been beyond the pale."
translations.idiomatic: Yet Litton's note quoted Shi as saying the villages were "beyond the pale," and Shi's own reply repeated that they had "long been outside Chinese administration."

sentences.zh: 石道責在勘界，並不援據力爭，而反先自認『久在化外』，實所不解。

translations.literal: Commissioner Shi's duty was to survey the boundary; he did not cite evidence and argue forcefully, but on the contrary first admitted himself that the area had "long been beyond the pale"—truly incomprehensible.
translations.idiomatic: Shi was charged with demarcation yet failed to argue from evidence and instead volunteered that the land had "long been beyond the pale"—inexplicable conduct.

sentences.zh: 此其誤者五。

translations.literal: This was his fifth error.
translations.idiomatic: That was the fifth mistake.

sentences.zh: 又茅貢等寨原系滇灘屬土司所轄，本中國舊有之地，不過英兵曾經至此，並強收門戶稅而已，並非英人實已占為屬地，而中國有允認之明文也。

translations.literal: Again, villages such as Maogong had originally been under the native official of Diantan; they were old Chinese territory; it was only that English troops had once come there and forcibly collected gate taxes—not that the English had actually occupied them as dependency, nor that China had any written acknowledgment.
translations.idiomatic: Villages like Maogong had always belonged to Diantan's native chief on old Chinese soil; British troops had only passed through and levied gate taxes—there was no occupation and no Chinese acknowledgment in writing.

sentences.zh: 乃石道照會謂『早經貴國辦過案件，不復管理』，竟絕不置辨。

translations.literal: Yet Commissioner Shi's note said, "Your country has already handled the case and no longer administers it," and he made no argument at all.
translations.idiomatic: Shi merely noted that Britain had "already handled the matter" and abandoned administration, offering no rebuttal.

sentences.zh: 此其誤者六。

translations.literal: This was his sixth error.
translations.idiomatic: That was the sixth mistake.

sentences.zh: 至於大啞口外，如甘稗地等各處，烈領事欲仿三角地成案，作為永租。

translations.literal: As for beyond Dayakou, at places such as Ganbaindi, Consul Lie wished to follow the precedent of the leased triangle and make them perpetual lease.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Dayakou, at Ganbaindi and similar places, Litton wanted a perpetual lease on the model of the Kowloon Walled City triangle.

sentences.zh: 既欲議租，則已明認為中國之地，正可趁此力駮，使之無辭可遁。

translations.literal: Since he wished to negotiate lease, he had already clearly acknowledged it as Chinese territory; one could seize this moment to rebut forcefully and leave him no escape in argument.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking a lease was itself an admission of Chinese sovereignty—a point that should have been pressed until Britain had no reply.

sentences.zh: 計大啞口外共有一十八寨，其地甚廣，豈可輕棄？

translations.literal: Beyond Dayakou there were altogether eighteen villages; the land was very broad—how could it be lightly abandoned?
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen villages lay beyond Dayakou over a wide tract—how could such territory be surrendered lightly?

sentences.zh: 且既認租，則茨竹、派賴燒殺一百十四命之案，明是入我中國之界，正可提議，使之不能諉卸，何以絕不辨論？

translations.literal: Moreover, once lease was acknowledged, the case of Cizhu and Pailai burning and killing one hundred fourteen lives clearly occurred within our Chinese border; one could raise it and make them unable to shirk responsibility—why argue nothing at all?
translations.idiomatic: Once lease was admitted, the massacre of 114 people by Cizhu and Pailai clearly happened inside China—a charge Britain could not evade; why did Shi never raise it?

sentences.zh: 此其誤者七。

translations.literal: This was his seventh error.
translations.idiomatic: That was the seventh mistake.

sentences.zh: 又狼速之地，甚為遼闊，一名狼宋。

translations.literal: Again, the Langsu region was very vast, also called Langsong.
translations.idiomatic: The Langsu region, also called Langsong, was vast.

sentences.zh: 《大理府志》：『莪昌散處於狼宋、曹澗、趕馬撒之間，道光十八年准兵部議，以趕馬撒、曹澗等寨歸雲龍州管轄』，則狼速乃大理府屬境。

translations.literal: The Dali Prefecture Gazetteer states: "Echang is scattered between Langsong, Caojian, and Ganmasa; in the eighteenth year of Daoguang the Ministry of War approved placing Ganmasa, Caojian, and other villages under Yunlong prefecture"—thus Langsu was territory of Dali prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Dali Prefecture Gazetteer places Echang between Langsong, Caojian, and Ganmasa and records Daoguang 18 approval putting those villages under Yunlong—proof Langsu belonged to Dali.

sentences.zh: 若如石道所勘，另尋一小江源至板廠山為界，則不特噬戛等一十八寨摒諸化外，且並將狼速地一帶地方亦概棄之不問矣。

translations.literal: If, as Commissioner Shi surveyed, one sought another Little River source to Banchang Mountain as boundary, then not only would the eighteen villages such as Shiga be cast beyond the pale, but the whole Langsu region would also be abandoned without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Shi's line from a different Little River headwater to Banchang Mountain would cast out the eighteen villages and abandon the entire Langsu region.

sentences.zh: 此其誤者八。

translations.literal: This was his eighth error.
translations.idiomatic: That was the eighth mistake.

sentences.zh: 然此八者，甚害尚祗在滇省也。

translations.literal: Yet these eight errors, serious as they were, still harmed only Yunnan province.
translations.idiomatic: Serious as these eight errors were, the damage was still confined to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 更有大誤足以為將來之後患者：一則小江外之狼速地一旦棄去，再北而為怒夷，其地踞龍、潞兩江之上流，東接維西、中甸，直通麗江，北與四川之巴塘、裏塘諸土司相接，西北即可以通至西藏；

translations.literal: There were greater errors sufficient to become future chronic troubles: first, once Langsu beyond the Little River was abandoned, farther north lay Nu territory; the land straddled the upper reaches of the Nujiang and Lancang, east connected to Weixi and Zhongdian and directly to Lijiang, north adjoined Batang and Litang native domains in Sichuan, and northwest could reach Tibet;
translations.idiomatic: Worse errors would breed lasting trouble: abandoning Langsu opened the Nu country to the north, commanding the upper Salween and Mekong, linking Weixi and Zhongdian to Lijiang, touching Batang and Litang in Sichuan, and opening routes northwest into Tibet;

sentences.zh: 一則高黎共雪山之地任其節外生枝，自往履勘，將來若果曲從，則即可從此高黎共雪山之頂，沿潞江、金沙江之上流由北直進，不特球夷、怒夷之地去其大半，即維西屬之鋪拉籠、西藏屬之擦瓦龍一帶皆將被其所侵佔，所失之土地豈尚可以數計？」

translations.literal: second, allowing Gaoligong Snow Mountain to sprout branches beyond the agreement and going to survey on one's own—if later the court indeed yielded, then from the peak of Gaoligong one could advance straight north along the upper Nu and Jinsha; not only would most Nu and Qiu territory be lost, but Pulalong under Weixi and Tsawarong under Tibet would also be encroached upon—how could the land lost still be counted?"
translations.idiomatic: second, letting Litton survey Gaoligong at will—if Beijing yielded, Britain could march north from the ridge along the Salween and Yangtze headwaters, stripping most Nu and Qiu lands and seizing Pulalong and Tsawarong; how could the territorial loss even be counted?"

sentences.zh: 岑春蓂得覆，即據以入奏。

translations.literal: When Cen Chunming received this reply, he immediately memorialized on it.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Chunming received Shen's report and memorialized the throne.

sentences.zh: 上諭革石鴻韶等職，仍不允。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the dismissal of Shi Hongshao and others from office, but it was still not approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Shi Hongshao dismissed, but the proposal was not approved.

sentences.zh: 時因津鎮鐵路借款，直隸、山東、江蘇三省商民欲廢約，英不允，允改章。

translations.literal: At the time, because of the Tianjin–Pukou railway loan, merchants of Zhili, Shandong, and Jiangsu wished to abrogate the contract; Britain refused but agreed to revise the articles.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants in Zhili, Shandong, and Jiangsu sought to cancel the Tianjin–Pukou railway loan; Britain refused abrogation but agreed to revised terms.

sentences.zh: 德與英同。

translations.literal: Germany acted the same as Britain.
translations.idiomatic: Germany took the same position as Britain.

sentences.zh: 英又因鄂境修造粵漢、川漢兩路需款，欲借款於中國，卻之。

translations.literal: Britain also, because building the Guangzhou–Hankou and Sichuan–Hankou lines in Hubei required funds, wished to lend money to China; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Britain also offered China a loan for the Guangzhou–Hankou and Sichuan–Hankou railways in Hubei; Beijing declined.

sentences.zh: 是年，山西商務局與英福公司議定贖回開礦制鐵轉運合同。

translations.literal: That year, the Shanxi Bureau of Commerce and the British Pekin Syndicate agreed on a contract to redeem mining, iron-making, and transport rights.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shanxi's Bureau of Commerce and the British Pekin Syndicate agreed terms to buy back the mining and iron contract.

sentences.zh: 初，晉省礦由晉商與福公司商人羅沙第訂立合同。

translations.literal: At first, Shanxi mines were contracted between Shanxi merchants and Pekin Syndicate merchant Rossi.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi mines had first been contracted between local merchants and Rossi of the Pekin Syndicate.

sentences.zh: 旋於光緒二十四年復由商務局紳商與福公司改訂借款章程二十條。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, in Guangxu 24, the bureau gentry and merchants again revised with the company a twenty-article loan charter.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 the bureau and company rewrote a twenty-article loan charter.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，又經盛宣懷續立合同四條。

translations.literal: In year 31, Sheng Xuanhuai further concluded a four-article contract.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 Sheng Xuanhuai added a four-article agreement.

sentences.zh: 案久未結。

translations.literal: The case had long remained unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: The dispute had dragged on for years.

sentences.zh: 至是商務局員紳並全省代表各員在京開議，訂定贖回自辦合同十二條，贖款行平化寶銀二百七十五萬兩，由山西商務局擔任，按期交清。

translations.literal: By this time bureau members, gentry, and provincial representatives met in the capital and fixed a twelve-article redemption and self-operation contract; redemption was 2.75 million taels of sycee silver at the market rate, borne by the Shanxi Bureau of Commerce and paid on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Representatives met in Beijing and signed twelve articles to redeem the concession for 2.75 million taels sycee, payable on schedule by the Shanxi Bureau of Commerce.

sentences.zh: 三十四年二月，與英訂滬杭甬鐵路借款合同。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 34, a loan contract for the Shanghai–Hangzhou–Ningbo railway was concluded with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 34 China signed the Shanghai–Hangzhou–Ningbo railway loan with Britain.

sentences.zh: 先是滬杭甬鐵路已立有草合同四條：一，訂草約章程，與滬寧鐵路章程一樣；

translations.literal: Earlier the Shanghai–Hangzhou–Ningbo railway had a draft contract of four articles: first, draft regulations the same as the Shanghai–Nanjing railway regulations;
translations.idiomatic: A prior draft had four points: regulations mirroring the Shanghai–Nanjing line;

sentences.zh: 二，將來訂正約，仍與嗣後商定核准之滬寧正約一樣；

translations.literal: second, the future formal treaty still the same as the later approved Shanghai–Nanjing formal treaty;
translations.idiomatic: second, the formal treaty to match whatever Shanghai–Nanjing terms were later approved;

sentences.zh: 三，從速測勘；

translations.literal: third, survey speedily;
translations.idiomatic: third, prompt surveying;

sentences.zh: 四，如有地方窒礙之處，即行更正，俟訂正約，即會同入奏。

translations.literal: fourth, if any place proved obstructive, correct it at once; when the formal treaty was fixed, memorialize jointly.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, correct local obstacles and memorialize jointly once the formal treaty was ready.

sentences.zh: 至是浙江紳士籌辦全省鐵路，欲廢前約，收回自辦。

translations.literal: By this time Zhejiang gentry were organizing provincial railways, wishing to abrogate the prior agreement and recover self-operation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang gentry then sought to cancel the earlier agreement and run the line themselves.

sentences.zh: 英使不允，因命侍郎汪大燮等與英公司改商借款辦法，久未決。

translations.literal: The British minister refused; the court therefore ordered Vice Minister Wang Daxie and others to renegotiate loan methods with the British company, but no decision came for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: The British minister refused; Wang Daxie and others renegotiated with the company for months without result.

sentences.zh: 於是政府再命侍郎梁敦彥接議，分辦路、借款為兩事，路由中國自造，除華商原有股本侭數備用外，約仍需英金一百五十萬鎊，即向英公司籌借，按九三折扣交納，年五釐息，以三十年為期；

translations.literal: Thereupon the government again ordered Vice Minister Liang Dunyan to take over negotiations, separating railway construction and loan as two matters; the line would be built by China itself; aside from Chinese merchant capital already subscribed, the agreement still required 1.5 million pounds sterling borrowed from the British company, paid at a 93 percent discount, five percent annual interest, for thirty years;
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dunyan was sent to split construction and finance: China would build the railway, supplementing Chinese capital with a £1.5 million loan from the British firm at 93 percent of par, five percent interest, thirty years;

sentences.zh: 並聲明如所收此路進項不足，由關內外鐵路餘利撥付；

translations.literal: and it was stated that if this line's receipts were insufficient, payment would come from surplus profits of railways inside and outside the passes;
translations.idiomatic: shortfalls would be covered from surplus profits on other national railways;

sentences.zh: 凡提用款項，均由郵傳部或其所派之人經理；

translations.literal: all withdrawals were to be managed by the Ministry of Posts and Communications or persons it appointed;
translations.idiomatic: the Ministry of Posts and Communications would control all disbursements;

sentences.zh: 此鐵路建造工程，以及管理一切之權，全歸中國國家；

translations.literal: construction of this railway and all authority of management belonged wholly to the Chinese state;
translations.idiomatic: construction and management remained entirely Chinese;

sentences.zh: 英公司代購外洋材料機器，以三萬五千鎊作為酬勞，一切用銀均在內；

translations.literal: the British company would purchase foreign materials and machinery on agency, with thirty-five thousand pounds as remuneration, all silver expenses included;
translations.idiomatic: the British company would procure foreign materials for £35,000 commission, silver costs included;

sentences.zh: 選用英總工程司一人，仍須聽命於總辦等語。

translations.literal: one British chief engineer might be selected, but must still obey orders of the general director, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: one British chief engineer might be hired but would answer to the Chinese director.

sentences.zh: 遂定議。

translations.literal: The agreement was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Terms were finally settled.

sentences.zh: 九月，與英訂藏印通商章程。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, trade regulations between Tibet and India were concluded with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Britain and China signed Tibet–India trade regulations.

sentences.zh: 是年，借英滙豐及法匯理銀行款，收回京漢鐵路。

translations.literal: That year, loans were taken from the British Hongkong and Shanghai Bank and the French Banque de l'Indochine to recover the Beijing–Hankou railway.
translations.idiomatic: That year loans from HSBC and the Banque de l'Indochine bought back the Beijing–Hankou railway.
